functions.description: Parses an optional explicitly-tagged element with the given tag. If present, sets out (if non-NULL) to its contents and out_present to 1; otherwise sets out_present to 0 and leaves CBS at original position.
requirements: cbs must be positioned at either the optional element or the following element.
out may be NULL to ignore the value.
out_present may be NULL to ignore presence.
Returns 1 on success (present or not), 0 on decode failure.

functions.name: CBS_get_optional_asn1_octet_string
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int CBS_get_optional_asn1_octet_string(CBS *cbs, CBS *out, int *out_present, CBS_ASN1_TAG tag)
functions.description: Parses an optional explicitly-tagged OCTET STRING. If present, sets out to the string and out_present to 1; otherwise sets out empty and out_present to 0.
requirements: cbs must be positioned at the optional element or not.
out must be non-NULL (will be set to empty if absent).
out_present may be NULL to ignore presence.
Returns 1 on success (present or absent), 0 on decode failure.

functions.name: CBS_get_optional_asn1_uint64
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int CBS_get_optional_asn1_uint64(CBS *cbs, uint64_t *out, CBS_ASN1_TAG tag, uint64_t default_value)
functions.description: Parses an optional explicitly-tagged INTEGER. If present, writes its value to out; otherwise writes default_value.
requirements: cbs must be positioned at the optional element or not.
out must be non-NULL.
Returns 1 on success (present or absent), 0 on decode failure.

functions.name: CBS_get_optional_asn1_bool
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int CBS_get_optional_asn1_bool(CBS *cbs, int *out, CBS_ASN1_TAG tag, int default_value)
functions.description: Parses an optional explicitly-tagged BOOLEAN. If present, writes 0 or 1; otherwise writes default_value.
requirements: cbs must be positioned at the optional element or not.
out must be non-NULL.
Returns 1 on success (present or absent), 0 on decode failure.

functions.name: CBS_is_valid_asn1_bitstring
functions.description: Validates that cbs contains a well-formed ASN.1 BIT STRING body (contents only).
requirements: cbs must be initialized.
Returns 1 if valid, 0 otherwise.

functions.name: CBS_asn1_bitstring_has_bit
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int CBS_asn1_bitstring_has_bit(const CBS *cbs, unsigned bit)
functions.description: Checks whether the given bit is present and set in a valid ASN.1 BIT STRING body.
requirements: cbs must be a valid ASN.1 BIT STRING body (function returns 0 otherwise).
bit index is zero-based.
Returns 1 if present and set; 0 otherwise.

functions.name: CBS_is_valid_asn1_integer
functions.description: Validates that cbs is a well-formed ASN.1 INTEGER body. Optionally reports if it is negative.
requirements: cbs must be initialized.
out_is_negative may be NULL to ignore negativity result.
Returns 1 if valid, 0 otherwise.

functions.name: CBS_is_unsigned_asn1_integer
functions.description: Validates that cbs is a well-formed, non-negative ASN.1 INTEGER body.
requirements: cbs must be initialized.
Returns 1 if valid non-negative, 0 otherwise.

functions.name: CBS_is_valid_asn1_oid
functions.description: Validates DER-encoded ASN.1 OBJECT IDENTIFIER contents (no element header). Tolerates arbitrarily large OID components.
requirements: cbs must be initialized.
Returns 1 if valid OID contents, 0 otherwise.

functions.name: CBS_asn1_oid_to_text
functions.description: Converts DER-encoded ASN.1 OBJECT IDENTIFIER contents to a newly-allocated dotted-decimal ASCII string.
requirements: cbs must contain valid OID contents.
On success, returned string must be freed with OPENSSL_free.
May return NULL on invalid input or allocation failure.

functions.name: CBS_is_valid_asn1_relative_oid
functions.description: Validates DER-encoded ASN.1 RELATIVE-OID contents (no element header). Tolerates arbitrarily large components.
requirements: cbs must be initialized.
Returns 1 if valid RELATIVE-OID contents, 0 otherwise.

functions.name: CBS_asn1_relative_oid_to_text
functions.description: Converts DER-encoded ASN.1 RELATIVE-OID contents to a newly-allocated dotted-decimal ASCII string.
requirements: cbs must contain valid RELATIVE-OID contents.
On success, returned string must be freed with OPENSSL_free.
May return NULL on invalid input or allocation failure.

functions.name: CBS_parse_generalized_time
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int CBS_parse_generalized_time(const CBS *cbs, struct tm *out_tm, int allow_timezone_offset)
functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded ASN.1 GeneralizedTime body (RFC 5280 constraints). Optionally allows four-digit timezone offsets. On success, fills out_tm (if non-NULL) with the corresponding UTC time (tm_wday and tm_yday not computed).
requirements: cbs must contain a valid GeneralizedTime body within RFC 5280 limitations.
out_tm may be NULL to ignore the parsed time.
allow_timezone_offset non-zero permits four-digit offsets otherwise disallowed by DER.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on invalid input.

functions.name: CBS_parse_utc_time
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int CBS_parse_utc_time(const CBS *cbs, struct tm *out_tm, int allow_timezone_offset)
functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded ASN.1 UTCTime body (RFC 5280 constraints). Optionally allows four-digit timezone offsets. On success, fills out_tm (if non-NULL) in UTC (tm_wday and tm_yday not computed).
requirements: cbs must contain a valid UTCTime body within RFC 5280 limitations.
out_tm may be NULL to ignore the parsed time.
allow_timezone_offset non-zero permits four-digit offsets otherwise disallowed by DER.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on invalid input.

functions.name: CBB_zero
functions.description: Sets an uninitialized CBB to the zero state. Safe to call CBB_cleanup later even if init fails.
requirements: cbb must be a valid pointer.
Must call CBB_init or CBB_init_fixed before use (other than cleanup).

functions.name: CBB_init
functions.description: Initializes a growable CBB with an initial capacity hint.
requirements: cbb must be a valid pointer and currently zero or uninitialized state.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on allocation failure.
After a failure, the CBB is in an error/undefined state and must not be used except CBB_cleanup.

functions.name: CBB_init_fixed
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int CBB_init_fixed(CBB *cbb, uint8_t *buf, size_t len)
functions.description: Initializes a CBB to write into a fixed caller-provided buffer of length len. Cannot grow.
requirements: cbb must be a valid pointer.
buf must point to a writable buffer of at least len bytes (len may be zero).
This function always returns 1 (infallible).
Attempting to write more than len bytes will cause subsequent CBB operations to fail.

functions.name: CBB_cleanup
functions.description: Releases all resources for cbb and any CBBs writing to the same buffer. Use when abandoning a serialization or at end of use.
requirements: May only be called on a top-level CBB (initialized with CBB_init/CBB_init_fixed) or a CBB set to zero with CBB_zero.
After cleanup, all children and associated buffers become invalid.

functions.name: CBB_finish
functions.description: Finalizes any pending length prefixes and returns the serialized bytes in a newly-allocated buffer and its length. Transfers ownership to caller.
requirements: Must be called only on a top-level CBB (initialized with CBB_init or CBB_init_fixed).
out_data and out_len must be non-NULL.
If the buffer was not fixed, caller must free *out_data with OPENSSL_free.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBB_flush
functions.description: Forces any pending length prefixes to be written and invalidates any active child CBBs, allowing the parent to be used after children go out of scope.
requirements: cbb must be initialized.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBB_data
functions.description: Returns a pointer to bytes written so far without flushing. Fatal to call if there are active children with unfinalized length prefixes.
requirements: cbb must be initialized.
There must be no active children (unflushed).
Returned pointer is invalidated by the next operation on cbb.

functions.name: CBB_len
functions.description: Returns the number of bytes written so far without flushing. Fatal to call if there are active children with unfinalized length prefixes.
requirements: cbb must be initialized.
There must be no active children (unflushed).

functions.name: CBB_add_u8_length_prefixed
functions.description: Creates a child CBB whose contents will be prefixed in the parent with an 8-bit length when finalized.
requirements: cbb must be initialized and not currently have an active child unless flushed/discarded.
out_contents must be non-NULL and will become active child until flushed/finished.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBB_add_u16_length_prefixed
functions.description: Creates a child CBB with a big-endian 16-bit length prefix in the parent.
requirements: Same constraints as CBB_add_u8_length_prefixed.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBB_add_u24_length_prefixed
functions.description: Creates a child CBB with a big-endian 24-bit length prefix in the parent.
requirements: Same constraints as CBB_add_u8_length_prefixed.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBB_add_asn1
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int CBB_add_asn1(CBB *cbb, CBB *out_contents, CBS_ASN1_TAG tag)
functions.description: Creates a child CBB for writing the contents of an ASN.1 element with the given tag into the parent.
requirements: cbb must be initialized and have no conflicting active child.
out_contents must be non-NULL and becomes active until flushed/finished.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBB_add_bytes
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int CBB_add_bytes(CBB *cbb, const uint8_t *data, size_t len)
functions.description: Appends len bytes from data to the CBB.
requirements: cbb must be initialized.
If cbb is fixed-capacity, len must not exceed remaining capacity.
data must point to at least len bytes (if len>0).
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBB_add_zeros
functions.description: Appends len zero bytes to the CBB.
requirements: cbb must be initialized.
If fixed-capacity, sufficient space must remain.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBB_add_space
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int CBB_add_space(CBB *cbb, uint8_t **out_data, size_t len)
functions.description: Appends len uninitialized bytes and returns a pointer to that space for the caller to fill immediately.
requirements: cbb must be initialized.
out_data must be non-NULL.
Caller must write exactly len bytes to *out_data before any further operations on cbb.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBB_reserve
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int CBB_reserve(CBB *cbb, uint8_t **out_data, size_t len)
functions.description: Ensures room for len additional bytes and returns a pointer to the start of that space for deferred completion with CBB_did_write.
requirements: cbb must be initialized.
out_data must be non-NULL.
Caller may write up to len bytes to *out_data and then must call CBB_did_write with the actual number written before further operations.
*out_data is valid until the next operation on cbb or any ancestor CBB.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBB_did_write
functions.description: Advances the CBB by len bytes after the caller has written to space obtained by CBB_reserve.
requirements: A prior successful CBB_reserve must have provided at least len bytes that have been written by the caller.
cbb must be initialized.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBB_add_u8
functions.description: Appends an 8-bit value.
requirements: cbb must be initialized.
If fixed-capacity, must have space.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBB_add_u16
functions.description: Appends a big-endian 16-bit value.
requirements: cbb must be initialized.
If fixed-capacity, must have space.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBB_add_u16le
functions.description: Appends a little-endian 16-bit value.
requirements: cbb must be initialized.
If fixed-capacity, must have space.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBB_add_u24
functions.description: Appends a big-endian 24-bit value.
requirements: cbb must be initialized.
value must fit in 24 bits (upper bits ignored by function semantics implied; caller should ensure correctness).
If fixed-capacity, must have space.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBB_add_u32
functions.description: Appends a big-endian 32-bit value.
requirements: cbb must be initialized.
If fixed-capacity, must have space.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBB_add_u32le
functions.description: Appends a little-endian 32-bit value.
requirements: cbb must be initialized.
If fixed-capacity, must have space.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBB_add_u64
functions.description: Appends a big-endian 64-bit value.
requirements: cbb must be initialized.
If fixed-capacity, must have space.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBB_add_u64le
functions.description: Appends a little-endian 64-bit value.
requirements: cbb must be initialized.
If fixed-capacity, must have space.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBB_discard
functions.description: Discards the last len bytes written to the CBB. Aborts the process if there is an unflushed child or the length is insufficient.
requirements: cbb must be initialized.
Must not have an unflushed child at the time of call.
len must be less than or equal to current length.

functions.name: CBB_discard_child
functions.description: Discards the current unflushed child of cbb; neither the child's contents nor its length prefix are included.
requirements: cbb must have a current unflushed child; otherwise behavior is to discard none.
After discarding, the child CBB becomes invalid.

functions.name: CBB_add_asn1_element
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int CBB_add_asn1_element(CBB *cbb, CBS_ASN1_TAG tag, const uint8_t *data, size_t data_len)
functions.description: Appends a complete ASN.1 element with the specified tag and provided contents. Convenience for when data is already available.
requirements: cbb must be initialized.
data must point to at least data_len bytes (if data_len>0).
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBB_add_asn1_uint64
functions.description: Encodes value as a DER INTEGER and appends it using CBB_add_asn1.
requirements: cbb must be initialized.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBB_add_asn1_uint64_with_tag
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int CBB_add_asn1_uint64_with_tag(CBB *cbb, uint64_t value, CBS_ASN1_TAG tag)
functions.description: Encodes value as a DER INTEGER but uses the provided tag (e.g., for implicit tagging).
requirements: cbb must be initialized.
tag must be appropriate for an implicitly-tagged INTEGER in the context.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBB_add_asn1_int64
functions.description: Encodes value as a DER INTEGER (signed) and appends it using CBB_add_asn1.
requirements: cbb must be initialized.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBB_add_asn1_int64_with_tag
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int CBB_add_asn1_int64_with_tag(CBB *cbb, int64_t value, CBS_ASN1_TAG tag)
functions.description: Encodes value as a DER INTEGER (signed) using the provided tag (e.g., for implicit tagging).
requirements: cbb must be initialized.
tag must be appropriate for an implicitly-tagged INTEGER in the context.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBB_add_asn1_octet_string
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int CBB_add_asn1_octet_string(CBB *cbb, const uint8_t *data, size_t data_len)
functions.description: Encodes and appends an ASN.1 OCTET STRING with the given contents.
requirements: cbb must be initialized.
data must point to at least data_len bytes (if data_len>0).
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBB_add_asn1_bool
functions.description: Encodes and appends an ASN.1 BOOLEAN which is true iff value is non-zero.
requirements: cbb must be initialized.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBB_add_asn1_oid_from_text
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int CBB_add_asn1_oid_from_text(CBB *cbb, const char *text, size_t len)
functions.description: Parses an ASCII dotted-decimal OID string and appends its DER-encoded contents (no tag/length). Rejects components that do not fit in uint64_t.
requirements: cbb must be initialized.
text must point to len bytes of a valid OID string in ASCII (e.g., "1.2.3").
Returns 1 on success, 0 on invalid text or allocation failure.

functions.name: CBB_add_asn1_relative_oid_from_text
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int CBB_add_asn1_relative_oid_from_text(CBB *cbb, const char *text, size_t len)
functions.description: Parses an ASCII dotted-decimal RELATIVE-OID string and appends its DER-encoded contents (no framing). Rejects components that do not fit in uint64_t.
requirements: cbb must be initialized.
text must point to len bytes of a valid RELATIVE-OID string.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on invalid text or allocation failure.

functions.name: CBB_add_asn1_oid_component
functions.description: Appends a single OID component to the current OID contents being built.
requirements: cbb must be initialized and used in a context where OID contents are being assembled.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBB_flush_asn1_set_of
functions.description: Flushes pending children and reorders contents to canonical DER order for SET OF (lexicographic by encoding).
requirements: cbb must be initialized and contain SET OF elements not already known to be canonical.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure.

functions.name: CBS_get_utf8
functions.description: Reads one Unicode code point encoded in UTF-8 and stores it in out, advancing the CBS. Treats Unicode noncharacters as invalid.
requirements: cbs must contain a valid UTF-8 sequence for one code point.
out must be non-NULL.
Noncharacters and invalid encodings cause failure.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBS_get_latin1
functions.description: Reads one Latin-1 code unit as a Unicode code point and stores it in out, advancing the CBS. Noncharacters are invalid.
requirements: cbs must have at least 1 byte.
out must be non-NULL.
Returned code point must not be a Unicode noncharacter; such values cause failure.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBS_get_ucs2_be
functions.description: Reads one UCS-2 big-endian code unit as a Unicode code point and stores it in out, advancing the CBS. Noncharacters are invalid.
requirements: cbs must have at least 2 bytes.
out must be non-NULL.
Invalid code points or noncharacters cause failure.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBS_get_utf32_be
functions.description: Reads one UTF-32 big-endian code point and stores it in out, advancing the CBS. Noncharacters are invalid.
requirements: cbs must have at least 4 bytes.
out must be non-NULL.
Invalid code points or noncharacters cause failure.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBB_get_utf8_len
functions.description: Returns the number of bytes needed to encode code point u in UTF-8.
requirements: u must be a valid Unicode scalar value; otherwise behavior of length is based on encoding rules (use with CBB_add_utf8 which will validate).

functions.name: CBB_add_utf8
functions.description: Encodes code point u as UTF-8 and appends it. Fails if u is invalid or unencodable.
requirements: cbb must be initialized.
u must be a valid, encodable Unicode code point and not a noncharacter.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBB_add_latin1
functions.description: Encodes code point u in Latin-1 and appends it. Fails if u is invalid or not encodable in Latin-1.
requirements: cbb must be initialized.
u must be a valid code point representable in Latin-1 and not a noncharacter.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBB_add_ucs2_be
functions.description: Encodes code point u as UCS-2 big-endian and appends it. Fails if u is invalid or not encodable in UCS-2.
requirements: cbb must be initialized.
u must be a valid code point encodable in UCS-2 and not a noncharacter.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: CBB_add_utf32_be
functions.description: Encodes code point u as UTF-32 big-endian and appends it. Fails if u is invalid.
requirements: cbb must be initialized.
u must be a valid Unicode code point and not a noncharacter.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: EVP_aead_aes_128_gcm
functions.description: Returns the AEAD implementation for AES-128-GCM. Use with EVP_AEAD_CTX_init/EVP_AEAD_CTX_new to configure a context for sealing/opening. Notes warn that AES-GCM should only be used with 12-byte nonces in normal protocols.
requirements: Returned pointer must be passed to EVP_AEAD_CTX_init or EVP_AEAD_CTX_new before use.
Nonce length for operations must equal EVP_AEAD_nonce_length(aead). For GCM, typical length is 12 bytes (recommended).

functions.name: EVP_aead_aes_192_gcm
functions.description: Returns the AEAD implementation for AES-192-GCM. Provided primarily for interoperability; documentation warns against using AES-192 unless required.
requirements: Returned pointer must be used to initialize an EVP_AEAD_CTX.
Nonce length for operations must equal EVP_AEAD_nonce_length(aead). For GCM, typical length is 12 bytes (recommended).

functions.name: EVP_aead_aes_256_gcm
functions.description: Returns the AEAD implementation for AES-256-GCM.
requirements: Use the returned AEAD with EVP_AEAD_CTX_init/EVP_AEAD_CTX_new.
Nonce length for operations must equal EVP_AEAD_nonce_length(aead). For GCM, typical length is 12 bytes (recommended).

functions.name: EVP_aead_chacha20_poly1305
functions.description: Returns the AEAD implementation for ChaCha20-Poly1305 as per RFC 8439.
requirements: Use the returned AEAD to initialize EVP_AEAD_CTX before operations.
Nonce length for operations must equal EVP_AEAD_nonce_length(aead).

functions.name: EVP_aead_xchacha20_poly1305
functions.description: Returns the AEAD for XChaCha20-Poly1305 with an extended nonce, suitable for random nonces.
requirements: Initialize an EVP_AEAD_CTX with the returned AEAD before use.
Nonce length for operations must equal EVP_AEAD_nonce_length(aead).

functions.name: EVP_aead_aes_128_ctr_hmac_sha256
functions.description: Returns the AEAD for AES-128-CTR with HMAC-SHA256 authentication. Uses 12-byte nonces; bottom 32 bits are the block counter; maximum plaintext size is 64GB.
requirements: Initialize an EVP_AEAD_CTX before use.
Nonce length must equal EVP_AEAD_nonce_length(aead) (12 bytes per notes).
Do not encrypt more than 64GB of plaintext per message due to 32-bit counter.

functions.name: EVP_aead_aes_256_ctr_hmac_sha256
functions.description: Returns the AEAD for AES-256-CTR with HMAC-SHA256 authentication. Same behavior and limits as the 128-bit key variant.
requirements: Initialize an EVP_AEAD_CTX before use.
Nonce length must equal EVP_AEAD_nonce_length(aead) (12 bytes per notes).
Do not encrypt more than 64GB of plaintext per message due to 32-bit counter.

functions.name: EVP_aead_aes_128_gcm_siv
functions.description: Returns the AEAD for AES-128 GCM-SIV (RFC 8452).
requirements: Initialize an EVP_AEAD_CTX before use.
Nonce length must equal EVP_AEAD_nonce_length(aead).

functions.name: EVP_aead_aes_256_gcm_siv
functions.description: Returns the AEAD for AES-256 GCM-SIV (RFC 8452).
requirements: Initialize an EVP_AEAD_CTX before use.
Nonce length must equal EVP_AEAD_nonce_length(aead).

functions.name: EVP_aead_aes_128_gcm_randnonce
functions.description: Returns AES-128-GCM with internal random nonce generation. The 12-byte nonce is appended to the tag, making the API-visible tag 12 bytes larger. Intended for FIPS compliance scenarios.
requirements: When using this AEAD, the nonce parameter to seal/open must be zero-length.
Do not use a single key for more than 2^32 seal operations (nonce is random).
Initialize EVP_AEAD_CTX before use.

functions.name: EVP_aead_aes_256_gcm_randnonce
functions.description: Returns AES-256-GCM with internal random nonce generation. The 12-byte nonce is appended to the tag and generated internally. Intended for FIPS compliance scenarios.
requirements: Nonce parameter to operations must be zero-length.
Do not use a single key for more than 2^32 seal operations.
Initialize EVP_AEAD_CTX before use.

functions.name: EVP_aead_aes_128_ccm_bluetooth
functions.description: Returns AES-128-CCM configured for Bluetooth (M=4 tag, L=2; 4-byte tags and 13-byte nonces).
requirements: Initialize EVP_AEAD_CTX before use.
Nonce length must equal EVP_AEAD_nonce_length(aead) (13 bytes per notes).

functions.name: EVP_aead_aes_128_ccm_bluetooth_8
functions.description: Returns AES-128-CCM configured for Bluetooth Mesh (M=8, L=2; 8-byte tags and 13-byte nonces).
requirements: Initialize EVP_AEAD_CTX before use.
Nonce length must equal EVP_AEAD_nonce_length(aead) (13 bytes per notes).

functions.name: EVP_aead_aes_128_ccm_matter
functions.description: Returns AES-128-CCM configured for Matter (M=16, L=2; 16-byte tags and 13-byte nonces).
requirements: Initialize EVP_AEAD_CTX before use.
Nonce length must equal EVP_AEAD_nonce_length(aead) (13 bytes per notes).

functions.name: EVP_has_aes_hardware
functions.description: Returns 1 if hardware support for fast and constant-time AES-GCM is enabled, otherwise 0.

functions.name: EVP_aead_aes_128_eax
functions.description: Returns the AEAD for AES-128 in EAX mode. Nonce size is either 12 or 16 bytes; tag length is 16 bytes.
requirements: Initialize an EVP_AEAD_CTX before use.
Nonce length must equal EVP_AEAD_nonce_length(aead) (12 or 16 bytes per notes).

functions.name: EVP_aead_aes_256_eax
functions.description: Returns the AEAD for AES-256 in EAX mode. Nonce size is either 12 or 16 bytes; tag length is 16 bytes.
requirements: Initialize an EVP_AEAD_CTX before use.
Nonce length must equal EVP_AEAD_nonce_length(aead) (12 or 16 bytes per notes).

functions.name: EVP_AEAD_key_length
functions.description: Returns the key length in bytes for the given AEAD.
requirements: Parameter aead must be a valid AEAD pointer returned by an EVP_aead_* function.

functions.name: EVP_AEAD_nonce_length
functions.description: Returns the required per-message nonce length in bytes for the given AEAD.
requirements: Parameter aead must be a valid AEAD pointer returned by an EVP_aead_* function.

functions.name: EVP_AEAD_max_overhead
functions.description: Returns the maximum number of additional bytes added when sealing with the given AEAD.
requirements: Parameter aead must be a valid AEAD pointer returned by an EVP_aead_* function.

functions.name: EVP_AEAD_max_tag_len
functions.description: Returns the maximum tag length for the AEAD; the largest permissible tag_len to EVP_AEAD_CTX_init.
requirements: Parameter aead must be a valid AEAD pointer returned by an EVP_aead_* function.

functions.name: EVP_AEAD_CTX_zero
functions.description: Sets an uninitialized EVP_AEAD_CTX to the zero state. Safe (but not required) to subsequently call EVP_AEAD_CTX_cleanup. Use before EVP_AEAD_CTX_init for uniform cleanup patterns.
requirements: ctx must point to an EVP_AEAD_CTX to be zeroed. It must be initialized with EVP_AEAD_CTX_init before use for encryption/decryption.

functions.name: EVP_AEAD_CTX_new
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT EVP_AEAD_CTX *EVP_AEAD_CTX_new(const EVP_AEAD *aead, const uint8_t *key, size_t key_len, size_t tag_len);
functions.description: Allocates a new EVP_AEAD_CTX, initializes it with the given AEAD, key, and tag length, and returns the context or NULL on error.
requirements: aead must be a valid AEAD algorithm pointer.
key must point to at least key_len bytes; key_len must match EVP_AEAD_key_length(aead).
tag_len of zero selects the default (EVP_AEAD_DEFAULT_TAG_LENGTH); otherwise must be a valid tag length for the AEAD.
Caller must free the result with EVP_AEAD_CTX_free.

functions.name: EVP_AEAD_CTX_free
functions.description: Calls EVP_AEAD_CTX_cleanup and OPENSSL_free on the given context.
requirements: ctx may be NULL or a pointer returned by EVP_AEAD_CTX_new. After this call, ctx must not be used.

functions.name: EVP_AEAD_CTX_init
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_AEAD_CTX_init(EVP_AEAD_CTX *ctx, const EVP_AEAD *aead, const uint8_t *key, size_t key_len, size_t tag_len, ENGINE *impl);
functions.description: Initializes an EVP_AEAD_CTX for the given AEAD algorithm and key. The impl argument is ignored and should be NULL. Supports optional tag truncation via tag_len (0 selects default). Returns 1 on success, 0 on error (and may push to error stack).
requirements: ctx must be non-NULL and will be initialized by this call.
aead must be a valid AEAD pointer.
key must point to at least key_len bytes; key_len must match EVP_AEAD_key_length(aead).
tag_len of zero selects the default; otherwise must be within AEAD’s supported tag lengths (<= EVP_AEAD_max_tag_len(aead)).
impl should be NULL.
On failure, it is not required to call EVP_AEAD_CTX_cleanup, but it is safe to do so before reuse.

functions.name: EVP_AEAD_CTX_cleanup
functions.description: Frees any data allocated by the context. It is a no-op to call this on a context that has been memset to all zeros.
requirements: ctx must be an EVP_AEAD_CTX previously initialized or zeroed.
After cleanup, the context must be reinitialized before reuse.

functions.name: EVP_AEAD_CTX_seal
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_AEAD_CTX_seal(const EVP_AEAD_CTX *ctx, uint8_t *out, size_t *out_len, size_t max_out_len, const uint8_t *nonce, size_t nonce_len, const uint8_t *in, size_t in_len, const uint8_t *ad, size_t ad_len);
functions.description: Encrypts and authenticates input and optional additional data, writing ciphertext+tag to out. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error. Operation is atomic and may be called concurrently across the same context.
requirements: ctx must be initialized with EVP_AEAD_CTX_init/EVP_AEAD_CTX_new.
nonce_len must equal EVP_AEAD_nonce_length(EVP_AEAD_CTX_aead(ctx)).
Nonces must be unique per key for security (critical requirement).
max_out_len should be at least in_len + EVP_AEAD_max_overhead(aead) to ensure success.
On success, *out_len is set to bytes written; on any error, out is zeroed and *out_len set to zero.
If in and out alias, they must be exactly the same pointer; otherwise overlapping aliasing is an error.
May be used concurrently with other seal/open calls on the same ctx.

functions.name: EVP_AEAD_CTX_open
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_AEAD_CTX_open(const EVP_AEAD_CTX *ctx, uint8_t *out, size_t *out_len, size_t max_out_len, const uint8_t *nonce, size_t nonce_len, const uint8_t *in, size_t in_len, const uint8_t *ad, size_t ad_len);
functions.description: Authenticates and decrypts input and additional data, writing plaintext to out. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error. Operation is atomic and may be called concurrently across the same context.
requirements: ctx must be initialized.
nonce_len must equal EVP_AEAD_nonce_length(aead).
max_out_len should be at least in_len.
On success, *out_len is set; on error, out is zeroed and *out_len set to zero.
If in and out alias, they must be the same pointer.
May be called concurrently with other seal/open operations on the same ctx.

functions.name: EVP_AEAD_CTX_seal_scatter
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_AEAD_CTX_seal_scatter(const EVP_AEAD_CTX *ctx, uint8_t *out, uint8_t *out_tag, size_t *out_tag_len, size_t max_out_tag_len, const uint8_t *nonce, size_t nonce_len, const uint8_t *in, size_t in_len, const uint8_t *extra_in, size_t extra_in_len, const uint8_t *ad, size_t ad_len);
functions.description: Encrypts/authenticates input, writing exactly in_len bytes of ciphertext to out and the tag (and optional extra_in ciphertext) to out_tag. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.
requirements: ctx must be initialized.
nonce_len must equal EVP_AEAD_nonce_length(aead).
Exactly in_len bytes are written to out; up to EVP_AEAD_max_overhead(aead)+extra_in_len bytes to out_tag.
If extra_in is provided, extra_in_len plaintext bytes are encrypted and written to out_tag before the tag; max_out_tag_len must allow for these bytes.
On success, *out_tag_len is set. On error, out and out_tag are zeroed and *out_tag_len set to zero.
If in and out alias, they must be the same pointer. out_tag must not alias any other argument.
May be called concurrently with other seal/open calls.

functions.name: EVP_AEAD_CTX_open_gather
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_AEAD_CTX_open_gather(const EVP_AEAD_CTX *ctx, uint8_t *out, const uint8_t *nonce, size_t nonce_len, const uint8_t *in, size_t in_len, const uint8_t *in_tag, size_t in_tag_len, const uint8_t *ad, size_t ad_len);
functions.description: Authenticates and decrypts ciphertext from in with a detached tag from in_tag, writing exactly in_len bytes of plaintext to out. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.
requirements: ctx must be initialized.
nonce_len must equal EVP_AEAD_nonce_length(aead).
If in and out alias, they must be the same pointer.
On any error, out is filled with zero bytes.
May be called concurrently with other seal/open calls.

functions.name: EVP_AEAD_CTX_sealv
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_AEAD_CTX_sealv(const EVP_AEAD_CTX *ctx, const CRYPTO_IOVEC *iovec, size_t num_iovec, uint8_t *out_tag, size_t *out_tag_len, size_t max_out_tag_len, const uint8_t *nonce, size_t nonce_len, const CRYPTO_IVEC *aadvec, size_t num_aadvec);
functions.description: Vectorized seal API (preview). Encrypts/authenticates concatenated iovec plaintext and aadvec AAD, writing ciphertext in-place to each iovec.out and the tag (and any AEAD-specific overhead) to out_tag. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error. Same output as seal_scatter for equivalent inputs.
requirements: ctx must be initialized.
num_iovec and num_aadvec must be <= CRYPTO_IOVEC_MAX.
Exactly the sum of iovec lengths is written across the iovec.out buffers; up to EVP_AEAD_max_overhead(aead)+extra_in_len bytes may be written to out_tag (per comments mapping to seal_scatter).
nonce_len must equal EVP_AEAD_nonce_length(aead).
On success, *out_tag_len is set; on error, all iovec.out and out_tag are zeroed and *out_tag_len set to zero.
No output pointer (including those in iovec and aadvec) may alias any other pointer except that an iovec entry’s in and out may be equal for in-place operation.
This API is preview: not all AEADs support it or may be slow.

functions.name: EVP_AEAD_CTX_openv
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_AEAD_CTX_openv(const EVP_AEAD_CTX *ctx, const CRYPTO_IOVEC *iovec, size_t num_iovec, size_t *out_total_bytes, const uint8_t *nonce, size_t nonce_len, const CRYPTO_IVEC *aadvec, size_t num_aadvec);
functions.description: Vectorized open API (preview). Authenticates/decrypts concatenated iovec input and aadvec AAD, writing plaintext into iovec.out. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error. May output less than total input length; out_total_bytes is set to actual bytes written.
requirements: ctx must be initialized.
num_iovec and num_aadvec must be <= CRYPTO_IOVEC_MAX.
nonce_len must equal EVP_AEAD_nonce_length(aead).
On error, all output is zeroed and *out_total_bytes is set to zero.
No output pointer may alias any other pointer except that an iovec entry’s in and out may be equal for in-place operation.
For AEADs with fixed tag lengths, treat the tag as appended to ciphertext or use EVP_AEAD_CTX_openv_detached for detached tags.
This API is preview: not all AEADs support it or may be slow.

functions.name: EVP_AEAD_CTX_openv_detached
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_AEAD_CTX_openv_detached(const EVP_AEAD_CTX *ctx, const CRYPTO_IOVEC *iovec, size_t num_iovec, const uint8_t *nonce, size_t nonce_len, const uint8_t *in_tag, size_t in_tag_len, const CRYPTO_IVEC *aadvec, size_t num_aadvec);
functions.description: Vectorized open API with detached tag (preview). Authenticates concatenated iovec input and aadvec AAD using in_tag/in_tag_len, writing plaintext into iovec.out. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error. Only usable with AEADs that have fixed-length overhead (variable-overhead AEADs will return 0).
requirements: ctx must be initialized.
num_iovec and num_aadvec must be <= CRYPTO_IOVEC_MAX.
nonce_len must equal EVP_AEAD_nonce_length(aead).
If the AEAD has variable-length overhead, this function returns 0; such AEADs must use EVP_AEAD_CTX_openv.
On error, output is zeroed.
No output pointer may alias any other pointer except that an iovec entry’s in and out may be equal for in-place operation.
This API is preview: not all AEADs support it or may be slow.

functions.name: EVP_AEAD_CTX_aead
functions.description: Returns the underlying AEAD associated with the context, or NULL if none has been set.
requirements: ctx must be a valid pointer; returns NULL if no AEAD set.

functions.name: EVP_aead_aes_128_cbc_sha1_tls
functions.description: Returns the TLS-specific AEAD for AES-128-CBC with SHA-1 MAC (TLS). These AEADs are stateful, TLS-specific, and must not be used outside TLS.
requirements: Must be initialized with EVP_AEAD_CTX_init_with_direction (not the generic init).
Are stateful and may not be used concurrently.
Any nonces are IVs and must be unpredictable.
Only accept ad parameters of length 11 (TLS AAD without length).

functions.name: EVP_aead_aes_128_cbc_sha1_tls_implicit_iv
functions.description: Returns the TLS-specific AEAD for AES-128-CBC with SHA-1 MAC using implicit IV (TLS 1.0 behavior).
requirements: Must be initialized with EVP_AEAD_CTX_init_with_direction.
Stateful; may not be used concurrently.
IVs (nonces) must be unpredictable.
ad length must be exactly 11 bytes.

functions.name: EVP_aead_aes_128_cbc_sha256_tls
functions.description: Returns the TLS-specific AEAD for AES-128-CBC with SHA-256 MAC.
requirements: Must be initialized with EVP_AEAD_CTX_init_with_direction.
Stateful; may not be used concurrently.
IVs must be unpredictable.
ad length must be exactly 11 bytes.

functions.name: EVP_aead_aes_256_cbc_sha1_tls
functions.description: Returns the TLS-specific AEAD for AES-256-CBC with SHA-1 MAC.
requirements: Must be initialized with EVP_AEAD_CTX_init_with_direction.
Stateful; may not be used concurrently.
IVs must be unpredictable.
ad length must be exactly 11 bytes.

functions.name: EVP_aead_aes_256_cbc_sha1_tls_implicit_iv
functions.description: Returns the TLS-specific AEAD for AES-256-CBC with SHA-1 MAC using implicit IV (TLS 1.0 behavior).
requirements: Must be initialized with EVP_AEAD_CTX_init_with_direction.
Stateful; may not be used concurrently.
IVs must be unpredictable.
ad length must be exactly 11 bytes.

functions.name: EVP_aead_des_ede3_cbc_sha1_tls
functions.description: Returns the TLS-specific AEAD for 3DES-EDE-CBC with SHA-1 MAC.
requirements: Must be initialized with EVP_AEAD_CTX_init_with_direction.
Stateful; may not be used concurrently.
IVs must be unpredictable.
ad length must be exactly 11 bytes.

functions.name: EVP_aead_des_ede3_cbc_sha1_tls_implicit_iv
functions.description: Returns the TLS-specific AEAD for 3DES-EDE-CBC with SHA-1 MAC using implicit IV (TLS 1.0 behavior).
requirements: Must be initialized with EVP_AEAD_CTX_init_with_direction.
Stateful; may not be used concurrently.
IVs must be unpredictable.
ad length must be exactly 11 bytes.

functions.name: EVP_aead_aes_128_gcm_tls12
functions.description: Returns AES-128-GCM configured for TLS 1.2 nonce construction (TLS-specific AEAD).
requirements: Must be initialized with EVP_AEAD_CTX_init_with_direction.
Stateful; may not be used concurrently.
Any nonces are IVs and must be unpredictable.
ad length must be exactly 11 bytes.

functions.name: EVP_aead_aes_256_gcm_tls12
functions.description: Returns AES-256-GCM configured for TLS 1.2 nonce construction (TLS-specific AEAD).
requirements: Must be initialized with EVP_AEAD_CTX_init_with_direction.
Stateful; may not be used concurrently.
Nonces are IVs and must be unpredictable.
ad length must be exactly 11 bytes.

functions.name: EVP_aead_aes_128_gcm_tls13
functions.description: Returns AES-128-GCM configured for TLS 1.3 nonce construction (TLS-specific AEAD).
requirements: Must be initialized with EVP_AEAD_CTX_init_with_direction.
Stateful; may not be used concurrently.
Nonces are IVs and must be unpredictable.
ad length must be exactly 11 bytes.

functions.name: EVP_aead_aes_256_gcm_tls13
functions.description: Returns AES-256-GCM configured for TLS 1.3 nonce construction (TLS-specific AEAD).
requirements: Must be initialized with EVP_AEAD_CTX_init_with_direction.
Stateful; may not be used concurrently.
Nonces are IVs and must be unpredictable.
ad length must be exactly 11 bytes.

functions.name: EVP_AEAD_CTX_init_with_direction
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_AEAD_CTX_init_with_direction(EVP_AEAD_CTX *ctx, const EVP_AEAD *aead, const uint8_t *key, size_t key_len, size_t tag_len, enum evp_aead_direction_t dir);
functions.description: Initializes an EVP_AEAD_CTX like EVP_AEAD_CTX_init for normal AEADs, and selects a direction for TLS/SSL3-specific AEADs. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.
requirements: ctx must be non-NULL.
aead must be a valid AEAD pointer (including TLS-specific ones).
key must point to at least key_len bytes; key_len must match EVP_AEAD_key_length(aead).
tag_len semantics same as EVP_AEAD_CTX_init (0 for default).
dir must be evp_aead_open or evp_aead_seal and is required for TLS/SSL3-specific AEADs.

functions.name: EVP_AEAD_CTX_get_iv
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_AEAD_CTX_get_iv(const EVP_AEAD_CTX *ctx, const uint8_t **out_iv, size_t *out_len);
functions.description: For AEADs with implicit IVs (e.g., TLS 1.0 CBC), sets *out_len to the IV length and *out_iv to point to the current IV bytes. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.
requirements: Only meaningful for implicit-IV AEADs; for others may return error.
out_iv and out_len must be valid pointers to receive results.
ctx must be initialized.

functions.name: EVP_AEAD_CTX_tag_len
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_AEAD_CTX_tag_len(const EVP_AEAD_CTX *ctx, size_t *out_tag_len, const size_t in_len, const size_t extra_in_len);
functions.description: Computes the exact tag length for a seal_scatter operation with the specified in_len and extra_in_len and writes it to *out_tag_len. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.
requirements: ctx must be initialized.
in_len and extra_in_len must match the values to be used with EVP_AEAD_CTX_seal_scatter.
out_tag_len must be a valid pointer to receive the result.

functions.name: AES_set_encrypt_key
functions.signature: int AES_set_encrypt_key(const uint8_t *key, unsigned bits, AES_KEY *aeskey)
functions.description: Initializes an AES_KEY for encryption using the provided key material. Pass a key of bits/8 bytes and a valid AES key size (typically 128, 192, or 256 bits). Returns 0 on success and a negative value if bits is invalid. Note: This function uses an atypical return convention (0 = success).
requirements: key must point to at least bits/8 bytes.
bits must be a valid AES key size; otherwise the function returns a negative value. Typical valid values: 128, 192, 256.
aeskey must be a valid, writable AES_KEY pointer.
On success the caller may use aeskey with AES_encrypt and other encrypting modes.
Return convention is inverted compared to many C APIs: 0 indicates success; negative indicates error.

functions.name: AES_set_decrypt_key
functions.signature: int AES_set_decrypt_key(const uint8_t *key, unsigned bits, AES_KEY *aeskey)
functions.description: Initializes an AES_KEY for decryption using the provided key material. Pass a key of bits/8 bytes and a valid AES key size (typically 128, 192, or 256 bits). Returns 0 on success and a negative value if bits is invalid. Note: This function uses an atypical return convention (0 = success).
requirements: key must point to at least bits/8 bytes.
bits must be a valid AES key size; otherwise the function returns a negative value. Typical valid values: 128, 192, 256.
aeskey must be a valid, writable AES_KEY pointer.
On success the caller may use aeskey with AES_decrypt and other decrypting modes.
Return convention is inverted compared to many C APIs: 0 indicates success; negative indicates error.

functions.name: AES_encrypt
functions.signature: void AES_encrypt(const uint8_t *in, uint8_t *out, const AES_KEY *key)
functions.description: Encrypts a single 16-byte block from in to out using the provided AES encryption key schedule. in and out may alias (overlap). Intended for low-level single-block operations; for larger inputs use a mode function.
requirements: in must point to at least 16 bytes (AES_BLOCK_SIZE).
out must point to at least 16 bytes (AES_BLOCK_SIZE).
key must be a valid AES_KEY configured for encryption (typically via AES_set_encrypt_key).
in and out may overlap; no restriction on aliasing.

functions.name: AES_decrypt
functions.signature: void AES_decrypt(const uint8_t *in, uint8_t *out, const AES_KEY *key)
functions.description: Decrypts a single 16-byte block from in to out using the provided AES decryption key schedule. in and out may alias (overlap). Intended for low-level single-block operations; for larger inputs use a mode function.
requirements: in must point to at least 16 bytes (AES_BLOCK_SIZE).
out must point to at least 16 bytes (AES_BLOCK_SIZE).
key must be a valid AES_KEY configured for decryption (typically via AES_set_decrypt_key).
in and out may overlap; no restriction on aliasing.

functions.name: AES_ctr128_encrypt
functions.signature: void AES_ctr128_encrypt(const uint8_t *in, uint8_t *out, size_t len, const AES_KEY *key, uint8_t ivec[AES_BLOCK_SIZE], uint8_t ecount_buf[AES_BLOCK_SIZE], unsigned int *num)
functions.description: Encrypts or decrypts len bytes using AES in CTR mode from in to out. CTR mode is symmetric for encryption and decryption. The counter in ivec will be incremented as bytes are processed. Supports streaming across multiple calls using ecount_buf and num.
requirements: in must point to at least len bytes unless in == out for in-place operation.
out must point to at least len bytes.
Either in == out (in-place) or the input and output buffers must not partially overlap (no partial overlap allowed).
key must be a valid AES_KEY configured for encryption (CTR uses the encryption transform).
ivec must point to a 16-byte counter/IV buffer (AES_BLOCK_SIZE) and will be updated (incremented).
ecount_buf must point to a 16-byte buffer used internally and preserved across calls.
num must be non-NULL; it must be set to 0 on the first call for a given ivec/ecount_buf state and preserved across subsequent calls.
len may be any size (including non-multiple of block size).

functions.name: AES_ecb_encrypt
functions.signature: void AES_ecb_encrypt(const uint8_t *in, uint8_t *out, const AES_KEY *key, const int enc)
functions.description: Encrypts or decrypts a single 16-byte block using AES in ECB mode. If enc == AES_DECRYPT, it decrypts; otherwise it encrypts. in and out may alias (in-place allowed), but partial overlaps other than complete aliasing are not permitted.
requirements: in must point to at least 16 bytes (AES_BLOCK_SIZE).
out must point to at least 16 bytes (AES_BLOCK_SIZE).
Either in == out (in-place) or the input and output buffers must not partially overlap.
key must be a valid AES_KEY configured for encryption when enc == AES_ENCRYPT and for decryption when enc == AES_DECRYPT (inferred from typical usage).
enc must be either AES_ENCRYPT or AES_DECRYPT.

functions.name: AES_cbc_encrypt
functions.signature: void AES_cbc_encrypt(const uint8_t *in, uint8_t *out, size_t len, const AES_KEY *key, uint8_t *ivec, const int enc)
functions.description: Encrypts or decrypts len bytes using AES in CBC mode. If enc == AES_DECRYPT, it decrypts; otherwise it encrypts. Supports in-place operation when in == out; otherwise buffers must not partially overlap.
requirements: len must be a multiple of 16 (AES_BLOCK_SIZE).
in must point to at least len bytes unless in == out for in-place operation.
out must point to at least len bytes.
Either in == out (in-place) or the input and output buffers must not partially overlap.
key must be a valid AES_KEY configured for encryption when enc == AES_ENCRYPT and for decryption when enc == AES_DECRYPT (inferred).
ivec must point to a 16-byte IV buffer (AES_BLOCK_SIZE) and will be updated across the operation.
enc must be either AES_ENCRYPT or AES_DECRYPT.

functions.name: AES_ofb128_encrypt
functions.signature: void AES_ofb128_encrypt(const uint8_t *in, uint8_t *out, size_t len, const AES_KEY *key, uint8_t *ivec, int *num)
functions.description: Encrypts or decrypts len bytes using AES in OFB mode. OFB mode uses the encryption transform for both directions. Supports streaming across multiple calls using ivec and num.
requirements: in must point to at least len bytes unless in == out for in-place operation.
out must point to at least len bytes.
Either in == out (in-place) or the input and output buffers must not partially overlap.
key must be a valid AES_KEY configured for encryption (OFB uses the encryption transform).
ivec must point to a 16-byte IV buffer (AES_BLOCK_SIZE) and will be updated across calls.
num must be non-NULL; it must be set to 0 on the first call for a given ivec and preserved across subsequent calls.
len may be any size (including non-multiple of block size).

functions.name: AES_cfb128_encrypt
functions.signature: void AES_cfb128_encrypt(const uint8_t *in, uint8_t *out, size_t len, const AES_KEY *key, uint8_t *ivec, int *num, int enc)
functions.description: Encrypts or decrypts len bytes using AES in CFB-128 mode. If enc == AES_DECRYPT, it decrypts; otherwise it encrypts. Supports streaming across multiple calls via ivec and num.
requirements: in must point to at least len bytes unless in == out for in-place operation.
out must point to at least len bytes.
Either in == out (in-place) or the input and output buffers must not partially overlap.

key must be a valid AES_KEY configured for encryption when enc == AES_ENCRYPT and for decryption when enc == AES_DECRYPT (inferred from typical usage; CFB typically uses the encryption transform for both directions but the API accepts enc).
ivec must point to a 16-byte IV buffer (AES_BLOCK_SIZE) and will be updated across calls.
num must be non-NULL; it must be set to 0 on the first call for a given ivec and preserved across subsequent calls.
enc must be either AES_ENCRYPT or AES_DECRYPT.
len may be any size (including non-multiple of block size).

functions.name: AES_wrap_key
functions.signature: int AES_wrap_key(const AES_KEY *key, const uint8_t *iv, uint8_t *out, const uint8_t *in, size_t in_len)
functions.description: Wraps (encrypts) key material using AES Key Wrap (RFC 3394). Input must be a multiple of 8 bytes. If iv is NULL, the default IV is used; otherwise iv must be 8 bytes. key must be configured for encryption. On success writes in_len + 8 bytes to out and returns in_len + 8; on failure returns -1.
requirements: in_len must be a multiple of 8 bytes.
in must point to at least in_len bytes.
out must point to at least in_len + 8 bytes.
key must be a valid AES_KEY configured for encryption.
iv, if non-NULL, must point to exactly 8 bytes; if NULL, the default IV is used.
Return value handling: >=0 indicates success (exact size written); -1 indicates failure.

functions.name: AES_unwrap_key
functions.signature: int AES_unwrap_key(const AES_KEY *key, const uint8_t *iv, uint8_t *out, const uint8_t *in, size_t in_len)
functions.description: Unwraps (decrypts) key material using AES Key Wrap (RFC 3394). Input must be a multiple of 8 bytes. If iv is NULL, the default IV is used; otherwise iv must be 8 bytes. key must be configured for decryption. On success writes in_len - 8 bytes to out and returns in_len - 8; on failure returns -1.
requirements: in_len must be a multiple of 8 bytes.
in must point to at least in_len bytes (ciphertext).
out must point to at least in_len - 8 bytes (for plaintext).
key must be a valid AES_KEY configured for decryption.
iv, if non-NULL, must point to exactly 8 bytes; if NULL, the default IV is used.
Return value handling: >=0 indicates success (exact size written); -1 indicates failure.

functions.name: AES_wrap_key_padded
functions.signature: int AES_wrap_key_padded(const AES_KEY *key, uint8_t *out, size_t *out_len, size_t max_out, const uint8_t *in, size_t in_len)
functions.description: Wraps (encrypts) key material using AES Key Wrap with Padding (RFC 5649). Input length must be between 1 and 2^32-1 bytes. key must be configured for encryption. On success, writes ciphertext to out (at most max_out bytes), sets *out_len to the number of bytes written, and returns 1. On failure, returns 0. To guarantee success, set max_out >= in_len + 15.
requirements: in_len must be between 1 and 2^32-1 bytes (inclusive).
in must point to at least in_len bytes.
out must point to a buffer of size at least max_out bytes; to ensure success, max_out must be at least in_len + 15.
out_len must be a valid writable pointer; on success it is set to the number of bytes written.
key must be a valid AES_KEY configured for encryption.
Return value handling: 1 indicates success; 0 indicates failure.

functions.name: AES_unwrap_key_padded
functions.signature: int AES_unwrap_key_padded(const AES_KEY *key, uint8_t *out, size_t *out_len, size_t max_out, const uint8_t *in, size_t in_len)
functions.description: Unwraps (decrypts) key material using AES Key Wrap with Padding (RFC 5649). Input length must be a multiple of 8 bytes. key must be configured for decryption. On success, writes plaintext to out (at most max_out bytes), sets *out_len to the number of bytes written, and returns 1. On failure, returns 0. A reasonable estimate for max_out is in_len.
requirements: in_len must be a multiple of 8 bytes.
in must point to at least in_len bytes (ciphertext).
out must point to a buffer of size at least max_out bytes; a reasonable estimate is max_out == in_len.
out_len must be a valid writable pointer; on success it is set to the number of bytes written.
key must be a valid AES_KEY configured for decryption.
Return value handling: 1 indicates success; 0 indicates failure.

functions.name: ASN1_tag2bit
functions.description: Converts a universal ASN.1 tag number to its corresponding B_ASN1_* bitmask value, or zero if the tag has no bitmask representation. Used to map tag numbers (e.g., V_ASN1_UTF8STRING) into selection masks.
requirements: tag must be a universal tag number or a V_ASN1_NEG_* value; otherwise zero may be returned.
Return value is zero if there is no corresponding bitmask.

functions.name: ASN1_tag2str
functions.description: Returns a human-readable string for a universal ASN.1 tag number (or V_ASN1_NEG_*).
requirements: tag should be a universal tag number or V_ASN1_NEG_*.
Returned pointer is to a constant string; do not free.

functions.name: ASN1_item_new
functions.description: Allocates a new instance of the C type corresponding to the ASN1_ITEM it. Returns NULL on error. Not valid for items whose C type is ASN1_BOOLEAN.
requirements: it must refer to a valid ASN1_ITEM and not an item with C type ASN1_BOOLEAN.
Caller must free the returned object with ASN1_item_free or the type-specific free.
The returned pointer must be used consistently with it; miscasting is unsafe.

functions.name: ASN1_item_free
functions.description: Frees an object of the C type corresponding to it. Not valid for items whose C type is ASN1_BOOLEAN.
requirements: val must be a pointer to an object of the C type matching it (type-safety is the caller’s responsibility).
it must not correspond to ASN1_BOOLEAN.

functions.name: ASN1_item_d2i
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT ASN1_VALUE *ASN1_item_d2i(ASN1_VALUE **out, const unsigned char **inp, long len, const ASN1_ITEM *it);
functions.description: Parses up to len bytes at *inp as the ASN.1 type it (DER) and returns a newly-allocated value. On success advances *inp by the bytes consumed. If out is non-NULL, frees previous *out and updates it to the new value. Does not reject trailing data.
requirements: inp must point to a buffer with at most len bytes; function may not consume all (caller must check trailing data).
out may be NULL; if non-NULL, previous *out is freed before update (not in-place).
it must not be ASN1_BOOLEAN.
Returned pointer must be treated as the correct C type for it; miscasting is unsafe.

functions.name: ASN1_item_i2d
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int ASN1_item_i2d(ASN1_VALUE *val, unsigned char **outp, const ASN1_ITEM *it);
functions.description: Serializes val as the ASN.1 type it in DER. Follows i2d_SAMPLE output buffer conventions (size-only, allocate, or write-into-provided-buffer). Not valid for items whose C type is ASN1_BOOLEAN.
requirements: val must point to an object of the C type matching it.
If outp and *outp are non-NULL, the caller must ensure sufficient buffer space; function does not check bounds.
If outp is non-NULL and *outp is NULL, the function allocates a buffer which must be freed with OPENSSL_free.
it must not correspond to ASN1_BOOLEAN.
Returns negative on error.

functions.name: ASN1_item_dup
functions.description: Creates a newly-allocated copy of x of the ASN.1 type it. Returns NULL on error. Not valid for items whose C type is ASN1_BOOLEAN.
requirements: x must be a pointer to an object of the C type matching it.
it must not correspond to ASN1_BOOLEAN.
Returned pointer must be used as the correct C type for it.

functions.name: ASN1_item_d2i_fp
functions.description: Parses it from a FILE* stream, like ASN1_item_d2i but reading from in. out plays the same role as in ASN1_item_d2i (void* form).
requirements: Reading is unbounded; do not use with untrusted inputs as it can consume unbounded memory.
it must not correspond to ASN1_BOOLEAN.
out may be NULL or a pointer to a same-type object; previous value may be freed and replaced.

functions.name: ASN1_item_d2i_bio
functions.description: Parses it from a BIO, like ASN1_item_d2i_fp but reading from BIO.
requirements: Reading is unbounded; do not use with untrusted inputs as it can consume unbounded memory.
it must not correspond to ASN1_BOOLEAN.
out semantics same as ASN1_item_d2i.

functions.name: ASN1_item_i2d_fp
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int ASN1_item_i2d_fp(const ASN1_ITEM *it, FILE *out, const void *in);
functions.description: Serializes in of type it to a FILE* stream in DER, like ASN1_item_i2d but to FILE.
requirements: it must not correspond to ASN1_BOOLEAN.
in must be a pointer to an object of the C type matching it.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error (per i2d convention returns negative on error; header just declares int).

functions.name: ASN1_item_i2d_bio
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int ASN1_item_i2d_bio(const ASN1_ITEM *it, BIO *out, const void *in);
functions.description: Serializes in of type it to a BIO in DER, like ASN1_item_i2d but to BIO.
requirements: it must not correspond to ASN1_BOOLEAN.
in must be a pointer to an object of the C type matching it.

functions.name: ASN1_item_unpack
functions.description: Parses the contents of oct (an OCTET STRING-like container) as it’s ASN.1 type and returns a newly-allocated instance.
requirements: it must not correspond to ASN1_BOOLEAN.
Caller must ensure the returned pointer is used as the correct C type for it.
oct must contain the encoded DER value of it.

functions.name: ASN1_item_pack
functions.description: Serializes obj of type it into an ASN1_STRING. If out is NULL, returns a newly-allocated ASN1_STRING; if out non-NULL and *out NULL, sets *out; if both non-NULL, writes into *out and returns it.
requirements: obj must be a pointer to the C type matching it.
it must not correspond to ASN1_BOOLEAN.
If both out and *out are non-NULL, *out must be suitable to receive replacement; prior contents will be overwritten.

functions.name: d2i_ASN1_BOOLEAN
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT ASN1_BOOLEAN d2i_ASN1_BOOLEAN(ASN1_BOOLEAN *out, const unsigned char **inp, long len);
functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded ASN.1 BOOLEAN from up to len bytes at *inp. Advances *inp and returns the value (0 for FALSE, 0xff for TRUE). On error returns ASN1_BOOLEAN_NONE (-1). Writes to out if non-NULL.
requirements: Caller must check for trailing data separately if parsing a single element.
This d2i differs from pointer-typed ones: it returns the value directly, not a pointer.
out may be NULL or point to storage to receive the value.

functions.name: i2d_ASN1_BOOLEAN
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int i2d_ASN1_BOOLEAN(ASN1_BOOLEAN a, unsigned char **outp);
functions.description: Encodes a as DER BOOLEAN. Follows i2d_SAMPLE buffer rules.
requirements: If outp and *outp are non-NULL, ensure sufficient buffer; function advances *outp without bounds checks.
If outp is non-NULL and *outp is NULL, buffer is allocated and must be freed with OPENSSL_free.
Returns negative on error.

functions.name: ASN1_STRING_type_new
functions.description: Allocates an empty ASN1_STRING with the given type, or NULL on error.
requirements: type should be a valid V_ASN1_* value for a string-like type.

functions.name: ASN1_STRING_new
functions.description: Allocates an empty ASN1_STRING with an arbitrary type (unset). Prefer type-specific constructors when possible.

functions.name: ASN1_STRING_free
functions.description: Frees an ASN1_STRING and its contents.
requirements: str may be NULL (safe to free as per OpenSSL conventions).

functions.name: ASN1_STRING_copy
functions.description: Sets dst to a copy of str.
requirements: dst must be non-NULL and initialized ASN1_STRING.
str must be non-NULL.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: ASN1_STRING_dup
functions.description: Returns a newly-allocated copy of str, or NULL on error.
requirements: str must be non-NULL.

functions.name: ASN1_STRING_type
functions.description: Returns the V_ASN1_* type of the ASN1_STRING.
requirements: str must be non-NULL.

functions.name: ASN1_STRING_get0_data
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the internal contents of str. May contain embedded NULs and not be NUL-terminated.
requirements: Use ASN1_STRING_length to get length.
Do not modify or free the returned pointer.
The internal representation may not match DER encoding for some types.

functions.name: ASN1_STRING_data
functions.description: Returns a mutable pointer to str’s internal contents. Prefer ASN1_STRING_get0_data for read-only access.
requirements: Use ASN1_STRING_length to get length.
Modifying contents must respect type-specific representation constraints.

functions.name: ASN1_STRING_length
functions.description: Returns the length, in bytes, of the ASN1_STRING contents.
requirements: str must be non-NULL.

functions.name: ASN1_STRING_cmp
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int ASN1_STRING_cmp(const ASN1_STRING *a, const ASN1_STRING *b);
functions.description: Compares two ASN1_STRINGs by length, then data, then type. Suitable for sorting but not for numeric ordering of INTEGERs.
requirements: a and b must be non-NULL.
Result is an arbitrary ordering across differing types—do not assume semantic ordering for differing types.

functions.name: ASN1_STRING_set
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int ASN1_STRING_set(ASN1_STRING *str, const void *data, ossl_ssize_t len);
functions.description: Sets str to a copy of len bytes from data. If data is NULL, adjusts length and (re)allocates but does not initialize contents.
requirements: str must be non-NULL.
If data is NULL, caller must later initialize contents before use.
len may be -1 only where documented elsewhere; here it is a size (per prototype).

functions.name: ASN1_STRING_set0
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT void ASN1_STRING_set0(ASN1_STRING *str, void *data, int len);
functions.description: Sets str to point to data of length len, taking ownership of data (must be OPENSSL_malloc-allocated).
requirements: data must have been allocated with OPENSSL_malloc and is now owned by str.
str must be non-NULL.
len must be the byte length of data.

functions.description: Compares two OCTET STRINGs using ASN1_STRING_cmp.
requirements: a and b must be non-NULL.

functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int ASN1_OCTET_STRING_set(ASN1_OCTET_STRING *str, const unsigned char *data, int len);
functions.description: Sets str to a copy of data of length len (same as ASN1_STRING_set).
requirements: str must be non-NULL.
data may be NULL to allocate without initializing (per ASN1_STRING_set semantics).

functions.name: ASN1_STRING_to_UTF8
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int ASN1_STRING_to_UTF8(unsigned char **out, const ASN1_STRING *in);
functions.description: Converts in to UTF-8 and stores into a newly-allocated buffer at *out. Returns the length or negative on error. Caller frees *out with OPENSSL_free.
requirements: out must be non-NULL; on success *out is set and owned by caller.
in must be a valid ASN1_STRING of a convertible type.
On error, negative return; *out is not set.

functions.name: ASN1_mbstring_copy
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int ASN1_mbstring_copy(ASN1_STRING **out, const uint8_t *in, ossl_ssize_t len, int inform, unsigned long mask);
functions.description: Converts input (multi-byte per inform MBSTRING_*) to an ASN1_STRING of a type selected by mask (or default DIRSTRING_TYPE) and optional out update. Returns the selected V_ASN1_* type on success, -1 on error.
requirements: If len == -1, in must be NUL-terminated.
inform must be one of MBSTRING_UTF8, MBSTRING_ASC (Latin-1), MBSTRING_BMP, MBSTRING_UNIV.
mask is a bitmask over allowed output types; if zero, DIRSTRING_TYPE is used.
If out and *out are non-NULL, object at *out is updated; if out non-NULL and *out NULL, *out is allocated; if out NULL, no ASN1_STRING is produced.

functions.name: ASN1_mbstring_ncopy
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int ASN1_mbstring_ncopy(ASN1_STRING **out, const uint8_t *in, ossl_ssize_t len, int inform, unsigned long mask, ossl_ssize_t minsize, ossl_ssize_t maxsize);
functions.description: Like ASN1_mbstring_copy with additional enforcement that input length in codepoints is between minsize and maxsize (if maxsize != 0). Returns selected V_ASN1_* type or -1 on error.
requirements: Same as ASN1_mbstring_copy.
Input length must be >= minsize and <= maxsize (if maxsize != 0).

functions.name: ASN1_STRING_set_by_NID
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT ASN1_STRING *ASN1_STRING_set_by_NID(ASN1_STRING **out, const unsigned char *in, ossl_ssize_t len, int inform, int nid);
functions.description: Chooses appropriate ASN.1 string type and bounds based on nid (for X.509 attributes), converts in accordingly, and returns an ASN1_STRING per its special out semantics. Returns NULL on error.
requirements: inform must be one of MBSTRING_*.
For recognized NIDs, additional attribute-specific size constraints are enforced; unrecognized NIDs default to UTF8String.
If out is NULL, returns newly-allocated string; if out non-NULL and *out NULL, sets *out; if both non-NULL, updates *out in place.

functions.name: ASN1_STRING_TABLE_add
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int ASN1_STRING_TABLE_add(int nid, long minsize, long maxsize, unsigned long mask, unsigned long flags);
functions.description: Registers custom parameters (type mask, size bounds, flags) for nid to be used by ASN1_STRING_set_by_NID. Affects global state.
requirements: May not be called for built-in NIDs or for a nid already registered.
Modifies global state and may conflict across libraries in same process.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded X.509 DirectoryString. May currently accept BER; trailing data not rejected.

Caller should not rely on BER acceptance (will be removed).

functions.name: i2d_DISPLAYTEXT

requirements: Buffer handling per i2d_SAMPLE.

functions.description: Frees a BIT STRING.

functions.name: i2d_ASN1_BIT_STRING
functions.description: Serializes a BIT STRING to DER. See i2d_SAMPLE.

functions.description: Decodes the BIT STRING contents (no tag/length) from exactly len bytes, consuming all len. See d2i_SAMPLE for out semantics.
requirements: len must match the content length exactly; on success all bytes are consumed.

functions.name: i2c_ASN1_BIT_STRING
functions.description: Encodes the contents (no tag/length) of a BIT STRING. Returns number of bytes or <=0 on error. If outp is non-NULL, writes and advances without bounds checks.
requirements: If outp and *outp non-NULL, ensure sufficient buffer; function does not allocate in this mode.
If outp NULL, returns size only.
Padding bits in data must be zero; flags may encode number of unused bits when ASN1_STRING_FLAG_BITS_LEFT is set.

functions.name: ASN1_BIT_STRING_num_bytes
functions.description: If bit length is a whole number of bytes, writes the byte length to *out and returns 1; else returns 0. Useful to treat BIT STRING as a byte string.
requirements: str must be a valid BIT STRING.
out must be non-NULL when expecting success.

functions.name: ASN1_BIT_STRING_set
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int ASN1_BIT_STRING_set(ASN1_BIT_STRING *str, const unsigned char *d, ossl_ssize_t length);
functions.description: Sets the BIT STRING data to a copy of d of given length. Flags (padding) are left unchanged; caller must set unused bits count if needed.
requirements: Caller must set padding count appropriately (e.g., via flags) for non-byte-aligned strings.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: ASN1_BIT_STRING_set_bit
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int ASN1_BIT_STRING_set_bit(ASN1_BIT_STRING *str, int n, int value);
functions.description: Sets or clears bit n (0-based), resizing as needed, then trims trailing zeros to conform to DER-like named-bits representation.
requirements: Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: ASN1_BIT_STRING_get_bit
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int ASN1_BIT_STRING_get_bit(const ASN1_BIT_STRING *str, int n);
functions.description: Returns 1 if bit n is in-bounds and set, else 0.

functions.name: ASN1_BIT_STRING_check
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int ASN1_BIT_STRING_check(const ASN1_BIT_STRING *str, const unsigned char *flags, int flags_len);
functions.description: Checks that str contains only bits present in flags bitmask (MSB-first). Returns 1 if OK, 0 otherwise.
requirements: flags must be flags_len bytes; bit 0 is MSB of flags[0].

functions.name: i2c_ASN1_INTEGER
functions.description: Encodes INTEGER contents (no tag/length). Returns number of bytes or <=0 on error. Does not allocate when *outp is NULL unlike i2d_SAMPLE third mode.
requirements: If outp and *outp non-NULL, ensure sufficient buffer; function does not allocate in this case.
Skips leading zeros if present (invalid representation).

functions.name: ASN1_INTEGER_set_uint64
functions.description: Sets out to the non-negative integer value v.
requirements: out must be non-NULL.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: ASN1_INTEGER_set_int64
functions.description: Sets out to the signed integer value v (negative handled via type flag).
requirements: out must be non-NULL.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: ASN1_INTEGER_get_uint64
functions.description: Converts a to uint64_t, returning 1 on success, 0 if out-of-range or wrong type (negative).
requirements: out must be non-NULL.
a must be non-NULL and represent a non-negative value fitting in uint64_t.

functions.name: ASN1_INTEGER_get_int64
functions.description: Converts a to int64_t, returning 1 on success, 0 if out-of-range or wrong type.
requirements: out must be non-NULL.
a must be non-NULL.

functions.name: BN_to_ASN1_INTEGER
functions.description: Sets ai to the value of bn as an ASN1_INTEGER and returns ai; if ai is NULL, allocates a new ASN1_INTEGER.
requirements: bn must be non-NULL.
Returned ASN1_INTEGER must be freed with ASN1_INTEGER_free if allocated.

functions.name: ASN1_INTEGER_to_BN
functions.description: Sets bn to the value of ai and returns bn; if bn is NULL, allocates and returns a new BIGNUM.
requirements: ai must be non-NULL.
Returned BIGNUM must be freed with BN_free if allocated.

functions.name: ASN1_INTEGER_cmp
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int ASN1_INTEGER_cmp(const ASN1_INTEGER *x, const ASN1_INTEGER *y);
functions.description: Numerically compares two ASN1_INTEGER values, returning <0, 0, >0 accordingly.
requirements: x and y must be non-NULL.

functions.name: ASN1_ENUMERATED_new
functions.description: Allocates a new ENUMERATED with value zero (type V_ASN1_ENUMERATED).

functions.name: ASN1_ENUMERATED_free
functions.description: Frees an ASN1_ENUMERATED.

functions.name: d2i_ASN1_ENUMERATED
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT ASN1_ENUMERATED *d2i_ASN1_ENUMERATED(ASN1_ENUMERATED **out, const uint8_t **inp, long len);
functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded ENUMERATED. See d2i_SAMPLE.

functions.name: i2d_ASN1_ENUMERATED
functions.description: Serializes an ENUMERATED to DER. See i2d_SAMPLE.

functions.name: ASN1_ENUMERATED_set_uint64
functions.description: Sets out to the non-negative enumerated value v.
requirements: out must be non-NULL.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: ASN1_ENUMERATED_set_int64
functions.description: Sets out to the signed enumerated value v (negative handled via type flag).
requirements: out must be non-NULL.

functions.name: ASN1_ENUMERATED_get_uint64
functions.description: Converts a to uint64_t; returns 1 on success, 0 if out-of-range or wrong type.
requirements: out must be non-NULL.
a must represent a non-negative value in-range.

functions.name: ASN1_ENUMERATED_get_int64
functions.description: Converts a to int64_t; returns 1 on success, 0 otherwise.
requirements: out must be non-NULL.

functions.name: BN_to_ASN1_ENUMERATED
functions.description: Sets ai to the value of bn as an ASN1_ENUMERATED and returns ai; if ai is NULL, allocates a new ASN1_ENUMERATED.
requirements: bn must be non-NULL.

functions.name: ASN1_ENUMERATED_to_BN
functions.description: Sets bn to the value of ai; allocates a new BIGNUM if bn is NULL.
requirements: ai must be non-NULL.

functions.name: ASN1_UTCTIME_new
functions.description: Allocates an empty UTCTime string (type V_ASN1_UTCTIME).

functions.name: ASN1_UTCTIME_free
functions.description: Frees a UTCTime.

functions.name: d2i_ASN1_UTCTIME
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT ASN1_UTCTIME *d2i_ASN1_UTCTIME(ASN1_UTCTIME **out, const uint8_t **inp, long len);
functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded UTCTime (currently also accepts BER).
requirements: Out semantics per d2i_SAMPLE.
Caller should not rely on BER acceptance in future.

functions.name: i2d_ASN1_UTCTIME
functions.description: Serializes a UTCTime to DER. See i2d_SAMPLE.

functions.name: ASN1_UTCTIME_check
functions.description: Validates that a contains a valid UTCTime. Returns 1 if valid, 0 otherwise.
requirements: a must be non-NULL.

functions.name: ASN1_UTCTIME_set
functions.description: Sets s (or allocates if s == NULL) to a UTCTime representing posix_time. May fail if time is out of UTCTime range.
requirements: posix_time must be within UTCTime representable range (1950..2049 per RFC 5280 interpretation).

functions.name: ASN1_UTCTIME_adj
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT ASN1_UTCTIME *ASN1_UTCTIME_adj(ASN1_UTCTIME *s, int64_t posix_time, int offset_day, long offset_sec);
functions.description: Sets s (or allocates) to UTCTime representing posix_time + offset_day*86400 + offset_sec. May fail on overflow or out-of-range.
requirements: Offsets must not overflow 64-bit addition; function returns NULL on overflow/out-of-range.

functions.name: ASN1_UTCTIME_set_string
functions.description: If s != NULL, sets s to the UTCTime given by str; if s == NULL, just validates str. Returns 1 on success, 0 on invalid or error.
requirements: str must be a valid UTCTime string (DER format like YYMMDDHHMMSSZ, etc.).

functions.name: ASN1_GENERALIZEDTIME_new
functions.description: Allocates an empty GeneralizedTime.

functions.name: ASN1_GENERALIZEDTIME_free
functions.description: Frees a GeneralizedTime.

functions.name: d2i_ASN1_GENERALIZEDTIME
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT ASN1_GENERALIZEDTIME *d2i_ASN1_GENERALIZEDTIME(ASN1_GENERALIZEDTIME **out, const uint8_t **inp, long len);
functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded GeneralizedTime. See d2i_SAMPLE.

functions.name: i2d_ASN1_GENERALIZEDTIME
functions.description: Serializes a GeneralizedTime to DER. See i2d_SAMPLE.

functions.name: ASN1_GENERALIZEDTIME_check
functions.description: Validates that a is a valid GeneralizedTime. Returns 1 if valid, 0 otherwise.

functions.name: ASN1_GENERALIZEDTIME_set
functions.description: Sets s (or allocates) to a GeneralizedTime representing posix_time. May fail if time out of range.

functions.name: ASN1_GENERALIZEDTIME_adj
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT ASN1_GENERALIZEDTIME *ASN1_GENERALIZEDTIME_adj(ASN1_GENERALIZEDTIME *s, int64_t posix_time, int offset_day, long offset_sec);
functions.description: Sets s (or allocates) to GeneralizedTime representing posix_time plus offsets. May fail on overflow or out-of-range.

functions.name: ASN1_GENERALIZEDTIME_set_string
functions.description: If s != NULL, sets s to str; if s == NULL, validates str as GeneralizedTime. Returns 1 on success, 0 on invalid/error.
requirements: str must be valid GeneralizedTime format (e.g., YYYYMMDDHHMMSSZ).

functions.name: ASN1_TIME_new
functions.description: Allocates an empty ASN1_TIME (multi-string for X.509 Time: UTCTime or GeneralizedTime).

functions.name: ASN1_TIME_free
functions.description: Frees an ASN1_TIME.

functions.name: d2i_ASN1_TIME
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT ASN1_TIME *d2i_ASN1_TIME(ASN1_TIME **out, const uint8_t **inp, long len);
functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded X.509 Time (UTCTime or GeneralizedTime). May currently accept BER.
requirements: Out semantics per d2i_SAMPLE.
Caller should not rely on BER acceptance in future.

functions.name: i2d_ASN1_TIME
functions.description: Serializes an ASN1_TIME (UTCTime or GeneralizedTime) to DER.

functions.name: ASN1_TIME_diff
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int ASN1_TIME_diff(int *out_days, int *out_seconds, const ASN1_TIME *from, const ASN1_TIME *to);
functions.description: Computes to - from, writing whole days and remaining seconds (rounded toward zero). Returns 1 on success, 0 on error (e.g., overflow or decoding failure).
requirements: out_days and out_seconds must be non-NULL.
from and to must be valid ASN1_TIME values.

functions.name: ASN1_TIME_set_posix
functions.description: Sets s (or allocates) to an X.509 Time using UTCTime if representable, otherwise GeneralizedTime.
requirements: posix_time must be within GeneralizedTime range.

functions.name: ASN1_TIME_set
functions.description: Compatibility wrapper for ASN1_TIME_set_posix taking time_t.
requirements: time must be convertible to GeneralizedTime.

functions.name: ASN1_TIME_adj
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT ASN1_TIME *ASN1_TIME_adj(ASN1_TIME *s, int64_t posix_time, int offset_day, long offset_sec);
functions.description: Sets s (or allocates) to Time of posix_time plus offsets, using UTCTime when possible, GeneralizedTime otherwise.
requirements: May fail on overflow or if out of GeneralizedTime range.

functions.name: ASN1_TIME_check
functions.description: Checks that t is a valid UTCTime or GeneralizedTime according to its type. Returns 1 if valid, 0 otherwise.

functions.name: ASN1_GENERALIZEDTIME *ASN1_TIME_to_generalizedtime
functions.description: Converts an ASN.1 Time (UTCTime or GeneralizedTime) value to a GeneralizedTime.
