functions.description: Returns an EVP_MD object implementing the SHA-256 hash algorithm. Use to configure an EVP_MD_CTX for SHA-256-based hashing.

functions.name: EVP_sha384
functions.description: Returns an EVP_MD object implementing the SHA-384 hash algorithm. Use to configure an EVP_MD_CTX for SHA-384-based hashing.

functions.name: EVP_sha512
functions.description: Returns an EVP_MD object implementing the SHA-512 hash algorithm. Use to configure an EVP_MD_CTX for SHA-512-based hashing.

functions.name: EVP_sha512_256
functions.description: Returns an EVP_MD object implementing the SHA-512/256 hash algorithm. Use to configure an EVP_MD_CTX for SHA-512/256-based hashing.

functions.name: EVP_blake2b256
functions.description: Returns an EVP_MD object implementing the BLAKE2b-256 hash algorithm. Use to configure an EVP_MD_CTX for BLAKE2b-256-based hashing.

functions.name: EVP_md5_sha1
functions.description: Returns a TLS-specific EVP_MD which computes the concatenation of MD5 and SHA-1, as used in TLS 1.1 and below.

functions.name: EVP_get_digestbynid
functions.description: Returns an EVP_MD for the given NID, or NULL if no such digest is known.

functions.name: EVP_get_digestbyobj
functions.description: Returns an EVP_MD for the given ASN1_OBJECT OID, or NULL if no such digest is known.

functions.name: EVP_MD_CTX_init
functions.description: Initializes an already-allocated EVP_MD_CTX. Equivalent to zeroing the structure.
requirements: ctx must point to an already allocated EVP_MD_CTX.

functions.name: EVP_MD_CTX_new
functions.description: Allocates and initializes a new EVP_MD_CTX. Returns NULL on allocation failure. Must be freed with EVP_MD_CTX_free.
requirements: Caller must free the returned context with EVP_MD_CTX_free.

functions.name: EVP_MD_CTX_cleanup
functions.description: Frees any resources owned by ctx and resets it to a freshly initialized state without freeing ctx itself. Returns one.
requirements: ctx must be an initialized EVP_MD_CTX.

functions.name: EVP_MD_CTX_cleanse
functions.description: Zeros the digest state in ctx and then performs EVP_MD_CTX_cleanup. Note: if the context contains more than a digest (e.g., from EVP_DigestSignInit), only the digest state is zeroed.
requirements: ctx must be an initialized EVP_MD_CTX.

functions.name: EVP_MD_CTX_free
functions.description: Calls EVP_MD_CTX_cleanup and then frees ctx itself. Safe to call on contexts allocated by EVP_MD_CTX_new.
requirements: ctx must have been allocated appropriately (e.g., by EVP_MD_CTX_new) or otherwise be valid for freeing.

functions.name: EVP_MD_CTX_copy_ex
functions.description: Sets out (already initialized) to be a copy of in. Returns one on success and zero on allocation failure.
requirements: out must be an already initialized EVP_MD_CTX.
in must be a valid, initialized EVP_MD_CTX.

functions.name: EVP_MD_CTX_move
functions.description: Moves the hash state from in into out. out must already be initialized. in is mutated and left in an empty state.
requirements: out must be an already initialized EVP_MD_CTX.
in must be a valid EVP_MD_CTX. It will be left in an empty state after the call.

functions.name: EVP_MD_CTX_reset
functions.description: Calls EVP_MD_CTX_cleanup followed by EVP_MD_CTX_init on ctx. Returns one.
requirements: ctx must be a valid EVP_MD_CTX.

functions.name: EVP_DigestInit_ex
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_DigestInit_ex(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, const EVP_MD *type, ENGINE *engine);
functions.description: Configures ctx (already initialized) for a fresh hashing operation using type. Returns one on success and zero on allocation failure.
requirements: ctx must already have been initialized (e.g., via EVP_MD_CTX_init or EVP_MD_CTX_new).
type must be a valid EVP_MD (e.g., from EVP_sha256, etc.).

functions.name: EVP_DigestInit
functions.description: Like EVP_DigestInit_ex but initializes ctx before use.
requirements: type must be a valid EVP_MD (e.g., from EVP_sha256, etc.).

functions.name: EVP_DigestUpdate
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_DigestUpdate(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, const void *data, size_t len);
functions.description: Hashes len bytes from data into the hashing operation in ctx. Returns one.
requirements: ctx must have been set up for hashing with EVP_DigestInit_ex or EVP_DigestInit.
data must point to at least len bytes of readable memory.

functions.name: EVP_DigestFinal_ex
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_DigestFinal_ex(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, uint8_t *md_out, unsigned int *out_size);
functions.description: Finishes the digest in ctx and writes the output to md_out. Writes EVP_MD_CTX_size(ctx) bytes (at most EVP_MAX_MD_SIZE). If out_size is not NULL, *out_size is set to the number of bytes written. Returns one. After this call, the hash cannot be updated or finished again until reinitialized with EVP_DigestInit_ex.
requirements: ctx must have a digest set (initialized via EVP_DigestInit_ex or EVP_DigestInit).
md_out must point to a buffer with capacity of at least EVP_MD_CTX_size(ctx) bytes (up to EVP_MAX_MD_SIZE).
After calling, caller must reinitialize ctx with EVP_DigestInit_ex before reusing for another digest operation if further updates/finals are needed.

functions.name: EVP_DigestFinal
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_DigestFinal(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, uint8_t *md_out, unsigned int *out_size);
functions.description: Like EVP_DigestFinal_ex but calls EVP_MD_CTX_cleanup on ctx before returning. Returns one on success.
requirements: ctx must have a digest set (initialized via EVP_DigestInit_ex or EVP_DigestInit).
md_out must point to a buffer with capacity of at least EVP_MD_CTX_size(ctx) bytes (up to EVP_MAX_MD_SIZE).

functions.name: EVP_Digest
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_Digest(const void *data, size_t len, uint8_t *md_out, unsigned int *md_out_size, const EVP_MD *type, ENGINE *impl);
functions.description: Performs a complete hashing operation in one call. Hashes len bytes from data using type and writes the digest to md_out. Writes EVP_MD_size(type) bytes (at most EVP_MAX_MD_SIZE). If md_out_size is not NULL, *md_out_size is set to the number of bytes written. Returns one on success and zero otherwise.
requirements: data must point to at least len bytes of readable memory.
md_out must point to a buffer with capacity of at least EVP_MD_size(type) bytes (up to EVP_MAX_MD_SIZE).
type must be a valid EVP_MD.

functions.name: EVP_MD_type
functions.description: Returns a NID identifying md (e.g., NID_sha256).
requirements: md must be a valid EVP_MD.

functions.name: EVP_MD_flags
functions.description: Returns the flags for md, which is a set of EVP_MD_FLAG_* values ORed together.
requirements: md must be a valid EVP_MD.

functions.name: EVP_MD_size
functions.description: Returns the digest size of md in bytes.
requirements: md must be a valid EVP_MD.

functions.name: EVP_MD_block_size
functions.description: Returns the native block size of md in bytes.
requirements: md must be a valid EVP_MD.

functions.name: EVP_MD_CTX_get0_md
functions.description: Returns the underlying digest function associated with ctx, or NULL if none has been set.
requirements: ctx must be a valid EVP_MD_CTX.

functions.name: EVP_MD_CTX_md
functions.description: Returns the underlying digest function associated with ctx, or NULL if none has been set. Deprecated spelling equivalent to EVP_MD_CTX_get0_md.
requirements: ctx must be a valid EVP_MD_CTX.

functions.name: EVP_MD_CTX_size
functions.description: Returns the digest size of ctx's digest in bytes. Will crash if a digest hasn't been set on ctx.
requirements: A digest must have been set on ctx before calling.

functions.name: EVP_MD_CTX_block_size
functions.description: Returns the block size of the digest function used by ctx, in bytes. Will crash if a digest hasn't been set on ctx.
requirements: A digest must have been set on ctx before calling.

functions.name: EVP_MD_CTX_type
functions.description: Returns a NID describing the digest function used by ctx (e.g., NID_sha256). Will crash if a digest hasn't been set on ctx.
requirements: A digest must have been set on ctx before calling.

functions.name: EVP_parse_digest_algorithm
functions.description: Parses an AlgorithmIdentifier containing a hash function OID from cbs and advances cbs. Parameters may be omitted or NULL. Returns the digest function or NULL on error.
requirements: cbs must point to a CBS positioned at an AlgorithmIdentifier encoding.
Caller must handle NULL return to detect parse errors.

functions.name: EVP_parse_digest_algorithm_nid
functions.description: Parses an AlgorithmIdentifier like EVP_parse_digest_algorithm but returns a NID (or NID_undef on error). Useful to avoid depending on all digests.
requirements: cbs must point to a CBS positioned at an AlgorithmIdentifier encoding.
Caller must check for NID_undef to detect parse errors.

functions.name: EVP_marshal_digest_algorithm
functions.description: Marshals md as an AlgorithmIdentifier and appends to cbb. Sets the parameters field to NULL. Returns one on success and zero on error. Notes outline standards that require NULL parameters in certain contexts (e.g., RSASSA-PSS/OAEP and RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 DigestInfo).
requirements: cbb must be a valid CBB ready for appending.
md must be a valid EVP_MD.
Caller must check the return value (zero indicates error).

functions.name: EVP_marshal_digest_algorithm_no_params
functions.description: Like EVP_marshal_digest_algorithm but omits the parameters field in the AlgorithmIdentifier. Returns one on success and zero on error.
requirements: cbb must be a valid CBB ready for appending.
md must be a valid EVP_MD.
Caller must check the return value (zero indicates error).

functions.name: EVP_MD_CTX_copy
functions.description: Deprecated. Sets out (which must not be initialized) to be a copy of in. Returns one on success and zero on error.
requirements: out must not be initialized prior to the call.
in must be a valid, initialized EVP_MD_CTX.

functions.name: EVP_add_digest
functions.description: Deprecated compatibility function. Does nothing and returns one (for OpenSSL compatibility).

functions.name: EVP_get_digestbyname
functions.description: Returns an EVP_MD given a human-readable name string, or NULL if the name is unknown.
requirements: Name string must be a valid, null-terminated C string pointer.

functions.name: EVP_dss1
functions.description: Returns the value of EVP_sha1(). Historically used for original DSA signatures fixed to SHA-1. Note: attempting to sign or verify DSA signatures with the EVP interface will always fail in BoringSSL.

functions.name: EVP_MD_CTX_create
functions.description: Deprecated alias. Calls EVP_MD_CTX_new.
requirements: Caller must free the returned context with EVP_MD_CTX_free (via EVP_MD_CTX_destroy or EVP_MD_CTX_free).

functions.name: EVP_MD_CTX_destroy
functions.description: Deprecated alias. Calls EVP_MD_CTX_free.
requirements: ctx must be a valid EVP_MD_CTX obtained from EVP_MD_CTX_create/new.

functions.name: EVP_DigestFinalXOF
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_DigestFinalXOF(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, uint8_t *out, size_t len);
functions.description: Returns zero and adds an error to the error queue. BoringSSL does not support any extensible-output function (XOF) digests.
requirements: Caller should not expect success; function always fails in BoringSSL and must handle a zero return value.

functions.name: EVP_MD_meth_get_flags
functions.description: Compatibility alias. Calls EVP_MD_flags.
requirements: md must be a valid EVP_MD.

functions.name: EVP_MD_CTX_set_flags
functions.description: Does nothing. Exists for compatibility.
requirements: None beyond providing a valid ctx pointer (no effect).

functions.name: EVP_MD_nid
functions.description: Compatibility alias. Calls EVP_MD_type.
requirements: md must be a valid EVP_MD.

functions.name: DSA_new
functions.description: Allocates and returns a new, empty DSA object. Use to create a DSA key/container before setting parameters/keys or generating them.
requirements: Caller must free the returned object with DSA_free when no longer needed.
The returned object has no parameters or keys until configured or generated.

functions.name: DSA_free
functions.description: Decrements the reference count of the DSA object and frees it when the count reaches zero.
requirements: It is safe to call with NULL (no effect) only if the implementation documents it; otherwise pass a valid DSA*.
Do not use the DSA object after the final DSA_free call.
All references must be balanced with corresponding DSA_up_ref/DSA_free usage.

functions.name: DSA_up_ref
functions.description: Increments the reference count of the DSA object. Non-mutating with respect to key material and thread-safe for concurrent use.
requirements: dsa must be a valid pointer to an initialized DSA.
Return value 1 indicates success; callers should check the return value.

functions.name: DSA_bits
functions.description: Returns the size, in bits, of the DSA group's modulus p for dsa.
requirements: dsa must be a valid DSA with parameters set.

functions.name: DSA_get0_pub_key
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the public key component (y) of dsa. The returned pointer is owned by dsa and must not be freed or modified.
requirements: dsa must be a valid DSA.
Returned BIGNUM pointer may be NULL if the public key is not set; caller must handle NULL.

functions.name: DSA_get0_priv_key
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the private key component (x) of dsa, or NULL if dsa is a public-only key. The pointer is owned by dsa.
requirements: dsa must be a valid DSA.
Caller must not free or modify the returned BIGNUM.

functions.name: DSA_get0_p
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the group modulus p of dsa. The pointer is owned by dsa.
requirements: dsa must be a valid DSA.
Caller must not free or modify the returned BIGNUM.

functions.name: DSA_get0_q
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the subgroup order q of dsa. The pointer is owned by dsa.
requirements: dsa must be a valid DSA.
Caller must not free or modify the returned BIGNUM.

functions.name: DSA_get0_g
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the generator g of dsa. The pointer is owned by dsa.
requirements: dsa must be a valid DSA.
Caller must not free or modify the returned BIGNUM.

functions.name: DSA_get0_key
functions.signature: void DSA_get0_key(const DSA *dsa, const BIGNUM **out_pub_key, const BIGNUM **out_priv_key)
functions.description: Outputs pointers to the public and private key components of dsa into the provided locations. The output pointers refer to internal storage owned by dsa.
requirements: dsa must be a valid DSA.
out_pub_key and/or out_priv_key may be NULL to skip that output.
Do not free or modify the returned BIGNUMs.

functions.name: DSA_get0_pqg
functions.signature: void DSA_get0_pqg(const DSA *dsa, const BIGNUM **out_p, const BIGNUM **out_q, const BIGNUM **out_g)
functions.description: Outputs pointers to the p, q, and g parameters of dsa. The pointers refer to internal storage owned by dsa.
requirements: dsa must be a valid DSA.
Each of out_p, out_q, out_g may be NULL to skip that output.
Do not free or modify the returned BIGNUMs.

functions.name: DSA_set0_key
functions.description: Sets dsa’s public and/or private key to the provided BIGNUMs. On success, ownership of any non-NULL inputs transfers to dsa.
requirements: dsa must be a valid DSA.
priv_key may be NULL (public-only key).
pub_key must be non-NULL or already configured on dsa; otherwise the call fails.
On success, caller must not free pub_key/priv_key passed in (ownership is taken).
Return value 1 indicates success; 0 indicates failure.

functions.name: DSA_set0_pqg
functions.description: Sets dsa’s domain parameters p, q, and/or g to the provided BIGNUMs. On success, ownership of any non-NULL inputs transfers to dsa.
requirements: dsa must be a valid DSA.
Each of p, q, g must be non-NULL or already configured on dsa.
On success, caller must not free the BIGNUMs passed in (ownership is taken).
Return value 1 indicates success; 0 indicates failure.

functions.name: DSA_generate_parameters_ex
functions.signature: int DSA_generate_parameters_ex(DSA *dsa, unsigned bits, const uint8_t *seed, size_t seed_len, int *out_counter, unsigned long *out_h, BN_GENCB *cb)
functions.description: Generates DSA domain parameters in dsa per FIPS 186-4 Appendix A. The prime p has length bits. Optionally uses a provided seed and returns generation counters. Progress notifications may be delivered via cb.
requirements: dsa must be a valid DSA to receive parameters.
bits specifies the size of p in bits; must be within implementation limits (up to OPENSSL_DSA_MAX_MODULUS_BITS).
seed may be NULL for random generation; if non-NULL, seed_len must be the seed length in bytes.
out_counter and out_h may be NULL if not needed.
cb may be NULL or a BN_GENCB configured per BN_generate_prime_ex semantics.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure; callers must check the return value.

functions.name: DSAparams_dup
functions.description: Allocates and returns a new DSA containing a copy of the parameters (p, q, g) from dsa.
requirements: dsa must be a valid DSA with parameters set.
Caller must free the returned object with DSA_free.
Returns NULL on error; callers must check for NULL.

functions.name: DSA_generate_key
functions.description: Generates and stores a DSA public/private key pair in dsa using its existing domain parameters.
requirements: dsa must be a valid DSA with parameters (p, q, g) already set.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error; callers must check the return value.

functions.name: DSA_SIG_new
functions.description: Allocates and returns a new empty DSA_SIG structure with r and s set to NULL.
requirements: Caller must free the returned object with DSA_SIG_free.
Returns NULL on allocation failure; callers must check for NULL.

functions.name: DSA_SIG_free
functions.description: Frees the DSA_SIG structure and its contents.
requirements: Do not use sig after freeing it.
It is safe to call on NULL only if implementation allows; otherwise pass a valid pointer.

functions.name: DSA_SIG_get0
functions.signature: void DSA_SIG_get0(const DSA_SIG *sig, const BIGNUM **out_r, const BIGNUM **out_s)
functions.description: Outputs pointers to the r and s components of a DSA signature. The returned pointers reference memory owned by sig.
requirements: sig must be a valid DSA_SIG.
Each of out_r and out_s may be NULL to skip that output.
Caller must not free or modify the returned BIGNUMs.

functions.name: DSA_SIG_set0
functions.description: Sets r and s components of a DSA signature. On success, ownership of r and s transfers to sig.
requirements: sig must be a valid DSA_SIG.
r and s must both be non-NULL; otherwise the call fails.
On success, caller must not free r or s passed in.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure.

functions.name: DSA_do_sign
functions.signature: DSA_SIG *DSA_do_sign(const uint8_t *digest, size_t digest_len, const DSA *dsa)
functions.description: Creates a raw DSA signature (r,s) over the message digest and returns it as a DSA_SIG.
requirements: digest must point to the message hash; digest_len is its length in bytes.
dsa must be a valid DSA containing a private key and parameters.
Returns NULL on error; callers must check for NULL.

functions.name: DSA_do_verify
functions.signature: int DSA_do_verify(const uint8_t *digest, size_t digest_len, const DSA_SIG *sig, const DSA *dsa)
functions.description: Verifies a raw DSA signature (r,s) against the message digest using the public key in dsa.
requirements: digest must point to the message hash; digest_len is its length in bytes.
sig must be a valid DSA_SIG with r and s set.
dsa must be a valid DSA containing the public key and parameters.
Return value semantics: 1 = valid, 0 = invalid, -1 = error; callers must not treat non-zero as success without checking for -1.
This function is deprecated in favor of DSA_do_check_signature due to return value semantics.

functions.name: DSA_do_check_signature
functions.signature: int DSA_do_check_signature(int *out_valid, const uint8_t *digest, size_t digest_len, const DSA_SIG *sig, const DSA *dsa)
functions.description: Verifies a raw DSA signature (r,s) against the message digest and sets *out_valid to 1 if valid, 0 if invalid.
requirements: out_valid must be a valid pointer; the function sets *out_valid to zero before verification.
digest must point to the message hash; digest_len is its length in bytes.
sig must be a valid DSA_SIG with r and s set.
dsa must be a valid DSA containing the public key and parameters.
Returns 1 on success (validity determined), 0 on error; callers must check the return value before using *out_valid.

functions.name: DSA_sign
functions.signature: int DSA_sign(int type, const uint8_t *digest, size_t digest_len, uint8_t *out_sig, unsigned int *out_siglen, const DSA *dsa)
functions.description: Creates an ASN.1 DER-encoded DSA signature over digest and writes it to out_sig; length is returned in *out_siglen. The type argument is ignored.
requirements: out_sig must have at least DSA_size(dsa) bytes available.
out_siglen must be a valid pointer to receive the length.
digest must point to the message hash; digest_len is its length in bytes.
dsa must be a valid DSA containing a private key and parameters.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure; callers must check the return value.

functions.name: DSA_verify
functions.signature: int DSA_verify(int type, const uint8_t *digest, size_t digest_len, const uint8_t *sig, size_t sig_len, const DSA *dsa)
functions.description: Verifies an ASN.1 DER-encoded DSA signature over digest using the public key in dsa. The type argument is ignored. Deprecated in favor of DSA_check_signature due to return value semantics.
requirements: digest must point to the message hash; digest_len is its length in bytes.
sig must point to the ASN.1-encoded signature; sig_len is its length in bytes.
dsa must be a valid DSA containing the public key and parameters.
Return value semantics: 1 = valid, 0 = invalid, -1 = error; callers must not treat non-zero as success without checking for -1.

functions.name: DSA_check_signature
functions.signature: int DSA_check_signature(int *out_valid, const uint8_t *digest, size_t digest_len, const uint8_t *sig, size_t sig_len, const DSA *dsa)
functions.description: Verifies an ASN.1 DER-encoded DSA signature over digest and sets *out_valid to 1 if valid, 0 if invalid.
requirements: out_valid must be a valid pointer; the function sets *out_valid to zero before verification.
digest must point to the message hash; digest_len is its length in bytes.
sig must point to the ASN.1-encoded signature; sig_len is its length in bytes.
dsa must be a valid DSA containing the public key and parameters.
Returns 1 on success (validity determined), 0 on error; callers must check the return value before using *out_valid.

functions.name: DSA_size
functions.description: Returns the maximum size in bytes of an ASN.1-encoded DSA signature generated with dsa.
requirements: dsa must be a valid DSA with parameters set.
Return is a non-negative size; callers must handle errors (negative or 0 depending on implementation).

functions.name: DSA_SIG_parse
functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded DSA-Sig-Value from the input CBS, advancing cbs on success, and returns a newly allocated DSA_SIG.
requirements: cbs must be initialized to the DER input; it is advanced on success.
Returns NULL on parse error; callers must check for NULL and consider cbs state only advanced on success.
Caller must free the returned DSA_SIG with DSA_SIG_free.

functions.name: DSA_SIG_marshal
functions.description: Appends a DER-encoded DSA-Sig-Value for sig to the output CBB.
requirements: cbb must be an initialized, open CBB for writing.
sig must be a valid DSA_SIG with r and s set.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error; callers must check the return value.

functions.name: DSA_parse_public_key
functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded DSA public key from cbs, advancing cbs, and returns a newly allocated DSA.
requirements: cbs must be initialized to the DER input; it is advanced on success.
Returns NULL on parse error; callers must check for NULL and manage cbs accordingly.
Caller must free the returned DSA with DSA_free.

functions.name: DSA_marshal_public_key
functions.description: Appends a DER-encoded DSA public key for dsa to cbb.
requirements: cbb must be an initialized, open CBB for writing.
dsa must be a valid DSA containing a public key and parameters.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure; callers must check the return value.

functions.name: DSA_parse_private_key
functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded DSA private key from cbs, advancing cbs, and returns a newly allocated DSA.
requirements: cbs must be initialized to the DER input; it is advanced on success.
Returns NULL on parse error; callers must check for NULL and manage cbs accordingly.
Caller must free the returned DSA with DSA_free.

functions.name: DSA_marshal_private_key
functions.description: Appends a DER-encoded DSA private key for dsa to cbb.
requirements: cbb must be an initialized, open CBB for writing.
dsa must be a valid DSA containing a private key and parameters.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure; callers must check the return value.

functions.name: DSA_parse_parameters
functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded Dss-Parms (RFC 3279) from cbs, advancing cbs, and returns a newly allocated DSA with those parameters.
requirements: cbs must be initialized to the DER input; it is advanced on success.
Returns NULL on parse error; callers must check for NULL and manage cbs accordingly.
Caller must free the returned DSA with DSA_free.

functions.name: DSA_marshal_parameters
functions.description: Appends a DER-encoded Dss-Parms (RFC 3279) for dsa to cbb.
requirements: cbb must be an initialized, open CBB for writing.
dsa must be a valid DSA with parameters set.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure; callers must check the return value.

functions.name: DSA_dup_DH
functions.description: Constructs and returns a DH object from the DSA parameters of dsa. Useful when DH parameters are stored in DSA form.
requirements: dsa must be a valid DSA with parameters set.
Returns NULL on error; callers must check for NULL.
Caller must free the returned DH with the appropriate free function.

functions.name: DSA_get_ex_new_index
functions.signature: int DSA_get_ex_new_index(long argl, void *argp, CRYPTO_EX_unused *unused, CRYPTO_EX_dup *dup_unused, CRYPTO_EX_free *free_func)
functions.description: Allocates a new ex_data index for DSA objects for application-specific data attachment. See ex_data.h for semantics.
requirements: Arguments are passed through to ex_data subsystem; free_func may be used for cleanup callbacks.
Return value is a non-negative index on success; negative on error. Callers must check the return value before using it with DSA_set_ex_data/DSA_get_ex_data.

functions.name: DSA_set_ex_data
functions.description: Associates application-specific data with a DSA object at index idx.
requirements: dsa must be a valid DSA.
idx must be a valid ex_data index previously obtained via DSA_get_ex_new_index.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure; callers must check the return value.
The lifetime and type of arg are managed by the application; if a free callback was registered for idx, it will be used at cleanup.

functions.name: DSA_get_ex_data
functions.description: Retrieves application-specific data previously stored in dsa at index idx.
requirements: dsa must be a valid DSA.
idx must be a valid ex_data index previously obtained via DSA_get_ex_new_index.
Returns the stored pointer (which may be NULL).

functions.name: d2i_DSA_SIG
functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded DSA-Sig-Value from *inp of length len into a DSA_SIG per d2i conventions. Deprecated: use DSA_SIG_parse.
requirements: inp must point to the DER input buffer; *inp is advanced on success per d2i semantics.
out_sig may be NULL or may point to an existing DSA_SIG* to be reused per d2i semantics.
len must be the number of bytes available at *inp.
Returns NULL on error; callers must check for NULL.

functions.name: i2d_DSA_SIG
functions.description: Serializes a DSA_SIG to DER (DSA-Sig-Value) per i2d conventions. Deprecated: use DSA_SIG_marshal.
requirements: in must be a valid DSA_SIG with r and s set.
If outp is non-NULL and *outp is NULL, a buffer is allocated and *outp advanced per i2d semantics; if *outp is non-NULL, sufficient space must be available.
Returns the number of bytes written on success, or a non-positive value on error; callers must check the return value.

functions.name: d2i_DSAPublicKey
functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded DSA public key from *inp of length len into a DSA per d2i conventions. Deprecated: use DSA_parse_public_key.
requirements: inp must point to the DER input buffer; *inp is advanced on success per d2i semantics.
out may be NULL or a pointer to an existing DSA* to be reused per d2i semantics.
len must be the number of bytes available at *inp.
Returns NULL on error; callers must check for NULL.

functions.name: i2d_DSAPublicKey
functions.description: Serializes a DSA public key to DER per i2d conventions. Deprecated: use DSA_marshal_public_key.
requirements: in must be a valid DSA containing a public key and parameters.
If outp is non-NULL and *outp is NULL, a buffer is allocated and *outp advanced per i2d semantics; if *outp is non-NULL, sufficient space must be available.
Returns the number of bytes written on success, or a non-positive value on error; callers must check the return value.

functions.name: d2i_DSAPrivateKey
functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded DSA private key from *inp of length len into a DSA per d2i conventions. Deprecated: use DSA_parse_private_key.
requirements: inp must point to the DER input buffer; *inp is advanced on success per d2i semantics.
out may be NULL or a pointer to an existing DSA* to be reused per d2i semantics.
len must be the number of bytes available at *inp.
Returns NULL on error; callers must check for NULL.

functions.name: i2d_DSAPrivateKey
functions.description: Serializes a DSA private key to DER per i2d conventions. Deprecated: use DSA_marshal_private_key.
requirements: in must be a valid DSA containing a private key and parameters.
If outp is non-NULL and *outp is NULL, a buffer is allocated and *outp advanced per i2d semantics; if *outp is non-NULL, sufficient space must be available.
Returns the number of bytes written on success, or a non-positive value on error; callers must check the return value.

functions.name: d2i_DSAparams
functions.description: Parses DER-encoded Dss-Parms from *inp of length len into a DSA per d2i conventions. Deprecated: use DSA_parse_parameters.
requirements: inp must point to the DER input buffer; *inp is advanced on success per d2i semantics.
out may be NULL or a pointer to an existing DSA* to be reused per d2i semantics.
len must be the number of bytes available at *inp.
Returns NULL on error; callers must check for NULL.

functions.name: i2d_DSAparams
functions.description: Serializes DSA parameters (Dss-Parms) to DER per i2d conventions. Deprecated: use DSA_marshal_parameters.
requirements: in must be a valid DSA with parameters set.
If outp is non-NULL and *outp is NULL, a buffer is allocated and *outp advanced per i2d semantics; if *outp is non-NULL, sufficient space must be available.
Returns the number of bytes written on success, or a non-positive value on error; callers must check the return value.

functions.name: DSA_generate_parameters
functions.signature: DSA *DSA_generate_parameters(int bits, unsigned char *seed, int seed_len, int *counter_ret, unsigned long *h_ret, void (*callback)(int, int, void *), void *cb_arg)
functions.description: Deprecated allocator variant of parameter generation corresponding to DSA_generate_parameters_ex. Generates DSA parameters of size bits, optionally using seed, and returns a newly allocated DSA.
requirements: bits specifies the size of p in bits; must be within implementation limits (up to OPENSSL_DSA_MAX_MODULUS_BITS).
seed may be NULL; if non-NULL, seed_len is its length in bytes.
counter_ret and h_ret may be NULL if not needed.
callback and cb_arg provide progress notifications; may be NULL.
Returns a newly allocated DSA on success or NULL on error; callers must free the result with DSA_free.

functions.name: EC_group_p224
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the static EC_GROUP representing the NIST P-224 (secp224r1) curve. Intended for selecting a built-in group for elliptic-curve operations. The returned object is static/immutable in BoringSSL and need not be freed.
requirements: Caller must not attempt to modify the returned EC_GROUP.
The returned EC_GROUP may be treated as static; EC_GROUP_free is optional.

functions.name: EC_group_p256
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the static EC_GROUP representing the NIST P-256 (secp256r1/prime256v1) curve. Use as the canonical P-256 group.
requirements: Caller must not attempt to modify the returned EC_GROUP.
The returned EC_GROUP may be treated as static; EC_GROUP_free is optional.

functions.name: EC_group_p384
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the static EC_GROUP representing the NIST P-384 (secp384r1) curve.
requirements: Caller must not attempt to modify the returned EC_GROUP.
The returned EC_GROUP may be treated as static; EC_GROUP_free is optional.

functions.name: EC_group_p521
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the static EC_GROUP representing the NIST P-521 (secp521r1) curve.
requirements: Caller must not attempt to modify the returned EC_GROUP.
The returned EC_GROUP may be treated as static; EC_GROUP_free is optional.

functions.name: EC_GROUP_new_by_curve_name
functions.description: Returns an EC_GROUP corresponding to a supported named curve NID (P-224, P-256, P-384, P-521), or NULL if unsupported. Provided mainly for OpenSSL compatibility; returns a non-const pointer to a static object in BoringSSL.
requirements: nid must be one of the supported curve NIDs: NID_secp224r1, NID_X9_62_prime256v1, NID_secp384r1, or NID_secp521r1.
Caller should check for NULL on failure.
Although a non-const pointer is returned, the object is static/immutable in BoringSSL; EC_GROUP_free is optional.

functions.name: EC_GROUP_cmp
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EC_GROUP_cmp(const EC_GROUP *a, const EC_GROUP *b, BN_CTX *ignored);
functions.description: Compares two EC_GROUPs for equality. Returns 0 if equal, non-zero otherwise. BN_CTX parameter is ignored.
requirements: a and b must be valid EC_GROUP pointers.
Caller should not rely on BN_CTX; it is ignored and may be NULL.

functions.name: EC_GROUP_get0_generator
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the internal EC_POINT that is the group generator. The returned pointer is owned by the group and must not be freed or modified.
requirements: group must be a valid EC_GROUP.
Returned EC_POINT is read-only and remains valid as long as the EC_GROUP is valid.

functions.name: EC_GROUP_get0_order
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the internal BIGNUM giving the group order. The returned object is owned by the group and must not be freed or modified.
requirements: group must be a valid EC_GROUP.
Returned BIGNUM is read-only and remains valid as long as the EC_GROUP is valid.

functions.name: EC_GROUP_order_bits
functions.description: Returns the bit length of the group order.
requirements: group must be a valid EC_GROUP.

functions.name: EC_GROUP_get_cofactor
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EC_GROUP_get_cofactor(const EC_GROUP *group, BIGNUM *cofactor, BN_CTX *ctx);
functions.description: Writes the group cofactor into |cofactor| and returns 1 on success, 0 on error. ctx is ignored and may be NULL.
requirements: group must be a valid EC_GROUP.
cofactor must be a valid, writable BIGNUM pointer.
Caller must check the return value for success.
BN_CTX may be NULL; if provided it is ignored.

functions.name: EC_GROUP_get_curve_GFp
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EC_GROUP_get_curve_GFp(const EC_GROUP *group, BIGNUM *out_p, BIGNUM *out_a, BIGNUM *out_b, BN_CTX *ctx);
functions.description: Gets the prime-field curve parameters for |group| in short Weierstrass form y^2 = x^3 + a x + b. Writes the field prime to out_p and curve parameters to out_a and out_b. Any output may be NULL to skip. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error. ctx is ignored.
requirements: group must be a valid EC_GROUP over GF(p).
out_p, out_a, out_b, if non-NULL, must be writable BIGNUMs.
Caller must check the return value.
BN_CTX may be NULL; if provided it is ignored.

functions.name: EC_GROUP_get_curve_name
functions.description: Returns the NID for the named curve of |group|, or NID_undef for arbitrary groups.
requirements: group must be a valid EC_GROUP.

functions.name: EC_GROUP_get_degree
functions.description: Returns the bit-length of elements in the field underlying |group|.
requirements: group must be a valid EC_GROUP.

functions.name: EC_curve_nid2nist
functions.description: Maps a curve NID to its NIST short name (e.g., NID_X9_62_prime256v1 -> "P-256"). Returns NULL if the NID is not a NIST curve.
requirements: Caller must not modify or free the returned string pointer.
nid should be a valid curve NID.

functions.name: EC_curve_nist2nid
functions.description: Maps a NIST short curve name (e.g., "P-256") to its OpenSSL NID. Returns NID_undef if not recognized.
requirements: name must be a NUL-terminated C string pointer to a NIST curve name or alias.

functions.name: EC_POINT_new
functions.description: Allocates a new EC_POINT belonging to |group|. Returns a new point or NULL on error.
requirements: group must be a valid EC_GROUP.
Caller must free the returned EC_POINT with EC_POINT_free (or EC_POINT_clear_free).
Caller must check for NULL on failure.

functions.name: EC_POINT_free
functions.description: Frees an EC_POINT and any associated data. Safe to call with NULL.
requirements: point must be either NULL or a pointer returned from EC_POINT_new/dup or owned by the caller.

functions.name: EC_POINT_copy
functions.description: Copies the value of |src| into |dest|. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.
requirements: dest and src must be valid EC_POINTs created for the same EC_GROUP.
Caller must check the return value.

functions.name: EC_POINT_dup
functions.description: Duplicates |src| into a newly-allocated EC_POINT associated with |group|. Returns the new point or NULL on error.
requirements: src must be a valid EC_POINT.
group must be a valid EC_GROUP compatible with |src|.
Caller must free the returned point with EC_POINT_free.
Caller must check for NULL on failure.

functions.name: EC_POINT_set_to_infinity
functions.description: Sets |point| to the point at infinity in |group|. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.
requirements: group must be a valid EC_GROUP.
point must be a valid EC_POINT belonging to |group|.
Caller must check the return value.

functions.name: EC_POINT_is_at_infinity
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EC_POINT_is_at_infinity(const EC_GROUP *group, const EC_POINT *point);
functions.description: Returns 1 if |point| is the point at infinity for |group|, otherwise 0.
requirements: group must be a valid EC_GROUP.
point must be a valid EC_POINT belonging to |group|.

functions.name: EC_POINT_is_on_curve
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EC_POINT_is_on_curve(const EC_GROUP *group, const EC_POINT *point, BN_CTX *ctx);
functions.description: Checks whether |point| lies on |group|. Returns 1 if on-curve, 0 otherwise or on error. Differs from OpenSSL which returns -1 on error. ctx is ignored and may be NULL.
requirements: group must be a valid EC_GROUP.
point must be a valid EC_POINT belonging to |group|.
Caller must treat a return of 0 as either not on curve or error; no -1 is returned in BoringSSL.
BN_CTX may be NULL; if provided it is ignored.

functions.name: EC_POINT_cmp
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EC_POINT_cmp(const EC_GROUP *group, const EC_POINT *a, const EC_POINT *b, BN_CTX *ctx);
functions.description: Compares two points for equality in |group|. Returns 0 if equal, >0 if not equal, and -1 on error. ctx is ignored and may be NULL.
requirements: group must be a valid EC_GROUP.
a and b must be valid EC_POINTs belonging to |group|.
Caller must handle return values 0 (equal), >0 (not equal), and -1 (error).
BN_CTX may be NULL; if provided it is ignored.

functions.name: EC_POINT_get_affine_coordinates_GFp
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EC_POINT_get_affine_coordinates_GFp(const EC_GROUP *group, const EC_POINT *point, BIGNUM *x, BIGNUM *y, BN_CTX *ctx);
functions.description: Converts |point| to affine coordinates and writes x and/or y. Either coordinate may be NULL to skip computation. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error. ctx is ignored and may be NULL.
requirements: group must be a valid EC_GROUP.
point must be a valid EC_POINT on |group|.
x and y, if non-NULL, must be writable BIGNUMs.
Caller must check the return value.
BN_CTX may be NULL; if provided it is ignored.

functions.name: EC_POINT_get_affine_coordinates
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EC_POINT_get_affine_coordinates(const EC_GROUP *group, const EC_POINT *point, BIGNUM *x, BIGNUM *y, BN_CTX *ctx);
functions.description: Alias of EC_POINT_get_affine_coordinates_GFp; converts |point| to affine coordinates and writes x and/or y. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.
requirements: Same as EC_POINT_get_affine_coordinates_GFp.

functions.name: EC_POINT_set_affine_coordinates_GFp
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EC_POINT_set_affine_coordinates_GFp(const EC_GROUP *group, EC_POINT *point, const BIGNUM *x, const BIGNUM *y, BN_CTX *ctx);
functions.description: Sets |point| to the affine coordinates (x, y) on |group|. Returns 1 on success or 0 on error. It is an error if the point is not on the curve. ctx is ignored and may be NULL.
requirements: group must be a valid EC_GROUP.
point must be a valid EC_POINT belonging to |group|.
x and y must represent a point on the curve; otherwise the call fails.
Caller must check the return value.
BN_CTX may be NULL; if provided it is ignored.

functions.name: EC_POINT_set_affine_coordinates
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EC_POINT_set_affine_coordinates(const EC_GROUP *group, EC_POINT *point, const BIGNUM *x, const BIGNUM *y, BN_CTX *ctx);
functions.description: Alias of EC_POINT_set_affine_coordinates_GFp; sets |point| to (x, y) with validation that the point lies on the curve. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.
requirements: Same as EC_POINT_set_affine_coordinates_GFp.

functions.name: EC_POINT_point2oct
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT size_t EC_POINT_point2oct(const EC_GROUP *group, const EC_POINT *point, point_conversion_form_t form, uint8_t *buf, size_t max_out, BN_CTX *ctx);
functions.description: Serializes |point| to X9.62 format according to |form| and writes to |buf| up to |max_out| bytes. If buf is non-NULL, returns number of bytes written or 0 on error. If buf is NULL, returns the number of bytes required. ctx is ignored.
requirements: group must be a valid EC_GROUP; form must be a supported conversion form (compressed or uncompressed; hybrid is unsupported).
point must be a valid EC_POINT on |group|.
If buf is provided, it must point to a buffer of at least max_out bytes.
Caller must check the return value for 0 (error).
BN_CTX may be NULL; if provided it is ignored.

functions.name: EC_POINT_point2buf
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT size_t EC_POINT_point2buf(const EC_GROUP *group, const EC_POINT *point, point_conversion_form_t form, uint8_t **out_buf, BN_CTX *ctx);
functions.description: Serializes |point| to X9.62 format according to |form| into a newly-allocated buffer, sets *out_buf, and returns the length, or 0 on error. Caller must free *out_buf with OPENSSL_free. ctx is ignored.
requirements: group must be a valid EC_GROUP; form must be supported.
point must be a valid EC_POINT on |group|.
out_buf must be non-NULL; on success, *out_buf will be non-NULL and must be freed with OPENSSL_free.
Caller must check the return value for 0 (error).
BN_CTX may be NULL; if provided it is ignored.

functions.name: EC_POINT_point2cbb
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EC_POINT_point2cbb(CBB *out, const EC_GROUP *group, const EC_POINT *point, point_conversion_form_t form, BN_CTX *ctx);
functions.description: Serializes |point| to X9.62 format according to |form| and appends it to |out| (a CBB). Returns 1 on success, 0 on error. ctx is ignored.
requirements: out must be a valid CBB initialized for appending.
group must be a valid EC_GROUP; form must be supported.
point must be a valid EC_POINT on |group|.
Caller must check the return value.
BN_CTX may be NULL; if provided it is ignored.

functions.name: EC_POINT_oct2point
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EC_POINT_oct2point(const EC_GROUP *group, EC_POINT *point, const uint8_t *buf, size_t len, BN_CTX *ctx);
functions.description: Parses an X9.62-encoded point from |buf| of length |len| and sets |point|. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error. It is an error if the encoding is invalid or the point is not on the curve. ctx may be NULL.
requirements: group must be a valid EC_GROUP.
point must be a valid EC_POINT belonging to |group|.
buf must point to len bytes containing a valid X9.62 point for |group|.
Caller must check the return value.
BN_CTX may be NULL.

functions.name: EC_POINT_set_compressed_coordinates_GFp
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EC_POINT_set_compressed_coordinates_GFp(const EC_GROUP *group, EC_POINT *point, const BIGNUM *x, int y_bit, BN_CTX *ctx);
functions.description: Sets |point| to the unique curve point with x-coordinate |x| and the y-bit specified by |y_bit| (per X9.62 compressed form). Returns 1 on success, 0 on error. ctx may be NULL.
requirements: group must be a valid EC_GROUP.
point must be a valid EC_POINT belonging to |group|.
x must be a valid BIGNUM in the field range for |group|.
y_bit must be 0 or 1 (specifies which y root).
Caller must check the return value.
BN_CTX may be NULL.

functions.name: EC_POINT_add
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EC_POINT_add(const EC_GROUP *group, EC_POINT *r, const EC_POINT *a, const EC_POINT *b, BN_CTX *ctx);
functions.description: Computes r = a + b in |group|. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error. ctx is ignored and may be NULL.
requirements: group must be a valid EC_GROUP.
r must be a valid EC_POINT belonging to |group| and not alias improperly if implementation forbids; aliasing with a or b is generally supported but unspecified by this header.
a and b must be valid EC_POINTs on |group|.
Caller must check the return value.
BN_CTX may be NULL; if provided it is ignored.

functions.name: EC_POINT_dbl
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EC_POINT_dbl(const EC_GROUP *group, EC_POINT *r, const EC_POINT *a, BN_CTX *ctx);
functions.description: Computes r = 2a in |group|. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error. ctx is ignored and may be NULL.
requirements: group must be a valid EC_GROUP.
r and a must be valid EC_POINTs belonging to |group|.
Caller must check the return value.
BN_CTX may be NULL; if provided it is ignored.

functions.name: EC_POINT_invert
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EC_POINT_invert(const EC_GROUP *group, EC_POINT *a, BN_CTX *ctx);
functions.description: Replaces |a| with its negation in |group| (computes -a). Returns 1 on success, 0 on error. ctx is ignored and may be NULL.
requirements: group must be a valid EC_GROUP.
a must be a valid EC_POINT belonging to |group|.
Caller must check the return value.
BN_CTX may be NULL; if provided it is ignored.

functions.name: EC_POINT_mul
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EC_POINT_mul(const EC_GROUP *group, EC_POINT *r, const BIGNUM *n, const EC_POINT *q, const BIGNUM *m, BN_CTX *ctx);
functions.description: Computes r = generator*n + q*m. Any of n or (q,m) may be NULL to omit that term. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error. ctx may be NULL.
requirements: group must be a valid EC_GROUP with a defined generator if n is non-NULL.
r must be a valid EC_POINT in |group|.
If q is non-NULL then m must be non-NULL and vice versa for that term to be used.
n and m, if provided, must be valid scalars (in the correct range for the group).
Caller must check the return value.
BN_CTX may be NULL.

functions.name: EC_hash_to_curve_p256_xmd_sha256_sswu
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EC_hash_to_curve_p256_xmd_sha256_sswu(const EC_GROUP *group, EC_POINT *out, const uint8_t *dst, size_t dst_len, const uint8_t *msg, size_t msg_len);
functions.description: Implements RFC 9380 P256_XMD:SHA-256_SSWU_RO_: hashes msg with domain separation tag dst to a uniformly random point on P-256 and writes it to out. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.
requirements: group must be the P-256 group (EC_group_p256 or equivalent).
out must be a valid EC_POINT belonging to |group|.
dst may be NULL only if dst_len is 0; otherwise must point to dst_len bytes.
msg must point to msg_len bytes (msg_len may be zero).
Caller must check the return value.
The dst value must be unique per protocol and per hash_to_curve vs encode_to_curve per RFC 9380 §3.1.

functions.name: EC_hash_to_curve_p384_xmd_sha384_sswu
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EC_hash_to_curve_p384_xmd_sha384_sswu(const EC_GROUP *group, EC_POINT *out, const uint8_t *dst, size_t dst_len, const uint8_t *msg, size_t msg_len);
functions.description: Implements RFC 9380 P384_XMD:SHA-384_SSWU_RO_: hashes msg with domain separation tag dst to a uniformly random point on P-384 and writes it to out. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.
requirements: group must be the P-384 group (EC_group_p384 or equivalent).
out must be a valid EC_POINT belonging to |group|.
dst may be NULL only if dst_len is 0; otherwise must point to dst_len bytes.
msg must point to msg_len bytes (msg_len may be zero).
Caller must check the return value.
The dst value must be unique per protocol and per primitive per RFC 9380 §3.1.

functions.name: EC_encode_to_curve_p256_xmd_sha256_sswu
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EC_encode_to_curve_p256_xmd_sha256_sswu(const EC_GROUP *group, EC_POINT *out, const uint8_t *dst, size_t dst_len, const uint8_t *msg, size_t msg_len);
functions.description: Implements RFC 9380 P256_XMD:SHA-256_SSWU_NU_: encodes msg with domain separation tag dst to a nonuniform point on P-256 and writes it to out. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error. Output distribution is nonuniform (see RFC 9380 §10.4).
requirements: group must be the P-256 group (EC_group_p256 or equivalent).
out must be a valid EC_POINT belonging to |group|.
dst may be NULL only if dst_len is 0; otherwise must point to dst_len bytes.
msg must point to msg_len bytes (msg_len may be zero).
Caller must check the return value.
The dst value must be unique per protocol and distinct from the hash_to_curve dst per RFC 9380 §3.1.

functions.name: EC_encode_to_curve_p384_xmd_sha384_sswu
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EC_encode_to_curve_p384_xmd_sha384_sswu(const EC_GROUP *group, EC_POINT *out, const uint8_t *dst, size_t dst_len, const uint8_t *msg, size_t msg_len);
functions.description: Implements RFC 9380 P384_XMD:SHA-384_SSWU_NU_: encodes msg with domain separation tag dst to a nonuniform point on P-384 and writes it to out. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error. Output distribution is nonuniform.
requirements: group must be the P-384 group (EC_group_p384 or equivalent).
out must be a valid EC_POINT belonging to |group|.
dst may be NULL only if dst_len is 0; otherwise must point to dst_len bytes.
msg must point to msg_len bytes (msg_len may be zero).
Caller must check the return value.
The dst value must be unique per protocol and distinct from the hash_to_curve dst per RFC 9380 §3.1.

functions.name: EC_GROUP_free
functions.description: Releases a reference to |group| if it was created dynamically by EC_GROUP_new_curve_GFp. Does nothing for static built-in groups. Provided for OpenSSL compatibility.
requirements: group may be NULL.
Only needed for groups created by EC_GROUP_new_curve_GFp; it is optional for static groups.

functions.name: EC_GROUP_dup
functions.description: Returns |group| with incremented refcount if it was a dynamic group created by EC_GROUP_new_curve_GFp; returns the same pointer for static groups. Provided for OpenSSL compatibility.
requirements: group must be a valid EC_GROUP.
Caller must check the return value for NULL on failure.
Returned pointer must be freed with EC_GROUP_free if it refers to a dynamic group.

functions.name: EC_GROUP_new_curve_GFp
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT EC_GROUP *EC_GROUP_new_curve_GFp(const BIGNUM *p, const BIGNUM *a, const BIGNUM *b, BN_CTX *ctx);
functions.description: Creates a new arbitrary short-Weierstrass curve group over GF(p) with equation y^2 = x^3 + a·x + b. Returns the new group or NULL on error. The resulting group has no generator until set with EC_GROUP_set_generator. This function is deprecated and intended only for legacy compatibility; arbitrary curves may violate required preconditions and lead to undefined or incorrect results in later operations.
requirements: p, a, b must be valid BIGNUMs; parameters must define a valid short-Weierstrass curve over GF(p).
Caller must check for NULL on failure.
The returned group must be managed with EC_GROUP_dup/EC_GROUP_free.
Before use in most EC operations, a generator must be set via EC_GROUP_set_generator.
Caller must not pass attacker-controlled invalid parameters; behavior may be insecure or undefined as documented.

functions.name: EC_GROUP_set_generator
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EC_GROUP_set_generator(EC_GROUP *group, const EC_POINT *generator, const BIGNUM *order, const BIGNUM *cofactor);
functions.description: Sets the generator, order, and cofactor for a group created by EC_GROUP_new_curve_GFp. May only be used once per such group. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.
requirements: group must be a group returned by EC_GROUP_new_curve_GFp (not a static built-in group).
generator must be an EC_POINT created for |group| and lie on the curve.
order and cofactor must be valid BIGNUMs; values must be consistent with the generator and curve.
May only be called once per group.
Caller must check the return value.

functions.name: EC_GROUP_get_order
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EC_GROUP_get_order(const EC_GROUP *group, BIGNUM *order, BN_CTX *ctx);
functions.description: Writes the group order into |order| and returns 1 on success, 0 on error. Deprecated in favor of EC_GROUP_get0_order. ctx is ignored and may be NULL.
requirements: group must be a valid EC_GROUP.
order must be a writable BIGNUM.
Caller must check the return value.
BN_CTX may be NULL; if provided it is ignored.

functions.name: EC_GROUP_set_asn1_flag
functions.description: No-op in BoringSSL. Retained for OpenSSL compatibility.
requirements: group must be a valid EC_GROUP.
flag is ignored.

functions.name: EC_GROUP_get_asn1_flag
functions.description: Returns OPENSSL_EC_NAMED_CURVE. Retained for OpenSSL compatibility.
requirements: group must be a valid EC_GROUP.

functions.name: EC_GROUP_method_of
functions.description: Returns a dummy non-NULL EC_METHOD pointer for compatibility. Not intended for method inspection in BoringSSL.
requirements: group must be a valid EC_GROUP.
Returned pointer is opaque/dummy and must not be dereferenced beyond documented functions.

functions.name: EC_METHOD_get_field_type
functions.description: Returns NID_X9_62_prime_field. Present for OpenSSL compatibility.
requirements: meth must be a non-NULL EC_METHOD pointer (e.g., from EC_GROUP_method_of).

functions.name: EC_GROUP_set_point_conversion_form
functions.description: Aborts the process if |form| is not POINT_CONVERSION_UNCOMPRESSED; otherwise does nothing. Provided for compatibility and to discourage compressed/hybrid encodings.
requirements: group must be a valid EC_GROUP.
form must be POINT_CONVERSION_UNCOMPRESSED; other values will abort the process.

functions.name: EC_get_builtin_curves
functions.description: Writes up to max_num_curves entries describing supported built-in curves to out_curves and returns the total number of supported curves. Use to enumerate curves.
requirements: If out_curves is non-NULL, it must point to an array with at least max_num_curves elements.
Caller should use the return value to size the buffer or know how many entries were truncated.

functions.name: EC_POINT_clear_free
functions.description: Alias for EC_POINT_free in BoringSSL; frees an EC_POINT. Present for compatibility.
requirements: point may be NULL or a valid EC_POINT pointer owned by the caller.

functions.name: EC_KEY_new
functions.description: Allocates and returns a new, empty EC_KEY object. Use to create an EC key handle before configuring a group and keys.
requirements: Returns NULL on allocation or initialization failure; callers must check for NULL.
The returned EC_KEY must be freed with EC_KEY_free to avoid memory leaks.

functions.name: EC_KEY_new_method
functions.description: Allocates and returns a new EC_KEY object bound to the specified ENGINE. Behavior is otherwise the same as EC_KEY_new.
requirements: engine specifies the ENGINE to use; may be NULL to use the default.
Returns NULL on failure; callers must check for NULL.
The returned EC_KEY must be freed with EC_KEY_free.

functions.name: EC_KEY_new_by_curve_name
functions.description: Allocates and returns a new EC_KEY configured for the EC group identified by the given NID. Useful for quickly creating a key for a known named curve.
requirements: nid must be a valid curve NID recognized by the library.
Returns NULL on error; callers must check for NULL.
The returned EC_KEY must be freed with EC_KEY_free.

functions.name: EC_KEY_free
functions.description: Frees an EC_KEY and all data it owns.
requirements: key may be NULL (no effect).
After calling, the pointer must not be used again.

functions.name: EC_KEY_dup
functions.description: Creates a new EC_KEY as a copy of src.
requirements: src must be a valid, initialized EC_KEY.
Returns NULL on allocation or copy failure; callers must check for NULL.
The returned EC_KEY must be freed with EC_KEY_free.

functions.name: EC_KEY_up_ref
functions.description: Increments the reference count of key and returns 1. Non-mutating with respect to key material and may be used concurrently.
requirements: key must be a valid EC_KEY pointer.
Return value is 1 on success; 0 indicates failure and should be handled.
Maintain corresponding EC_KEY_free calls to balance references.

functions.name: EC_KEY_is_opaque
functions.description: Returns 1 if key is opaque (key material not exposed), otherwise 0.
requirements: key must be a valid EC_KEY pointer.

functions.name: EC_KEY_get0_group
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the EC_GROUP configured on key without transferring ownership.
requirements: key must be a valid EC_KEY pointer.
Returned pointer is owned by key and must not be freed or modified.

functions.name: EC_KEY_set_group
functions.description: Sets the EC_GROUP used by key to group.
requirements: key must be a valid EC_KEY pointer.
group must be a valid EC_GROUP pointer.
Returns 1 on success, 0 if key is already configured with a different group or on error.

functions.name: EC_KEY_get0_private_key
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the private key BIGNUM inside key, or NULL if unset. No ownership transfer.
requirements: key must be a valid EC_KEY pointer.
Returned BIGNUM is owned by key and must not be modified or freed by the caller.

functions.name: EC_KEY_set_private_key
functions.description: Sets key’s private key to priv.
requirements: key must already have a group configured (via EC_KEY_set_group or EC_KEY_new_by_curve_name).
priv must be a valid BIGNUM for the group (implicit from API; exact range not documented here).
Returns 1 on success and 0 otherwise.

functions.name: EC_KEY_get0_public_key
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the EC_POINT public key inside key, or NULL if unset. No ownership transfer.
requirements: key must be a valid EC_KEY pointer.
Returned EC_POINT is owned by key and must not be modified or freed by the caller.

functions.name: EC_KEY_set_public_key
functions.description: Copies pub into key as the public key.
requirements: key must already have a group configured (via EC_KEY_set_group or EC_KEY_new_by_curve_name).
pub must belong to key’s group.
pub must not be the point at infinity.
Returns 1 on success and 0 otherwise.

functions.name: EC_KEY_get_enc_flags
functions.description: Returns the encoding flags (bitwise OR of EC_PKEY_* values) for key.
requirements: key must be a valid EC_KEY pointer.

functions.name: EC_KEY_set_enc_flags
functions.description: Sets the encoding flags (bitwise OR of EC_PKEY_* values) for key.
requirements: key must be a valid EC_KEY pointer.
flags should be a combination of EC_PKEY_* constants (e.g., EC_PKEY_NO_PARAMETERS, EC_PKEY_NO_PUBKEY).

functions.name: EC_KEY_get_conv_form
functions.description: Returns the point conversion form to be used for key.
requirements: key must be a valid EC_KEY pointer.

functions.name: EC_KEY_set_conv_form
functions.description: Sets the point conversion form to be used for key.
requirements: key must be a valid EC_KEY pointer.
cform must be a valid point_conversion_form_t value.

functions.name: EC_KEY_check_key
functions.description: Performs internal validity checks on key, possibly including an expensive subgroup check of the public key. Returns 1 if all checks pass, 0 otherwise. Error details are left on the error stack.
requirements: key must be a valid EC_KEY with necessary fields set for checking (group, and key material as applicable).
Caller should inspect the OpenSSL/BoringSSL error stack on failure for details.

functions.name: EC_KEY_check_fips
functions.description: Performs a signing pairwise consistency test (FIPS 140-2 4.9.2) and the consistency test from SP 800-56Ar3 5.6.2.1.4. Returns 1 on success, 0 otherwise.
requirements: key must be a valid EC_KEY configured for the intended operation (signing or key agreement as applicable).
Caller should treat 0 as failure and consult the error stack as needed.

functions.name: EC_KEY_set_public_key_affine_coordinates
functions.description: Sets key’s public key from affine coordinates (x, y). Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.
requirements: key must have a group configured.
x and y must represent a point on key’s curve.
Returns 0 if the coordinates are invalid for the curve.

functions.name: EC_KEY_oct2key
functions.signature: int EC_KEY_oct2key(EC_KEY *key, const uint8_t *in, size_t len, BN_CTX *ctx);
functions.description: Decodes an EC public key from X9.62 octet form in into key’s public key. Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure. ctx is ignored and may be NULL.
requirements: key must already have a group configured.
in must point to len bytes of the encoded point in X9.62 format.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: EC_KEY_key2buf
functions.signature: size_t EC_KEY_key2buf(const EC_KEY *key, point_conversion_form_t form, uint8_t **out_buf, BN_CTX *ctx);
functions.description: Encodes key’s public key point to a newly-allocated buffer, like EC_POINT_point2buf. ctx is ignored. Returns the size of the result in bytes, or 0 on error. Caller must free *out_buf with OPENSSL_free.
requirements: key must have a public key set belonging to its configured group.
out_buf must be a valid pointer to receive the allocated buffer; on success, *out_buf must be freed with OPENSSL_free.
form selects the point conversion form.
Returns 0 on error and leaves allocation undefined.

functions.name: EC_KEY_oct2priv
functions.signature: int EC_KEY_oct2priv(EC_KEY *key, const uint8_t *in, size_t len);
functions.description: Sets key’s private key by decoding a big-endian, zero-padded integer from in of length len. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.
requirements: The input must be padded to the size of key’s group order.
key must have a group configured.
in must point to len bytes of input.

functions.name: EC_KEY_priv2oct
functions.signature: size_t EC_KEY_priv2oct(const EC_KEY *key, uint8_t *out, size_t max_out);
functions.description: Serializes key’s private key as a big-endian integer, zero-padded to the size of the group order, writing up to max_out bytes to out. Returns the number of bytes written on success, 0 on error. If out is NULL, returns the required length without writing.
requirements: key must have a private key set and a group configured.
out must point to a buffer of at least max_out bytes, unless out is NULL to query the required size.
Caller must check for 0 to detect errors.

functions.name: EC_KEY_priv2buf
functions.description: Allocates and writes the zero-padded big-endian private key into a new buffer, setting *out_buf. Returns the size in bytes on success, 0 on error. Caller must free *out_buf with OPENSSL_free.
requirements: key must have a private key set and a group configured.
out_buf must be a valid pointer to receive the allocated buffer; on success, *out_buf must be freed with OPENSSL_free.
Caller must handle a 0 return and not use *out_buf if allocation or serialization fails.

functions.name: EC_KEY_generate_key
functions.description: Generates a random private key for key’s group and computes the corresponding public key, storing both in key. Returns 1 on success, 0 otherwise.
requirements: key must have a group configured before calling.
Caller must check the return value for success.

functions.name: EC_KEY_generate_key_fips
functions.description: Like EC_KEY_generate_key but performs additional checks for FIPS compliance, including both types of pairwise consistency tests (PCT). Returns 1 on success, 0 otherwise.
requirements: key must have a group configured before calling.
Caller must check the return value and treat 0 as failure.

functions.name: EC_KEY_derive_from_secret
functions.signature: EC_KEY *EC_KEY_derive_from_secret(const EC_GROUP *group, const uint8_t *secret, size_t secret_len);
functions.description: Deterministically derives an EC private key for group from secret using HKDF-SHA256. Returns a newly-allocated EC_KEY on success or NULL on error. Note: This is an arbitrary scheme; for new protocols prefer X25519/Ed25519 dedicated imports.
requirements: group must be a valid EC_GROUP pointer for the target curve.
secret must be a byte string not reused in any other algorithm; if using a base secret for multiple operations, derive distinct values first (e.g., via HKDF).
secret must point to at least secret_len bytes.
Caller must free the returned EC_KEY with EC_KEY_free.
Returns NULL on error; caller must check.

functions.name: EC_KEY_parse_private_key
functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded ECPrivateKey (RFC 5915) from cbs, advancing cbs. If group is non-NULL, the parameters field may be omitted (but must match group if present); otherwise parameters are required. Returns a newly-allocated EC_KEY on success or NULL on error.
requirements: cbs must be an initialized CBS positioned at the start of a DER-encoded ECPrivateKey structure.
If group is NULL, the input must include parameters; if group is non-NULL and parameters are present, they must match group.
On success, caller owns the returned EC_KEY and must free it with EC_KEY_free.
On failure (NULL), input CBS position is unspecified; caller should handle parse errors.

functions.name: EC_KEY_marshal_private_key
functions.signature: int EC_KEY_marshal_private_key(CBB *cbb, const EC_KEY *key, unsigned enc_flags);
functions.description: Marshals key as a DER-encoded ECPrivateKey (RFC 5915) and appends it to cbb. enc_flags is a bitwise-OR of EC_PKEY_* values controlling omitted fields. Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure.
requirements: cbb must be an initialized CBB ready for appending DER output.
key must be a valid EC_KEY, typically with parameters and private key set for a complete structure.
enc_flags must be a combination of EC_PKEY_* flags (e.g., EC_PKEY_NO_PARAMETERS, EC_PKEY_NO_PUBKEY).
Caller must check the return value and handle 0 as failure.

functions.name: EC_KEY_parse_curve_name
functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded OBJECT IDENTIFIER from cbs as a curve name, advancing cbs. Returns the decoded EC_GROUP pointer or NULL on error. The returned pointer may be freed with EC_GROUP_free but is actually static; freeing is optional.
requirements: cbs must be an initialized CBS positioned at a DER OBJECT IDENTIFIER representing a supported curve.
Caller may call EC_GROUP_free on the result, though it is optional due to static storage.
Caller must check for NULL on failure.

functions.name: EC_KEY_marshal_curve_name
functions.description: Marshals group as a DER-encoded OBJECT IDENTIFIER and appends to cbb. Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure.
requirements: cbb must be an initialized CBB ready for appending DER output.
group must correspond to a named curve with an OBJECT IDENTIFIER.
Caller must check return value for success.

functions.name: EC_KEY_parse_parameters
functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded ECParameters (RFC 5480) from cbs, advancing cbs. Supports namedCurve and specifiedCurve (the latter deprecated; prefer EC_KEY_parse_curve_name). Returns an EC_GROUP pointer or NULL on error. The returned pointer may be passed to EC_GROUP_free but is actually static; freeing is optional.
requirements: cbs must be an initialized CBS positioned at a DER-encoded ECParameters structure.
Use of specifiedCurve is deprecated; prefer parsing a named curve OID when possible.
Caller must check for NULL on failure.
Caller may call EC_GROUP_free on the result, though freeing is optional.

functions.name: EC_KEY_get_ex_new_index
functions.signature: int EC_KEY_get_ex_new_index(long argl, void *argp, CRYPTO_EX_unused *unused, CRYPTO_EX_dup *dup_unused, CRYPTO_EX_free *free_func);
functions.description: Obtains a new application-specific ex_data index for EC_KEY objects. Wrapper around the generic ex_data mechanism (see ex_data.h).
requirements: Arguments follow the ex_data API conventions; see ex_data.h for exact semantics.
Returns a non-negative index on success or a negative value on error; callers must check the return value before use.

functions.name: EC_KEY_set_ex_data
functions.description: Associates application-defined data with an EC_KEY at the given ex_data index. Wrapper around the generic ex_data mechanism.
requirements: r must be a valid EC_KEY pointer.
idx must be a valid index previously obtained via EC_KEY_get_ex_new_index or compatible ex_data APIs.
Returns 1 on success and 0 on failure; callers must check.

functions.name: EC_KEY_get_ex_data
functions.description: Retrieves application-defined data previously stored on an EC_KEY at the given ex_data index. Wrapper around the generic ex_data mechanism.
requirements: r must be a valid EC_KEY pointer.
idx must be a valid ex_data index for EC_KEY.
Returns the stored pointer or NULL if not set or on error; callers should distinguish as appropriate.

functions.name: EC_KEY_set_asn1_flag
functions.description: Deprecated no-op. Does nothing.
requirements: None beyond key being a valid pointer if non-NULL.

functions.name: d2i_ECPrivateKey
functions.description: Deprecated. Parses a DER-encoded ECPrivateKey (RFC 5915) from *inp (len bytes) in the d2i style. If *out_key is non-NULL and already has a group configured, the parameters field may be omitted but must match that group if present. On success advances *inp by the bytes consumed and returns the EC_KEY. Use EC_KEY_parse_private_key instead.
requirements: inp must point to a buffer of at least len bytes and will be advanced on success.
If out_key is non-NULL and *out_key has a group set, the input may omit parameters but, if present, they must match the group.
Caller owns the returned EC_KEY and must free it with EC_KEY_free.
On error returns NULL; callers must check.

functions.name: i2d_ECPrivateKey
functions.description: Deprecated. Marshals key as a DER-encoded ECPrivateKey (RFC 5915) in the i2d style. Returns length on success or a non-positive value on error. Use EC_KEY_marshal_private_key instead.
requirements: outp follows i2d conventions: if non-NULL, may be advanced and written to an allocated buffer (see OpenSSL/BoringSSL i2d conventions).
key must be a valid EC_KEY appropriate for serialization.
Caller must check return value; non-positive indicates failure.

functions.name: d2i_ECPKParameters
functions.description: Deprecated. Parses a DER-encoded ECParameters (RFC 5480) from *inp (len bytes) in the d2i style. Recognizes specifiedCurve only for curves already supported as named curves. Use EC_KEY_parse_parameters or EC_KEY_parse_curve_name instead.
requirements: inp must point to at least len bytes and is advanced on success.
Returns an EC_GROUP pointer or NULL on error; caller must check and free with EC_GROUP_free if appropriate.

functions.name: i2d_ECPKParameters
functions.description: Deprecated. Marshals group as a DER-encoded ECParameters (RFC 5480) in the i2d style. Use EC_KEY_marshal_curve_name instead.
requirements: outp follows i2d conventions for buffer allocation/advancement.
group must represent a supported curve.
Returns a length on success, non-positive on error; callers must check.

functions.name: d2i_ECParameters
functions.description: Deprecated. Parses a DER-encoded ECParameters (RFC 5480) from *inp (len bytes) and returns an EC_KEY with parameters only (no key). Use EC_KEY_parse_parameters or EC_KEY_parse_curve_name instead.
requirements: inp must point to at least len bytes and is advanced on success.
Returns an EC_KEY on success (caller must free with EC_KEY_free) or NULL on error; callers must check.

functions.name: i2d_ECParameters
functions.description: Deprecated. Marshals key’s parameters as a DER-encoded OBJECT IDENTIFIER in the i2d style. Use EC_KEY_marshal_curve_name instead.
requirements: key must have parameters set.
outp follows i2d conventions for buffer allocation/advancement.
Returns length on success, non-positive on error; callers must check.

functions.name: o2i_ECPublicKey
functions.description: Deprecated. Parses an EC point from len bytes at *inp into *out_key. Differs from d2i: *out_key must be non-NULL and already have a group set. On success advances *inp by len and returns *out_key. Use EC_POINT_oct2point instead.
requirements: out_key must be non-NULL and *out_key must have a group set before calling.
inp must point to at least len bytes of input and is advanced by len on success.
Returns *out_key on success or NULL on error; callers must check.

functions.name: i2o_ECPublicKey
functions.description: Deprecated. Marshals the EC point (public key) from key in the i2d style, but returns 0 on error instead of a negative value. Use EC_POINT_point2cbb instead.
requirements: key must have a public key set.
outp follows i2o conventions for buffer allocation/advancement.
Returns a positive length on success and 0 on error; callers must check.

functions.name: ECDH_compute_key
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int ECDH_compute_key(void *out, size_t outlen, const EC_POINT *pub_key, const EC_KEY *priv_key, void *(*kdf)(const void *in, size_t inlen, void *out, size_t *outlen))
functions.description: Computes an Elliptic Curve Diffie–Hellman shared secret from the peer's public key (pub_key) and the caller's private key (priv_key). If kdf is NULL, it copies as many bytes of the raw shared secret as will fit into out (up to outlen). If kdf is non-NULL, it calls the provided KDF with the raw shared secret; the KDF should write its result to out and set *outlen to the number of bytes produced. Returns the number of bytes written to out, or -1 on error. Typical usage is to derive a symmetric key material from an EC key agreement.
requirements: out must point to a writable buffer. When kdf is NULL, it must be at least outlen bytes; when kdf is non-NULL, it must be large enough for the KDF’s output (typically at least the input outlen).
outlen is the maximum number of bytes that may be written when kdf is NULL; when kdf is non-NULL, the KDF receives a pointer to an outlen variable to set the actual number of bytes produced.
pub_key must be a valid EC point (peer public key).
priv_key must be an EC_KEY containing a valid private value (the caller’s private key).
pub_key and priv_key must correspond to the same elliptic curve group (inferred from standard ECDH requirements).

If kdf is provided, it must match the type void *(*)(const void *, size_t, void *, size_t *) and on success should return a non-NULL pointer after writing to out and setting *outlen (per the documented behavior).
Caller must check the return value: -1 indicates error; a non-negative value indicates the number of bytes written to out.

functions.name: ECDH_compute_key_fips
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int ECDH_compute_key_fips(uint8_t *out, size_t out_len, const EC_POINT *pub_key, const EC_KEY *priv_key)
functions.description: Computes an ECDH shared secret from pub_key and priv_key, then hashes it with a fixed SHA function determined by out_len to produce the output. Only SHA-224 (24 bytes), SHA-256 (32 bytes), SHA-384 (48 bytes), and SHA-512 (64 bytes) are supported. Returns 1 on success and 0 on error. Intended to enable ECDH+KDF entirely within a FIPS module without passing an arbitrary KDF function pointer.
requirements: out must point to a writable buffer of at least out_len bytes.
out_len must be exactly one of: 24 (SHA-224), 32 (SHA-256), 48 (SHA-384), or 64 (SHA-512).
pub_key must be a valid EC point (peer public key).
priv_key must be an EC_KEY containing a valid private value (the caller’s private key).
pub_key and priv_key must correspond to the same elliptic curve group (inferred from standard ECDH requirements).
Caller must check the return value: 1 indicates success; 0 indicates error.

functions.name: ECDSA_sign
functions.signature: int ECDSA_sign(int type, const uint8_t *digest, size_t digest_len, uint8_t *sig, unsigned int *sig_len, const EC_KEY *key);
functions.description: Signs a pre-hashed message digest with an EC private key and outputs an ASN.1 (DER) encoded ECDSA signature. The signature is variable-length; callers must allocate a buffer of ECDSA_size(key) bytes and read the actual length from sig_len. The type parameter must be zero.
requirements: digest must be the output of a cryptographic hash function; unhashed inputs are insecure (explicit).
type must be 0 (explicit).
sig must point to a buffer with at least ECDSA_size(key) bytes (explicit).
sig_len must be a valid, writable pointer (inferred from out-param usage).
key should contain a valid EC private key (inferred from signing operation).

functions.name: ECDSA_verify
functions.signature: int ECDSA_verify(int type, const uint8_t *digest, size_t digest_len, const uint8_t *sig, size_t sig_len, const EC_KEY *key);
functions.description: Verifies an ASN.1 (DER) encoded ECDSA signature over a pre-hashed message digest using an EC public key. Returns 1 on valid signature, 0 on invalid signature or error. The type parameter must be zero.
requirements: digest must be the output of a cryptographic hash function; unhashed inputs are insecure (explicit).
type must be 0 (explicit).
sig must point to sig_len bytes containing a DER-encoded ECDSA-Sig-Value (explicit).
key should contain the corresponding EC public key (inferred from verification operation).

functions.name: ECDSA_size
functions.description: Returns the maximum number of bytes needed to store an ASN.1 (DER) encoded ECDSA signature for the given key. Returns 0 if key is NULL or has no group set.
requirements: key must be non-NULL and have an EC group set to obtain a non-zero result (explicit).

functions.name: ECDSA_SIG_new
