functions.description: Allocates and returns a new, empty ECDSA_SIG structure, or NULL on allocation failure.

functions.name: ECDSA_SIG_free
functions.description: Frees an ECDSA_SIG structure and its member BIGNUMs.
requirements: sig must be a pointer previously obtained from ECDSA_SIG_new, ECDSA_do_sign, ECDSA_SIG_parse, ECDSA_SIG_from_bytes, or similar (inferred from ownership semantics).

functions.name: ECDSA_SIG_get0_r
functions.description: Returns the r component of the ECDSA signature.
requirements: sig must be a valid, initialized ECDSA_SIG pointer (explicit).

functions.name: ECDSA_SIG_get0_s
functions.description: Returns the s component of the ECDSA signature.
requirements: sig must be a valid, initialized ECDSA_SIG pointer (explicit).

functions.name: ECDSA_SIG_get0
functions.signature: void ECDSA_SIG_get0(const ECDSA_SIG *sig, const BIGNUM **out_r, const BIGNUM **out_s);
functions.description: Outputs pointers to the r and s components of the ECDSA signature into out_r and out_s if they are non-NULL. Does not transfer ownership.
requirements: sig must be a valid, initialized ECDSA_SIG pointer (explicit).
out_r and out_s may be NULL; if non-NULL they must be writable locations for const BIGNUM* (explicit).

functions.name: ECDSA_SIG_set0
functions.description: Sets the r and s components of sig. On success takes ownership of r and s and returns 1; otherwise returns 0.
requirements: sig must be a valid ECDSA_SIG pointer (explicit).
r must be non-NULL (explicit).
s must be non-NULL (explicit).
On success, caller must not use or free r or s afterwards; ownership is transferred (explicit).

functions.name: ECDSA_do_sign
functions.signature: ECDSA_SIG *ECDSA_do_sign(const uint8_t *digest, size_t digest_len, const EC_KEY *key);
functions.description: Signs a pre-hashed message digest with an EC private key and returns the raw ECDSA_SIG structure (r,s) on success, or NULL on error.
requirements: digest must be the output of a cryptographic hash function; unhashed inputs are insecure (explicit).
key should contain a valid EC private key (inferred from signing operation).

functions.name: ECDSA_do_verify
functions.signature: int ECDSA_do_verify(const uint8_t *digest, size_t digest_len, const ECDSA_SIG *sig, const EC_KEY *key);
functions.description: Verifies an ECDSA_SIG (r,s) over a pre-hashed message digest using an EC public key. Returns 1 on valid signature, 0 on invalid signature or error.
requirements: digest must be the output of a cryptographic hash function; unhashed inputs are insecure (explicit).
sig must be a valid ECDSA_SIG containing r and s (explicit).
key should contain the corresponding EC public key (inferred from verification operation).

functions.name: ECDSA_SIG_parse
functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded ECDSA-Sig-Value from the CBS, advancing the CBS on success. Returns a newly allocated ECDSA_SIG or NULL on error.
requirements: cbs must be initialized to a buffer containing a DER-encoded ECDSA-Sig-Value and have sufficient remaining data; it will be advanced on success (explicit).

functions.name: ECDSA_SIG_from_bytes
functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded ECDSA-Sig-Value from a byte array and returns a newly allocated ECDSA_SIG, or NULL on error.
requirements: in must point to a buffer of length in_len containing a DER-encoded ECDSA-Sig-Value (explicit).

functions.name: ECDSA_SIG_marshal
functions.description: Serializes an ECDSA_SIG as a DER-encoded ECDSA-Sig-Value and appends it to the provided CBB. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.
requirements: cbb must be an initialized CBB ready for appending (explicit).
sig must be a valid ECDSA_SIG (explicit).

functions.name: ECDSA_SIG_to_bytes
functions.description: Serializes an ECDSA_SIG to a DER-encoded ECDSA-Sig-Value and returns it in a newly allocated buffer. On success, sets *out_bytes and *out_len and returns 1; caller must free *out_bytes with OPENSSL_free.
requirements: out_bytes must be non-NULL and will receive a newly allocated buffer (explicit).
out_len must be non-NULL and will receive the length (explicit).
sig must be a valid ECDSA_SIG (explicit).
Caller must free *out_bytes with OPENSSL_free on success (explicit).

functions.name: ECDSA_SIG_max_len
functions.description: Returns the maximum length, in bytes, of a DER-encoded ECDSA-Sig-Value for a curve whose group order is represented in order_len bytes. Returns 0 on overflow.
requirements: order_len should be the byte length of the curve order used with the signature (explicit).

functions.name: ECDSA_sign_p1363
functions.signature: int ECDSA_sign_p1363(const uint8_t *digest, size_t digest_len, uint8_t *sig, size_t *out_sig_len, size_t max_sig_len, const EC_KEY *key);
functions.description: Signs a pre-hashed message digest with an EC private key and writes a fixed-width IEEE P1363 signature (r||s, each zero-padded to order size). The signature length is always ECDSA_size_p1363(key). Returns 1 on success, 0 otherwise.
requirements: digest must be the output of a cryptographic hash function; unhashed inputs are insecure (explicit).
sig must have at least ECDSA_size_p1363(key) bytes available (explicit).
out_sig_len must be a valid, writable pointer; on success it will equal ECDSA_size_p1363(key) (explicit).
max_sig_len must be the size of the sig buffer and must be >= ECDSA_size_p1363(key) (inferred from parameter purpose and documentation about required space).
key should contain a valid EC private key (inferred from signing operation).

functions.name: ECDSA_verify_p1363
functions.signature: int ECDSA_verify_p1363(const uint8_t *digest, size_t digest_len, const uint8_t *sig, size_t sig_len, const EC_KEY *key);
functions.description: Verifies a fixed-width IEEE P1363 signature (r||s) over a pre-hashed message digest using an EC public key. Returns 1 on valid signature, 0 on invalid signature or error.
requirements: digest must be the output of a cryptographic hash function; unhashed inputs are insecure (explicit).
sig must point to sig_len bytes containing a P1363-formatted signature; length should match ECDSA_size_p1363(key) for the curve (explicit/inferred).
key should contain the corresponding EC public key (inferred from verification operation).

functions.name: ECDSA_size_p1363
functions.description: Returns the size, in bytes, of an IEEE P1363-formatted ECDSA signature (fixed width) for the given key. Returns 0 if key is NULL or has no group set.
requirements: key must be non-NULL and have an EC group set to obtain a non-zero result (explicit).

functions.name: ECDSA_sign_with_nonce_and_leak_private_key_for_testing
functions.signature: ECDSA_SIG *ECDSA_sign_with_nonce_and_leak_private_key_for_testing(const uint8_t *digest, size_t digest_len, const EC_KEY *eckey, const uint8_t *nonce, size_t nonce_len);
functions.description: Testing-only signer that behaves like ECDSA_do_sign but uses a caller-supplied nonce k (big-endian) instead of a random one. The nonce is reduced mod the group order and zero-padded to BN_num_bytes(order). May leak private keys; must not be used outside tests.
requirements: digest must be the output of a cryptographic hash function (explicit).
eckey should contain a valid EC private key (inferred from signing operation).
nonce must be provided in big-endian order; it will be reduced modulo the group order and padded to BN_num_bytes(order) (explicit).
Intended for testing only; must not be used in production (explicit).

functions.name: d2i_ECDSA_SIG
functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded ECDSA-Sig-Value from *inp with length len, in the legacy OpenSSL d2i style (see d2i_SAMPLE). Prefer ECDSA_SIG_parse for new code. Returns a newly allocated ECDSA_SIG or NULL on error. Detailed d2i semantics (e.g., *inp advancement and reuse of *out) follow OpenSSL conventions but are not restated here.
requirements: inp must point to a pointer to a buffer of at least len bytes containing a DER-encoded ECDSA-Sig-Value (explicit).
out may be used to receive or reuse an ECDSA_SIG depending on d2i semantics (unknown details; refer to d2i_SAMPLE) (explicitly unknown).
len must be non-negative and represent the length of the input buffer (inferred from type and typical usage).

functions.name: i2d_ECDSA_SIG
functions.description: Serializes an ECDSA_SIG to a DER-encoded ECDSA-Sig-Value in the legacy OpenSSL i2d style (see i2d_SAMPLE). Prefer ECDSA_SIG_marshal for new code. Returns the number of bytes written or a non-positive value on error, following OpenSSL i2d conventions.
requirements: sig must be a valid ECDSA_SIG (explicit).
outp points to a location that may be NULL or an output buffer per i2d semantics; exact allocation/advance behavior follows i2d_SAMPLE and is not restated here (explicitly unknown).

functions.name: ENGINE_new
functions.description: Allocates and returns a new empty ENGINE that uses the default method for all algorithms. Intended as the starting point before installing specific algorithm methods via the setter APIs.
requirements: Must be called before using the returned ENGINE in other ENGINE_* APIs.
Caller owns the returned ENGINE* and must eventually free it with ENGINE_free().
Returns NULL on allocation failure (implied by general C conventions; explicit success/failure not stated).

functions.name: ENGINE_free
functions.description: Decrements the reference counts for all methods linked from the given ENGINE and frees the ENGINE itself. Returns one on completion.
requirements: engine must be a valid ENGINE* previously obtained from ENGINE_new (or otherwise properly initialized).
After return, the ENGINE pointer must not be used again (it is freed).
Return value is 1 on success; no other return values are documented here.

functions.name: ENGINE_set_RSA_method
functions.signature: int ENGINE_set_RSA_method(ENGINE *engine, const RSA_METHOD *method, size_t method_size);
functions.description: Sets the RSA method table on the ENGINE. The method structure is copied (not referenced) using the provided structure size for ABI compatibility. Returns one on success and zero on allocation failure.
requirements: engine must be a valid ENGINE*.
method must point to an RSA_METHOD structure whose first member is the common method header (openssl_method_common_st).
method_size must be the size, in bytes, of the RSA_METHOD structure passed by the caller.
Before calling, the RSA_METHOD should have been zeroed and only the desired function pointers filled; any NULL function pointer fields indicate default behavior should be used.
May be called to override RSA operations for this ENGINE.

functions.name: ENGINE_get_RSA_method
functions.description: Returns the RSA method table currently configured on the ENGINE.
requirements: engine must be a valid ENGINE*.
Returned pointer refers to the ENGINE’s internal copy; caller must not modify or free it.

functions.name: ENGINE_set_ECDSA_method
functions.signature: int ENGINE_set_ECDSA_method(ENGINE *engine, const ECDSA_METHOD *method, size_t method_size);
functions.description: Sets the ECDSA method table on the ENGINE. The method structure is copied (not referenced) using the provided structure size for ABI compatibility. Returns one on success and zero on allocation failure.
requirements: engine must be a valid ENGINE*.
method must point to an ECDSA_METHOD structure whose first member is the common method header (openssl_method_common_st).
method_size must be the size, in bytes, of the ECDSA_METHOD structure passed by the caller.
Before calling, the ECDSA_METHOD should have been zeroed and only the desired function pointers filled; any NULL function pointer fields indicate default behavior should be used.
May be called to override ECDSA operations for this ENGINE.

functions.name: ENGINE_get_ECDSA_method
functions.description: Returns the ECDSA method table currently configured on the ENGINE.
requirements: engine must be a valid ENGINE*.
Returned pointer refers to the ENGINE’s internal copy; caller must not modify or free it.

functions.name: METHOD_ref
functions.description: Increments the reference count of the given method object. Currently a no-op because all methods are static, but provided for API completeness and future-proofing.
requirements: method must point to a method structure whose first member is the common header (openssl_method_common_st).
Should only be used with pointers to valid method structures (e.g., RSA_METHOD, ECDSA_METHOD).

functions.name: METHOD_unref
functions.description: Decrements the reference count of the given method object and frees it if the count reaches zero. Currently a no-op because all methods are static, but provided for API completeness and future-proofing.
requirements: method must point to a method structure whose first member is the common header (openssl_method_common_st).
Should only be used with pointers to valid method structures (e.g., RSA_METHOD, ECDSA_METHOD).

functions.name: bssl::Deleter<ENGINE>::operator()
functions.description: Custom deleter for ENGINE usable with C++ smart pointers in the bssl namespace. Invokes ENGINE_free on the provided pointer, enabling RAII management of ENGINE instances.
requirements: ptr should be an ENGINE* obtained from ENGINE_new (or equivalent) and owned by the smart pointer using this deleter.
Typical implementations tolerate nullptr (no-op) before calling ENGINE_free; this is inferred from BORINGSSL_MAKE_DELETER but not explicitly shown here.

functions.name: ERR_get_error
functions.description: Returns the packed error code for the least recent error on the current thread’s OpenSSL error queue and removes that error from the queue. Returns 0 if the queue is empty. Use to consume errors after OpenSSL API calls fail.
requirements: Must be called on a thread that may have an OpenSSL error queued; returns 0 if none.
Callers should consume errors in order until 0 is returned to fully drain the queue.

functions.name: ERR_get_error_line
functions.description: Like ERR_get_error, but also outputs the source file path and line number where the error was added. Removes that error from the queue; returns 0 if the queue is empty.
requirements: file must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the file path string pointer.
line must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the line number.
The returned file pointer refers to data owned by the error queue and may become invalid after subsequent error-queue operations.

functions.name: ERR_get_error_line_data
functions.signature: uint32_t ERR_get_error_line_data(const char **file, int *line, const char **data, int *flags);
functions.description: Like ERR_get_error_line, but also returns the error-specific data pointer and associated flags. Removes that error from the queue; returns 0 if the queue is empty. If ERR_FLAG_STRING is set in *flags, *data is human-readable.
requirements: file must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the file path pointer.
line must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the line number.
data must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the error-specific data pointer (may be NULL).
flags must be a non-NULL pointer to receive flag bits (bitwise-OR of ERR_FLAG_*).
The error-specific data pointer is owned by the error queue and becomes invalid after the next call that affects the same thread’s error queue.
If ERR_FLAG_MALLOCED is present in *flags, the data’s lifetime is still managed by the library; the caller must not free it.

functions.name: ERR_peek_error
functions.description: Returns the packed error code for the least recent error on the current thread’s error queue without removing it. Returns 0 if the queue is empty.
requirements: Read-only peek; does not modify the queue.
Callers should not assume the peeked error persists after subsequent queue-modifying calls.

functions.name: ERR_peek_error_line
functions.description: Like ERR_peek_error, but also returns the source file path and line number for the least recent error without removing it. Returns 0 if the queue is empty.
requirements: file must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the file path pointer.
line must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the line number.
Returned pointers refer to data owned by the error queue and may become invalid after subsequent error-queue operations.

functions.name: ERR_peek_error_line_data
functions.signature: uint32_t ERR_peek_error_line_data(const char **file, int *line, const char **data, int *flags);
functions.description: Like ERR_peek_error_line, but also returns the error-specific data pointer and flags for the least recent error, without removing it. Returns 0 if the queue is empty. If ERR_FLAG_STRING is set in *flags, *data is human-readable.
requirements: file must be non-NULL to receive the file path pointer.
line must be non-NULL to receive the line number.
data must be non-NULL to receive the error-specific data pointer (may be NULL).
flags must be non-NULL to receive flag bits (bitwise-OR of ERR_FLAG_*).
Returned pointers are owned by the error queue and can become invalid after subsequent queue-affecting calls; the caller must not free them even if ERR_FLAG_MALLOCED is set.

functions.name: ERR_peek_last_error
functions.description: Returns the packed error code for the most recent error on the current thread’s error queue without removing it. Returns 0 if the queue is empty.
requirements: Read-only peek; does not modify the queue.

functions.name: ERR_peek_last_error_line
functions.description: Like ERR_peek_last_error, but also returns the source file path and line number for the most recent error without removing it. Returns 0 if the queue is empty.
requirements: file must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the file path pointer.
line must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the line number.
Returned pointers refer to data owned by the error queue and may become invalid after subsequent error-queue operations.

functions.name: ERR_peek_last_error_line_data
functions.signature: uint32_t ERR_peek_last_error_line_data(const char **file, int *line, const char **data, int *flags);
functions.description: Like ERR_peek_last_error_line, but also returns the error-specific data pointer and flags for the most recent error, without removing it. Returns 0 if the queue is empty. If ERR_FLAG_STRING is set in *flags, *data is human-readable.
requirements: file must be non-NULL to receive the file path pointer.
line must be non-NULL to receive the line number.
data must be non-NULL to receive the error-specific data pointer (may be NULL).
flags must be non-NULL to receive flag bits (bitwise-OR of ERR_FLAG_*).
Returned pointers are owned by the error queue and can become invalid after subsequent queue-affecting calls; the caller must not free them even if ERR_FLAG_MALLOCED is set.

functions.name: ERR_error_string_n
functions.description: Formats a human-readable string for packed_error into buf, writing at most len bytes including the terminating NUL, and returns buf. If len > 0, buf is always NUL-terminated. The format is: error:[8-hex]:[library name]:OPENSSL_internal:[reason string].
requirements: buf must be a non-NULL writable buffer of at least len bytes.
len specifies the maximum number of bytes to write including the NUL terminator; the string will be truncated if necessary.
packed_error may be 0; the resulting string will indicate an unknown/empty error as per library behavior.

functions.name: ERR_lib_error_string
functions.description: Returns a string describing the library that generated packed_error, or a placeholder string if unrecognized.
requirements: No ownership is transferred; returned pointer refers to static/library-managed storage and must not be freed.

functions.name: ERR_reason_error_string
functions.description: Returns a string describing the reason for packed_error, or a placeholder string if unrecognized.
requirements: No ownership is transferred; returned pointer refers to static/library-managed storage and must not be freed.

functions.name: ERR_lib_symbol_name
functions.description: Returns the symbol name of the library that generated packed_error (e.g., "EVP" for ERR_LIB_EVP), or NULL if unrecognized.
requirements: Returned pointer, if non-NULL, refers to static/library-managed storage and must not be freed.

functions.name: ERR_reason_symbol_name
functions.description: Returns the symbol name for the reason of packed_error (e.g., "INTERNAL_ERROR" for ERR_R_INTERNAL_ERROR), or NULL if unrecognized. Errors from ERR_LIB_SYS or user-defined errors will also return NULL.
requirements: Returned pointer, if non-NULL, refers to static/library-managed storage and must not be freed.

functions.name: ERR_print_errors_cb
functions.description: Clears the current thread’s error queue, invoking callback once per error from least recent to most recent, passing a human-readable line and its length. Iteration continues while the callback returns 1 and stops if it returns 0.
requirements: callback must be non-NULL and must return 1 to continue iteration or 0 to stop.
callback must be able to accept a pointer to a human-readable string and its length; it must not assume NUL termination beyond len.
ctx is an opaque pointer passed to the callback unchanged.
Calling this function will clear the thread’s error queue.

functions.name: ERR_print_errors_fp
functions.description: Clears the current thread’s error queue, printing each error to the given FILE*. Output format matches ERR_print_errors_cb’s strings.
requirements: file must be a valid, writable FILE*; must not be NULL.
Calling this function will clear the thread’s error queue.

functions.name: ERR_clear_error
functions.description: Clears the OpenSSL error queue for the current thread.

functions.name: ERR_set_mark
functions.description: Marks the most recent error on the current thread’s queue so ERR_pop_to_mark can pop back to (but not including) this error. Returns 1 if an error was marked, 0 if there were no errors.

functions.name: ERR_pop_to_mark
functions.description: Pops and discards errors from most recent to least recent until (but not including) the most recent marked error. Returns 0 if no marked error was found (all errors removed), 1 otherwise.
requirements: Must be used after ERR_set_mark has marked an error to have a non-zero return; otherwise it will remove all errors and return 0.

functions.name: ERR_get_next_error_library
functions.description: Returns a new library identifier suitable for use as the library argument to ERR_put_error by code that wants to push non-standard (custom) errors.

functions.name: ERR_load_BIO_strings
functions.description: Deprecated/compatibility no-op. Does nothing.

functions.name: ERR_load_ERR_strings
functions.description: Deprecated/compatibility no-op. Does nothing.

functions.name: ERR_load_crypto_strings
functions.description: Deprecated/compatibility no-op. Does nothing.

functions.name: ERR_load_RAND_strings
functions.description: Deprecated/compatibility no-op. Does nothing.

functions.name: ERR_free_strings
functions.description: Deprecated/compatibility no-op. Does nothing.

functions.name: ERR_remove_state
functions.description: Deprecated. Calls ERR_clear_error. The pid parameter is ignored.

functions.name: ERR_remove_thread_state
functions.description: Deprecated. If tid is NULL, clears the current thread’s error queue. Otherwise calls assert(0). Use ERR_clear_error instead; error queues are deleted automatically on thread exit.
requirements: tid must be NULL; passing a non-NULL value will trigger an assertion failure.

functions.name: ERR_func_error_string
functions.description: Returns the string "OPENSSL_internal". Present for compatibility.
requirements: Returned pointer refers to static/library-managed storage and must not be freed.

functions.name: ERR_error_string
functions.description: Deprecated compatibility wrapper for ERR_error_string_n with an implicit buffer length (ERR_ERROR_STRING_BUF_LEN). If buf is NULL, uses and returns a static buffer, which is not thread-safe and may be overwritten by other threads. Prefer ERR_error_string_n.
requirements: If buf is non-NULL, it must point to a writable buffer of at least ERR_ERROR_STRING_BUF_LEN bytes.
If buf is NULL, caller must accept that a static, non-thread-safe buffer is returned.

functions.name: ERR_clear_system_error
functions.description: Clears the system’s error value (e.g., errno).

functions.name: ERR_put_error
functions.signature: void ERR_put_error(int library, int unused, int reason, const char *file, unsigned line);
functions.description: Pushes an error entry onto the current thread’s error queue with the specified library and reason, source file path, and line number, dropping the least recent error if necessary to make space.
requirements: library should be a valid error library code (e.g., ERR_LIB_* or custom from ERR_get_next_error_library).
unused must be provided but is ignored by BoringSSL.
reason should be a valid reason code for the given library.
file should be the source file path string (commonly __FILE__).
line should be the source line number (commonly __LINE__).

functions.name: ERR_add_error_data
functions.description: Concatenates count const char* strings provided as varargs and sets the result as the data string on the most recent error.
requirements: count specifies the number of following const char* arguments.
Each of the count arguments should be a valid pointer to a NUL-terminated C string.
There should be a most recent error present to attach data to; otherwise no data will be set.

functions.name: ERR_add_error_dataf
functions.description: Formats a string using printf-style format and arguments and sets it as the data string on the most recent error.
requirements: format must be a valid printf-style format string.
The provided varargs must match the format string as per printf conventions.
There should be a most recent error present to attach data to; otherwise no data will be set.

functions.name: ERR_set_error_data
functions.description: Sets the data string on the most recent error to data, which must be a NUL-terminated string. flags must include ERR_FLAG_STRING. If ERR_FLAG_MALLOCED is set, ownership of data (allocated with OPENSSL_malloc) is transferred to the library; otherwise, the library saves a copy and the caller retains ownership of the original pointer. Differs from OpenSSL, which would otherwise save the pointer without copying.
requirements: data must be a pointer to a NUL-terminated string.
flags must contain ERR_FLAG_STRING.
If flags contains ERR_FLAG_MALLOCED, data must have been allocated with OPENSSL_malloc and ownership is transferred; the caller must not free it after the call.
If flags does not contain ERR_FLAG_MALLOCED, the library saves a copy; the caller retains and manages the original buffer.
There should be a most recent error present to attach data to; otherwise no data will be set.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_new
functions.description: Allocates and returns a new empty EVP_PKEY key object, or NULL on allocation failure. Use to create a key container before assigning a concrete key type or parsing/decoding into it.
requirements: Callers must check for NULL return to handle allocation failure.
Result must be freed with EVP_PKEY_free to avoid memory leaks.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_free
functions.description: Frees an EVP_PKEY and all associated resources.
requirements: It is safe to pass NULL (no effect).
After calling, the pkey pointer must not be used.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_up_ref
functions.description: Increments the reference count of pkey and returns 1 on success. Non-mutating w.r.t. key contents to allow concurrent non-mutating use.
requirements: pkey must be non-NULL and a valid EVP_PKEY.
Caller must manage lifetime; each up_ref requires a corresponding EVP_PKEY_free.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_is_opaque
functions.description: Returns 1 if the key is opaque (backed by a custom implementation which does not expose key material/parameters), 0 otherwise. Opaque keys cannot be duplicated, exported, or compared.
requirements: pkey must be a valid pointer.
Do not attempt to duplicate/export/compare opaque keys (will be an error).

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_cmp
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_PKEY_cmp(const EVP_PKEY *a, const EVP_PKEY *b);
functions.description: Compares two keys for equality. Returns 1 if equal, 0 if not equal, and a negative value on error. Note: return convention differs from standard memcmp-style.
requirements: a and b must be valid EVP_PKEY pointers.
Caller must handle negative return as error, 1 as equal, 0 as not equal.
Do not use with opaque keys (comparison is an error).

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_copy_parameters
functions.description: Copies algorithm parameters from one key to another of compatible type. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.
requirements: Both to and from must be valid EVP_PKEYs.
Types must be compatible for parameters; otherwise function fails.
Caller must check return value for success.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_missing_parameters
functions.description: Returns 1 if pkey is missing required parameters, 0 otherwise (or 0 if the algorithm does not have parameters).
requirements: pkey must be valid.
Caller must interpret 1 as missing parameters for algorithms that require them.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_cmp_parameters
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_PKEY_cmp_parameters(const EVP_PKEY *a, const EVP_PKEY *b);
functions.description: Compares parameters of two keys. Returns 1 if parameters match, 0 if not, negative on error. Note: return convention differs from usual cmp.
requirements: a and b must be valid EVP_PKEY pointers of compatible types.
Caller must handle negative return as error.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_size
functions.description: Returns the maximum signature size in bytes for the key (e.g., RSA modulus length, or max DER-encoded ECDSA signature length).
requirements: pkey must be valid.
Caller should not assume the actual signature equals this maximum (it may be smaller).

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_bits
functions.description: Returns the nominal bit length of the key (e.g., RSA modulus bits, EC group order bits).
requirements: pkey must be valid.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_id
functions.description: Returns the EVP_PKEY_* type identifier of pkey (e.g., EVP_PKEY_RSA, EVP_PKEY_EC).
requirements: pkey must be valid.
Use this to distinguish EVP_PKEY_RSA vs EVP_PKEY_RSA_PSS, etc.

functions.name: EVP_pkey_rsa
functions.description: Returns the EVP_PKEY_ALG for RSA (rsaEncryption) keys (RFC 8017/3279). Used when parsing/constructing keys to specify RSA algorithm.
requirements: Callers parsing keys must validate RSA size bounds using EVP_PKEY_bits to mitigate DoS.
Returned pointer is library-owned; do not free.

functions.name: EVP_pkey_ec_p224
functions.description: Returns EVP_PKEY_ALG for EC keys restricted to P-224 curve (id-ecPublicKey).
requirements: Curve is not reflected in EVP_PKEY_id; inspect via EVP_PKEY_get_ec_curve_nid.
Returned pointer is library-owned; do not free.

functions.name: EVP_pkey_ec_p256
functions.description: Returns EVP_PKEY_ALG for EC keys restricted to P-256 curve (id-ecPublicKey).
requirements: Use EVP_PKEY_get_ec_curve_nid to inspect curve.
Returned pointer is library-owned; do not free.

functions.name: EVP_pkey_ec_p384
functions.description: Returns EVP_PKEY_ALG for EC keys restricted to P-384 curve (id-ecPublicKey).
requirements: Use EVP_PKEY_get_ec_curve_nid to inspect curve.
Returned pointer is library-owned; do not free.

functions.name: EVP_pkey_ec_p521
functions.description: Returns EVP_PKEY_ALG for EC keys restricted to P-521 curve (id-ecPublicKey).
requirements: Use EVP_PKEY_get_ec_curve_nid to inspect curve.
Returned pointer is library-owned; do not free.

functions.name: EVP_pkey_x25519
functions.description: Returns EVP_PKEY_ALG for X25519 keys as encoded in RFC 8410.
requirements: Returned pointer is library-owned; do not free.

functions.name: EVP_pkey_ed25519
functions.description: Returns EVP_PKEY_ALG for Ed25519 keys as encoded in RFC 8410.
requirements: Returned pointer is library-owned; do not free.

functions.name: EVP_pkey_ml_dsa_44
functions.description: Returns EVP_PKEY_ALG for ML-DSA-44 keys (seed form serialized).
requirements: For standard 'seed' output format, configure OpenSSL provider parameter 'ml-dsa.output_formats' to have 'seed-only' first.
Returned pointer is library-owned; do not free.

functions.name: EVP_pkey_ml_dsa_65
functions.description: Returns EVP_PKEY_ALG for ML-DSA-65 keys (seed form serialized).
requirements: Configure provider to seed-only if standard seed output is required.
Returned pointer is library-owned; do not free.

functions.name: EVP_pkey_ml_dsa_87
functions.description: Returns EVP_PKEY_ALG for ML-DSA-87 keys (seed form serialized).
requirements: Configure provider to seed-only if standard seed output is required.
Returned pointer is library-owned; do not free.

functions.name: EVP_pkey_dsa
functions.description: Returns EVP_PKEY_ALG for DSA keys (legacy; parameters accepted). Keys of this type are deprecated and not usable via generic EVP operations; underlying DSA object can be extracted.
requirements: Considered deprecated; provided for legacy compatibility.
Returned pointer is library-owned; do not free.

functions.name: EVP_pkey_rsa_pss_sha256
functions.description: Returns EVP_PKEY_ALG for id-RSASSA-PSS keys constrained to SHA-256, MGF1-SHA256, salt length >= hash len, trailerField=1. Keys usable only with matching PSS params.
requirements: Callers must distinguish EVP_PKEY_RSA vs EVP_PKEY_RSA_PSS via EVP_PKEY_id, not by EVP_PKEY_get{0,1}_RSA.
Returned pointer is library-owned; do not free.

functions.name: EVP_pkey_rsa_pss_sha384
functions.description: Returns EVP_PKEY_ALG for id-RSASSA-PSS keys constrained to SHA-384, MGF1-SHA384, salt length >= hash len, trailerField=1.
requirements: Use EVP_PKEY_id to distinguish key types.
Returned pointer is library-owned; do not free.

functions.name: EVP_pkey_rsa_pss_sha512
functions.description: Returns EVP_PKEY_ALG for id-RSASSA-PSS keys constrained to SHA-512, MGF1-SHA512, salt length >= hash len, trailerField=1.
requirements: Use EVP_PKEY_id to distinguish key types.
Returned pointer is library-owned; do not free.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_set1_RSA
functions.description: Sets pkey to reference the given RSA key (id-rsaEncryption type). Increments RSA refcount and returns 1 on success, 0 if key is NULL.
requirements: pkey must be valid and mutable.
key must be non-NULL and a valid RSA*.
On success, caller retains its RSA reference and must free appropriately.
This constructs an EVP_PKEY_RSA (not RSA_PSS).

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_assign_RSA
functions.description: Assigns RSA key to pkey, transferring ownership on success. Returns 1 on success, 0 if key is NULL.
requirements: pkey must be valid and mutable.
key must be non-NULL and a valid RSA*.
On success, pkey assumes ownership; caller must not free key separately.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_get0_RSA
functions.description: Returns a non-owning RSA* from pkey, or NULL if not RSA. For compatibility, returns non-NULL for both EVP_PKEY_RSA and EVP_PKEY_RSA_PSS keys.
requirements: pkey must be valid.
Do not assume non-NULL implies EVP_PKEY_RSA; use EVP_PKEY_id to distinguish.
Returned pointer must not be freed by caller.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_get1_RSA
functions.description: Returns a new reference to underlying RSA object if pkey is RSA or RSA_PSS, else NULL.
requirements: pkey must be valid.
Caller must free the returned RSA* with RSA_free when done.
Do not infer EVP_PKEY_RSA; use EVP_PKEY_id.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_set1_DSA
functions.description: Sets pkey to reference the given DSA key. Increments DSA refcount. Returns 1 on success, 0 if key is NULL.
requirements: pkey must be valid and mutable.
key must be non-NULL and valid.
Caller must manage DSA lifetime accordingly.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_assign_DSA
functions.description: Assigns DSA key to pkey, transferring ownership. Returns 1 on success, 0 if key is NULL.
requirements: pkey must be valid and mutable.
key must be non-NULL and valid.
On success, caller must not free key separately.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_get0_DSA
functions.description: Returns a non-owning DSA* if pkey is a DSA key; otherwise NULL.
requirements: pkey must be valid.
Returned pointer must not be freed by caller.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_get1_DSA
functions.description: Returns a new reference to underlying DSA object if pkey is DSA; otherwise NULL.
requirements: pkey must be valid.
Caller must free with DSA_free.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_set1_EC_KEY
functions.description: Sets pkey to reference the given EC_KEY. Increments EC_KEY refcount. Returns 1 on success, 0 if key is NULL.
requirements: pkey must be valid and mutable.
key must be non-NULL and valid.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_assign_EC_KEY
functions.description: Assigns EC_KEY to pkey, transferring ownership. Returns 1 on success, 0 if key is NULL.
requirements: pkey must be valid and mutable.
key must be non-NULL and valid.
On success, caller must not free key separately.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_get0_EC_KEY
functions.description: Returns a non-owning EC_KEY* if pkey is EC; otherwise NULL.
requirements: pkey must be valid.
Do not free returned pointer.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_get1_EC_KEY
functions.description: Returns a new reference to underlying EC_KEY if pkey is EC; otherwise NULL.
requirements: pkey must be valid.
Caller must free with EC_KEY_free.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_set1_DH
functions.description: Sets pkey to reference the given DH key. Increments DH refcount. Returns 1 on success, 0 if key is NULL.
requirements: pkey must be valid and mutable.
key must be non-NULL and valid.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_assign_DH
functions.description: Assigns DH key to pkey, transferring ownership. Returns 1 on success, 0 if key is NULL.
requirements: pkey must be valid and mutable.
key must be non-NULL and valid.
On success, caller must not free key separately.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_get0_DH
functions.description: Returns a non-owning DH* if pkey is DH; otherwise NULL.
requirements: pkey must be valid.
Do not free returned pointer.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_get1_DH
functions.description: Returns a new reference to underlying DH if pkey is DH; otherwise NULL.
requirements: pkey must be valid.
Caller must free with DH_free.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_from_subject_public_key_info
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT EVP_PKEY *EVP_PKEY_from_subject_public_key_info(const uint8_t *in, size_t len, const EVP_PKEY_ALG *const *algs, size_t num_algs);
functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded SubjectPublicKeyInfo from a buffer, restricted to the provided algorithms list. Returns a new EVP_PKEY or NULL on error.
requirements: in must point to DER data of length len.
algs must list supported algorithms; only those are accepted.
Caller must free returned EVP_PKEY with EVP_PKEY_free.
Caller should validate parsed key properties (e.g., RSA size, EC curve) as needed.

functions.name: EVP_parse_public_key
functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded SubjectPublicKeyInfo from a CBS, advancing it. Returns a new EVP_PKEY or NULL on error. Prefer EVP_PKEY_from_subject_public_key_info; this has pitfalls (trailing data handling; fixed default algorithms).
requirements: cbs must be initialized to the DER input; caller must handle any trailing data left in cbs.
Caller must verify the resulting key type and properties (e.g., RSA modulus size, EC curve).
Caller must free returned EVP_PKEY.

functions.name: EVP_marshal_public_key
functions.description: Appends a DER-encoded SubjectPublicKeyInfo for key to the CBB. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.
requirements: cbb must be a valid initialized CBB with sufficient capacity or capable of growth.
key must be a valid EVP_PKEY with a public key component.
Caller must check return value.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_from_private_key_info
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT EVP_PKEY *EVP_PKEY_from_private_key_info(const uint8_t *in, size_t len, const EVP_PKEY_ALG *const *algs, size_t num_algs);
functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded PrivateKeyInfo from a buffer, restricted to provided algorithms list. Attributes, if present, are ignored. Returns a new EVP_PKEY or NULL on error.
requirements: in must point to DER data of length len.
algs must contain supported algorithms to accept.
Caller must free returned EVP_PKEY.
Caller should validate key properties (e.g., RSA size, EC curve).

functions.name: EVP_parse_private_key
functions.description: Parses a DER-encoded PrivateKeyInfo from a CBS, advancing it. Returns a new EVP_PKEY or NULL on error. Prefer EVP_PKEY_from_private_key_info; this has pitfalls (trailing data handling; fixed default algorithms; must validate key properties; attributes ignored).
requirements: cbs must be initialized to input; caller must handle trailing data.
Caller must verify resulting key type and bounds (e.g., RSA key size) to avoid DoS; and EC curve.
Caller must free returned EVP_PKEY.

functions.name: EVP_marshal_private_key
functions.description: Appends a DER-encoded PrivateKeyInfo for key to the CBB. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error. Attributes are not included.
requirements: cbb must be a valid initialized CBB.
key must be a valid EVP_PKEY with a private key component.
Caller must check return value.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_from_raw_private_key
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT EVP_PKEY *EVP_PKEY_from_raw_private_key(const EVP_PKEY_ALG *alg, const uint8_t *in, size_t len);
functions.description: Creates an EVP_PKEY from a raw private key for the specified algorithm (e.g., X25519, Ed25519). Returns new EVP_PKEY or NULL on error.
requirements: alg must be a valid algorithm supporting raw private key format.
in/len must contain the exact raw private key per algorithm (e.g., 32 bytes for X25519/Ed25519).
Caller must free returned EVP_PKEY.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_from_private_seed
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT EVP_PKEY *EVP_PKEY_from_private_seed(const EVP_PKEY_ALG *alg, const uint8_t *in, size_t len);
functions.description: Creates an EVP_PKEY from a private seed for algorithms such as ML-DSA. Returns new EVP_PKEY or NULL on error.
requirements: alg must support private seed serialization (e.g., ML-DSA).
in/len must match algorithm’s seed length (e.g., 32 bytes for ML-DSA seed).
Caller must free returned EVP_PKEY.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_from_raw_public_key
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT EVP_PKEY *EVP_PKEY_from_raw_public_key(const EVP_PKEY_ALG *alg, const uint8_t *in, size_t len);
functions.description: Creates an EVP_PKEY from a raw public key for the specified algorithm. Returns new EVP_PKEY or NULL on error.
requirements: alg must support raw public key format.
in/len must match the algorithm’s raw public key size (e.g., 32 bytes for X25519/Ed25519).
Caller must free returned EVP_PKEY.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_get_raw_private_key
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_PKEY_get_raw_private_key(const EVP_PKEY *pkey, uint8_t *out, size_t *out_len);
functions.description: Retrieves the raw private key bytes for pkey. If out is NULL, sets *out_len to required size. Otherwise writes up to *out_len and sets it to bytes written. Returns 1 on success, 0 if unsupported, no private key, or buffer too small.
requirements: pkey must be valid and of a type supporting raw private keys.
If out is non-NULL, *out_len must be set to buffer capacity on entry.
Caller must handle 0 return for unsupported types or missing private key.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_get_private_seed
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_PKEY_get_private_seed(const EVP_PKEY *pkey, uint8_t *out, size_t *out_len);
functions.description: Retrieves the private seed for pkey (e.g., ML-DSA). If out is NULL, sets *out_len to size. Otherwise writes up to *out_len and sets to bytes written. Returns 1 on success, 0 if unsupported, no private key, or buffer too small.
requirements: pkey must be valid and of a type supporting private seed.
If out is non-NULL, *out_len must specify capacity.
Caller must handle 0 return for unsupported or absent private key.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_get_raw_public_key
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_PKEY_get_raw_public_key(const EVP_PKEY *pkey, uint8_t *out, size_t *out_len);
functions.description: Retrieves the raw public key bytes for pkey. If out is NULL, sets *out_len to required size. Otherwise writes up to *out_len and sets it to bytes written. Returns 1 on success, 0 if unsupported, no public key, or buffer too small.
requirements: pkey must be valid and of a type supporting raw public keys.
If out is non-NULL, *out_len must specify capacity.

functions.name: EVP_DigestSignInit
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_DigestSignInit(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, EVP_PKEY_CTX **pctx, const EVP_MD *type, ENGINE *e, EVP_PKEY *pkey);
functions.description: Initializes ctx for a signing operation using pkey and optional digest type. For single-shot no-prehash algorithms (e.g., Ed25519), type should be NULL and use EVP_DigestSign. Non-mutating on pkey. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must have been initialized with EVP_MD_CTX_init (or created appropriately).
pkey must be a valid private key for the selected algorithm.
If pctx is non-NULL, caller may use *pctx to set signer-specific options.
For no-prehash algorithms, set type to NULL.

functions.name: EVP_DigestSignUpdate
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_DigestSignUpdate(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, const void *data, size_t len);
functions.description: Streams data into a signing operation started with EVP_DigestSignInit for algorithms supporting streaming. Returns 1.
requirements: ctx must be initialized for DigestSign and support streaming; will fail for algorithms without streaming (e.g., Ed25519).
data/len must reference the message bytes.

functions.name: EVP_DigestSignFinal
functions.description: Finalizes streaming signing. If out_sig is NULL, sets *out_sig_len to max size; otherwise requires *out_sig_len capacity and outputs signature and actual length. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must be initialized and updated for a streaming-capable algorithm.
If out_sig is non-NULL, *out_sig_len must be set to buffer capacity.
Use EVP_DigestSign for single-shot algorithms.

functions.name: EVP_DigestSign
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_DigestSign(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, uint8_t *out_sig, size_t *out_sig_len, const uint8_t *data, size_t data_len);
functions.description: Single-shot signing of data using ctx. If out_sig is NULL, sets *out_sig_len to max size; else writes signature and sets actual length. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must be initialized for signing via EVP_DigestSignInit.
If out_sig is non-NULL, *out_sig_len must be set to buffer capacity.
Use for algorithms without streaming or for convenience.

functions.name: EVP_DigestVerifyInit
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_DigestVerifyInit(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, EVP_PKEY_CTX **pctx, const EVP_MD *type, ENGINE *e, EVP_PKEY *pkey);
functions.description: Initializes ctx for signature verification using pkey and optional digest type. For no-prehash algorithms, type should be NULL. Non-mutating on pkey. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must have been initialized with EVP_MD_CTX_init (or equivalent).
pkey must be a valid public key for the algorithm.
If pctx is non-NULL, caller may set verification options via *pctx.

functions.name: EVP_DigestVerifyUpdate
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_DigestVerifyUpdate(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, const void *data, size_t len);
functions.description: Streams data into a verification operation for streaming-capable algorithms. Returns 1.
requirements: ctx must be initialized for DigestVerify and support streaming.
data/len must reference the message bytes used to produce the signature.

functions.name: EVP_DigestVerifyFinal
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_DigestVerifyFinal(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, const uint8_t *sig, size_t sig_len);
functions.description: Finalizes streaming verification; verifies that sig is a valid signature of the streamed data. Returns 1 on success, 0 otherwise.
requirements: ctx must be initialized and updated for a streaming-capable algorithm.
sig/sig_len must reference the signature to verify.

functions.name: EVP_DigestVerify
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_DigestVerify(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, const uint8_t *sig, size_t sig_len, const uint8_t *data, size_t len);
functions.description: Single-shot signature verification of data using ctx. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error or verification failure.
requirements: ctx must be initialized for verification via EVP_DigestVerifyInit.
sig/sig_len must be the signature to verify; data/len the message bytes.

functions.name: EVP_SignInit_ex
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_SignInit_ex(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, const EVP_MD *type, ENGINE *impl);
functions.description: Legacy initialization for signing with a digest type. Returns 1 on success. Prefer EVP_DigestSignInit.
requirements: ctx must be initialized (EVP_MD_CTX_create or EVP_MD_CTX_init).
type must be a valid digest algorithm.

functions.name: EVP_SignInit
functions.description: Deprecated wrapper of EVP_SignInit_ex.
requirements: ctx must be initialized.
type must be a valid digest algorithm.

functions.name: EVP_SignUpdate
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_SignUpdate(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, const void *data, size_t len);
functions.description: Legacy streaming update for signing. Appends data to be signed by EVP_SignFinal. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must be initialized with EVP_SignInit_ex/EVP_SignInit.
data/len must reference input.

functions.name: EVP_SignFinal
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_SignFinal(const EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, uint8_t *sig, unsigned int *out_sig_len, EVP_PKEY *pkey);
functions.description: Legacy signing finalization. Signs the accumulated data using pkey and writes into sig buffer of at least EVP_PKEY_size(pkey). Writes signature length to out_sig_len. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must have been updated via EVP_SignInit/Update.
sig must have capacity >= EVP_PKEY_size(pkey).
out_sig_len must be a valid pointer.
pkey must be a valid private key for the chosen algorithm.
Does not mutate ctx; can be reused to sign longer messages.

functions.name: EVP_VerifyInit_ex
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_VerifyInit_ex(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, const EVP_MD *type, ENGINE *impl);
functions.description: Legacy initialization for signature verification with a digest type. Returns 1 on success. Prefer EVP_DigestVerifyInit.
requirements: ctx must be initialized.
type must be a valid digest algorithm.

functions.name: EVP_VerifyInit
functions.description: Deprecated wrapper of EVP_VerifyInit_ex.
requirements: ctx must be initialized.
type must be a valid digest algorithm.

functions.name: EVP_VerifyUpdate
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_VerifyUpdate(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, const void *data, size_t len);
functions.description: Legacy streaming update for verification. Appends data to be verified by EVP_VerifyFinal. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must be initialized with EVP_VerifyInit_ex/EVP_VerifyInit.
data/len must reference input.

functions.name: EVP_VerifyFinal
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_VerifyFinal(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, const uint8_t *sig, size_t sig_len, EVP_PKEY *pkey);
functions.description: Legacy verification finalization. Verifies sig over accumulated data using pkey. Returns 1 on success, 0 otherwise. Does not mutate ctx.
requirements: ctx must have been updated via EVP_VerifyInit/Update.
sig/sig_len must reference signature to verify.
pkey must be a valid public key for the algorithm.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_print_public
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_PKEY_print_public(BIO *out, const EVP_PKEY *pkey, int indent, ASN1_PCTX *pctx);
functions.description: Prints a textual representation of the public key to a BIO. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: out must be a valid writable BIO.
pkey must be valid.
indent controls formatting; pctx may be NULL.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_print_private
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_PKEY_print_private(BIO *out, const EVP_PKEY *pkey, int indent, ASN1_PCTX *pctx);
functions.description: Prints a textual representation of the private key to a BIO. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: out must be a valid writable BIO.
pkey must be valid and contain a private key.
indent controls formatting; pctx may be NULL.
Handle sensitive output appropriately.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_print_params
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_PKEY_print_params(BIO *out, const EVP_PKEY *pkey, int indent, ASN1_PCTX *pctx);
functions.description: Prints a textual representation of key parameters to a BIO. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: out must be a valid writable BIO.
pkey must be valid.
indent controls formatting; pctx may be NULL.

functions.name: PKCS5_PBKDF2_HMAC
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int PKCS5_PBKDF2_HMAC(const char *password, size_t password_len, const uint8_t *salt, size_t salt_len, uint32_t iterations, const EVP_MD *digest, size_t key_len, uint8_t *out_key);
functions.description: Derives a key using PBKDF2-HMAC with given password, salt, iterations, and digest. Writes key_len bytes to out_key. Returns 1 on success; 0 on allocation failure or if iterations is 0.
requirements: password/password_len specify the input password (password may be NULL with password_len=0 if desired).
salt/salt_len specify the salt (may be NULL with salt_len=0).
iterations must be > 0.
digest must be a valid EVP_MD (e.g., EVP_sha256).
out_key must have at least key_len bytes of space.

functions.name: PKCS5_PBKDF2_HMAC_SHA1
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int PKCS5_PBKDF2_HMAC_SHA1(const char *password, size_t password_len, const uint8_t *salt, size_t salt_len, uint32_t iterations, size_t key_len, uint8_t *out_key);
functions.description: PBKDF2-HMAC with digest fixed to SHA-1. Otherwise same behavior as PKCS5_PBKDF2_HMAC.
requirements: iterations must be > 0.
out_key must have at least key_len bytes of space.
Other input pointers/lengths as per PBKDF2 usage.

functions.name: EVP_PBE_scrypt
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_PBE_scrypt(const char *password, size_t password_len, const uint8_t *salt, size_t salt_len, uint64_t N, uint64_t r, uint64_t p, size_t max_mem, uint8_t *out_key, size_t key_len);
functions.description: Derives a key using scrypt (RFC 7914). Writes key_len bytes to out_key. Returns 1 on success; 0 on allocation failure, exceeding max_mem (or default 32MiB if max_mem=0), or invalid parameters as documented.
requirements: password/password_len specify the input password (password may be NULL with password_len=0 if desired).
salt/salt_len specify the salt (may be NULL with salt_len=0).
r and p must be non-zero.
p must satisfy p <= (2^30 - 1) / r.
N must be a power of two, N <= 2^32, and N <= 2^(128*r/8).
If max_mem is zero, default limit of 32MiB is used; otherwise operation must not exceed max_mem.
out_key must have at least key_len bytes of space.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_CTX_new
functions.description: Allocates a new EVP_PKEY_CTX for operations using an existing key pkey. Returns context or NULL on error.
requirements: pkey must be a valid EVP_PKEY for key-based operations.
Caller must free with EVP_PKEY_CTX_free.
ENGINE* is unused for BoringSSL; pass NULL.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_CTX_new_id
functions.description: Allocates a new EVP_PKEY_CTX for operations that do not use an existing key (e.g., key generation) for a key type id. Returns context or NULL on error.
requirements: id must be a supported EVP_PKEY_* type for this usage.
Caller must free with EVP_PKEY_CTX_free.
ENGINE* is unused; pass NULL.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_CTX_free
functions.description: Frees an EVP_PKEY_CTX and its owned resources.
requirements: It is safe to pass NULL.
After freeing, ctx must not be used.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_CTX_dup
functions.description: Duplicates an EVP_PKEY_CTX, copying its state. Returns a new context or NULL on error.
requirements: ctx must be a valid initialized EVP_PKEY_CTX.
Caller must free returned context with EVP_PKEY_CTX_free.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_CTX_get0_pkey
functions.description: Returns the EVP_PKEY associated with the context (non-owning).
requirements: ctx must be valid.
Returned pointer must not be freed by caller.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_sign_init
functions.description: Initializes the context for a signing operation. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must be valid and associated with a key supporting signing.
Must be called before EVP_PKEY_sign.
Caller may need to set algorithm-specific parameters before signing.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_sign
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_PKEY_sign(EVP_PKEY_CTX *ctx, uint8_t *sig, size_t *sig_len, const uint8_t *digest, size_t digest_len);
functions.description: Signs a pre-hashed digest using ctx. If sig is NULL, writes max signature size to sig_len; otherwise requires capacity in *sig_len and writes signature and actual length. Returns 1 on success. Not for algorithms that do not support pre-hash (e.g., Ed25519).
requirements: ctx must be initialized with EVP_PKEY_sign_init and configured appropriately.
digest must be the output of a hash over the message; unhashed inputs are insecure. Use EVP_DigestSign for hashing + signing.
If sig is non-NULL, *sig_len must be set to buffer capacity; actual signature may be smaller than maximum.
Caller must handle 0 return on error.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_verify_init
functions.description: Initializes the context for a signature verification operation. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must be valid and associated with a key supporting verification.
Must be called before EVP_PKEY_verify.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_verify
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_PKEY_verify(EVP_PKEY_CTX *ctx, const uint8_t *sig, size_t sig_len, const uint8_t *digest, size_t digest_len);
functions.description: Verifies that sig is a valid signature of a pre-hashed digest using ctx. Returns 1 on success, 0 on error/failure. Not for algorithms that do not support pre-hash.
requirements: ctx must be initialized with EVP_PKEY_verify_init.
digest must be the hash value of the message verified; use EVP_DigestVerify for hashing + verifying.
sig/sig_len must contain the signature bytes.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_encrypt_init
functions.description: Initializes the context for an asymmetric encryption operation. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must be valid and associated with an encrypt-capable key (e.g., RSA).
Must be called before EVP_PKEY_encrypt.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_encrypt
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_PKEY_encrypt(EVP_PKEY_CTX *ctx, uint8_t *out, size_t *out_len, const uint8_t *in, size_t in_len);
functions.description: Encrypts input using ctx. If out is NULL, writes max ciphertext size to out_len; otherwise requires capacity in *out_len, writes ciphertext and sets actual length. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must be initialized with EVP_PKEY_encrypt_init and configured (e.g., padding).
If out is non-NULL, *out_len must specify buffer capacity; actual ciphertext may be smaller than maximum.
in/in_len specify plaintext to encrypt.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_decrypt_init
functions.description: Initializes the context for an asymmetric decryption operation. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must be valid and associated with a decrypt-capable key (e.g., RSA private key).
Must be called before EVP_PKEY_decrypt.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_decrypt
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_PKEY_decrypt(EVP_PKEY_CTX *ctx, uint8_t *out, size_t *out_len, const uint8_t *in, size_t in_len);
functions.description: Decrypts input using ctx. If out is NULL, writes max plaintext size to out_len; otherwise requires capacity in *out_len, writes plaintext and sets actual length. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must be initialized with EVP_PKEY_decrypt_init and configured (e.g., padding).
If out is non-NULL, *out_len must specify buffer capacity; actual plaintext may be smaller than maximum.
in/in_len specify ciphertext to decrypt.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_verify_recover_init
functions.description: Initializes the context for public-key decryption (verify-recover) operation, primarily for RSA signature recovery. Rarely used and generally not recommended. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must be valid and associated with a key supporting this operation (RSA).
Understand the security/semantic implications; typically not what you want.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_verify_recover
functions.signature: OPENSSL_EXPORT int EVP_PKEY_verify_recover(EVP_PKEY_CTX *ctx, uint8_t *out, size_t *out_len, const uint8_t *sig, size_t siglen);
functions.description: Performs verify-recover operation. If out is NULL, writes max plaintext size to out_len; otherwise requires capacity in *out_len and writes recovered message and sets actual length. Returns 1 on success. See warnings in init function.
requirements: ctx must be initialized with EVP_PKEY_verify_recover_init and configured appropriately.
If out is non-NULL, *out_len must specify buffer capacity.
sig/siglen specify the input signature/ciphertext.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_derive_init
functions.description: Initializes the context for key derivation (e.g., ECDH). Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must be valid and associated with a key supporting derivation.
Must be called before EVP_PKEY_derive_set_peer and EVP_PKEY_derive.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_derive_set_peer
functions.description: Sets the peer key for key derivation. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must have been initialized with EVP_PKEY_derive_init.
peer must be a valid EVP_PKEY compatible with ctx (e.g., matching group for (EC)DH).

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_derive
functions.description: Derives a shared key. If key is NULL, sets *out_key_len to max length; otherwise requires capacity in *out_key_len and writes derived key and sets actual length. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must be initialized and have peer set (if applicable).
If key is non-NULL, *out_key_len must specify buffer capacity; actual derived key may be smaller than maximum.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_keygen_init
functions.description: Initializes the context for key generation. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must be valid and configured with algorithm-specific parameters (e.g., curve, RSA bits) before EVP_PKEY_keygen, as needed.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_keygen
functions.description: Generates a key according to parameters in ctx. If *out_pkey is non-NULL, it is overwritten; otherwise a new EVP_PKEY is allocated. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must be initialized via EVP_PKEY_keygen_init and configured (e.g., RSA bits, EC curve).
out_pkey must be a valid pointer to receive the result; if *out_pkey is non-NULL it will be replaced.
Caller must free any newly-allocated key with EVP_PKEY_free.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_paramgen_init
functions.description: Initializes the context for parameter generation. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must be valid and configured for algorithms needing parameter generation (e.g., EC curves).

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_paramgen
functions.description: Generates algorithm parameters according to ctx. If *out_pkey is non-NULL, it is overwritten; otherwise a new EVP_PKEY is allocated containing parameters (no key). Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must be initialized via EVP_PKEY_paramgen_init and configured (e.g., EC curve).
out_pkey must be a valid pointer to receive the parameters.
Caller must free any newly-allocated key with EVP_PKEY_free.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_CTX_set_signature_md
functions.description: Sets the digest algorithm for a signature operation. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must be valid and for a signature operation.
md must be a valid digest.
Some algorithms ignore or forbid a digest (e.g., Ed25519).

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_CTX_get_signature_md
functions.description: Gets the digest configured for a signature operation into out_md. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must be valid and for a signature operation.
out_md must be non-NULL.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_CTX_set_rsa_padding
functions.description: Sets RSA padding mode (one of RSA_*_PADDING). Default is RSA_PKCS1_PADDING. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must be valid and associated with RSA operations.
padding must be a valid RSA_*_PADDING constant.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_CTX_get_rsa_padding
functions.description: Gets the current RSA padding mode into out_padding. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must be valid and associated with RSA operations.
out_padding must be non-NULL.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_CTX_set_rsa_pss_saltlen
functions.description: Sets the salt length for RSA-PSS. RSA_PSS_SALTLEN_DIGEST uses hash length (default in BoringSSL); RSA_PSS_SALTLEN_AUTO uses max length when signing and recovered length when verifying; otherwise use explicit byte length. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must be valid and configured for RSA-PSS where applicable.
salt_len must be RSA_PSS_SALTLEN_* or a non-negative explicit length.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_CTX_get_rsa_pss_saltlen
functions.description: Gets the configured RSA-PSS salt length into out_salt_len. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must be valid and associated with RSA-PSS where applicable.
out_salt_len must be non-NULL.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_CTX_set_rsa_keygen_bits
functions.description: Sets RSA modulus size (bits) for key generation. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must be valid and configured for RSA key generation.
bits must be a supported RSA key size.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_CTX_set_rsa_keygen_pubexp
functions.description: Sets RSA public exponent for key generation. On success, ctx takes ownership of e (freed on ctx destruction). Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must be valid and configured for RSA key generation.
e must be non-NULL and valid; ownership is transferred on success.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_CTX_set_rsa_oaep_md
functions.description: Sets the hash used in RSA OAEP padding. Returns 1 on success. Default (if unset) is SHA-1, but callers are recommended to override.
requirements: ctx must be valid and associated with RSA OAEP operations.
md must be a valid digest.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_CTX_get_rsa_oaep_md
functions.description: Gets the RSA OAEP hash into out_md. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must be valid and associated with RSA OAEP operations.
out_md must be non-NULL.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_CTX_set_rsa_mgf1_md
functions.description: Sets the MGF1 hash function (used with RSA-PSS and RSA-OAEP). Returns 1 on success. If unset, defaults to signing hash for PSS and OAEP hash for OAEP.
requirements: ctx must be valid for an operation using MGF1 (RSA-PSS or OAEP).
md must be a valid digest or NULL to use defaults (recommended to leave unset).

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_CTX_get_rsa_mgf1_md
functions.description: Gets the configured MGF1 hash into out_md. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must be valid for an operation using MGF1.
out_md must be non-NULL.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_CTX_set0_rsa_oaep_label
functions.description: Sets the OAEP label to label (label_len bytes). On success, ownership of label is transferred to ctx (freed with OPENSSL_free). Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must be valid and configured for RSA OAEP.
label may be NULL with label_len=0 to clear; otherwise must be heap-allocated using OPENSSL_malloc/OPENSSL_zalloc or compatible allocator.
On success, caller must not free label (ctx owns it).

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_CTX_get0_rsa_oaep_label
functions.description: Returns the internal OAEP label pointer via out_label (may be NULL). Returns length of label on success, negative on error. Note unusual return convention.
requirements: ctx must be valid and configured for RSA OAEP.
out_label must be non-NULL.
Caller must not free the returned pointer.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_get_ec_curve_nid
functions.description: Returns the EC curve NID of pkey (e.g., NID_X9_62_prime256v1), or NID_undef if not EC.
requirements: pkey must be valid.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_get_ec_point_conv_form
functions.description: Returns the EC point conversion form (POINT_CONVERSION_*), or 0 if not EC.
requirements: pkey must be valid.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_CTX_set_ec_paramgen_curve_nid
functions.description: Sets the EC curve used for EVP_PKEY_keygen or EVP_PKEY_paramgen to nid. Returns 1 on success.
requirements: ctx must be valid and configured for EC operations.
nid must be a supported EC curve NID.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_CTX_set_dh_pad
functions.description: Configures handling of leading zeros in DH shared secret for derive operations. pad=0 strips leading zeros (default); pad!=0 keeps fixed-width secret as in PKCS#3. Returns 1 on success. Warning: stripping may leak information (side-channel risk).
requirements: ctx must be valid and an EVP_PKEY_derive operation context.
Caller should prefer pad!=0 to avoid side-channel leakage when appropriate.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_get0
functions.description: OpenSSL-compatibility stub that always returns NULL. Use typed EVP_PKEY_get0_* accessors instead.
requirements: Do not rely on this function to access key material; it returns NULL.

functions.name: OpenSSL_add_all_algorithms
functions.description: No-op in BoringSSL provided for compatibility.
requirements: None.

functions.name: OPENSSL_add_all_algorithms_conf
functions.description: No-op in BoringSSL provided for compatibility.
requirements: None.

functions.name: OpenSSL_add_all_ciphers
functions.description: No-op in BoringSSL provided for compatibility.
requirements: None.

functions.name: OpenSSL_add_all_digests
functions.description: No-op in BoringSSL provided for compatibility.
requirements: None.

functions.name: EVP_cleanup

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_set_type

requirements: If pkey is non-NULL, it must be valid and becomes half-empty (type-only) after call.
type must be one of supported values for this function; currently only useful for EVP_PKEY_X25519 used with EVP_PKEY_set1_tls_encodedpoint.

requirements: pkey must already be configured: EC key must have a group; X25519 requires pkey pre-set to X25519 via EVP_PKEY_set_type.

functions.name: EVP_PKEY_get1_tls_encodedpoint
