import base64
import random
import textwrap
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# This generator emits a PEM file containing a leaf X.509 certificate followed
# by zero or more intermediate certificates. To keep things self-contained and
# valid enough for parsers, we emit minimal, syntactically-correct PEM blocks
# with DER-like payloads that resemble TBSCertificate/Certificate structures.
# The contents are not cryptographically correct, but they follow ASN.1 DER
# structure enough to be parsed by tolerant PEM/ASN.1 loaders. The goal is to
# exercise SSL_CTX_use_certificate_chain_file by providing well-formed PEM
# cert chains of varying sizes and features.

# Helper: DER encoders for a subset needed to craft plausible X.509 certs.

def _der_len(n: int) -> bytes:
    if n < 0x80:
        return bytes([n])
    out = []
    while n > 0:
        out.append(n & 0xff)
        n >>= 8
    out.reverse()
    return bytes([0x80 | len(out)]) + bytes(out)

def _der_tlv(tag: int, payload: bytes) -> bytes:
    return bytes([tag]) + _der_len(len(payload)) + payload

# Universal tags
SEQ = 0x30
INT = 0x02
BIT_STRING = 0x03
OCTET_STRING = 0x04
NULL = 0x05
OID = 0x06
UTF8String = 0x0c
PRINTABLE_STRING = 0x13
IA5String = 0x16
UTCTime = 0x17
GeneralizedTime = 0x18
SET = 0x31
CONTEXT0 = 0xa0
CONTEXT1 = 0xa1
CONTEXT2 = 0xa2
CONTEXT3 = 0xa3

# Build simple Name (RDNSequence) with CN only.

def _der_oid(oid_bytes: bytes) -> bytes:
    return _der_tlv(OID, oid_bytes)

def _encode_oid(oid: str) -> bytes:
    # Basic OID encoder for dotted string, sufficient for 2.5.4.3 etc.
    parts = [int(p) for p in oid.split('.')]
    if len(parts) < 2:
        parts = [1, 3] + parts
    first = 40 * parts[0] + parts[1]
    body = [first]
    for p in parts[2:]:
        stack = []
        stack.append(p & 0x7f)
        p >>= 7
        while p:
            stack.append(0x80 | (p & 0x7f))
            p >>= 7
        body.extend(reversed(stack))
    return _der_tlv(OID, bytes(body))


def _printable_or_utf8(s: str) -> bytes:
    try:
        s.encode('ascii')
        return _der_tlv(PRINTABLE_STRING, s.encode('ascii'))
    except Exception:
        return _der_tlv(UTF8String, s.encode('utf-8', 'ignore'))


def _rdn_cn(common_name: str) -> bytes:
    # RDN: SET of AttributeTypeAndValue: SEQ(OID cn, value)
    cn_oid = _encode_oid('2.5.4.3')
    val = _printable_or_utf8(common_name)
    atv = _der_tlv(SEQ, cn_oid + val)
    rdn = _der_tlv(SET, atv)
    return rdn


def _name(cn: str) -> bytes:
    # Name ::= SEQUENCE OF RDN
    return _der_tlv(SEQ, _rdn_cn(cn))


def _der_int(n: int) -> bytes:
    if n == 0:
        b = b"\x00"
    else:
        tmp = []
        v = n
        while v > 0:
            tmp.append(v & 0xff)
            v >>= 8
        tmp.reverse()
        b = bytes(tmp)
        if b[0] & 0x80:
            b = b"\x00" + b
    return _der_tlv(INT, b)


def _der_utctime(dt: datetime) -> bytes:
    # YYMMDDHHMMSSZ
    year = dt.year % 100
    s = f"{year:02d}{dt.month:02d}{dt.day:02d}{dt.hour:02d}{dt.minute:02d}{dt.second:02d}Z"
    return _der_tlv(UTCTime, s.encode('ascii'))


def _der_generalizedtime(dt: datetime) -> bytes:
    s = f"{dt.year:04d}{dt.month:02d}{dt.day:02d}{dt.hour:02d}{dt.minute:02d}{dt.second:02d}Z"
    return _der_tlv(GeneralizedTime, s.encode('ascii'))


def _validity(not_before: datetime, not_after: datetime) -> bytes:
    # Use UTCTime for years < 2050 else GeneralizedTime
    def enc(dt: datetime) -> bytes:
        if 1950 <= dt.year < 2050:
            return _der_utctime(dt)
        return _der_generalizedtime(dt)
    return _der_tlv(SEQ, enc(not_before) + enc(not_after))


def _algorithm_identifier_sha256() -> bytes:
    sha256_oid = _encode_oid('2.16.840.1.101.3.4.2.1')  # id-sha256
    return _der_tlv(SEQ, sha256_oid + _der_tlv(NULL, b''))


def _algorithm_identifier_rsa() -> bytes:
    rsa_oid = _encode_oid('1.2.840.113549.1.1.1')  # rsaEncryption
    return _der_tlv(SEQ, rsa_oid + _der_tlv(NULL, b''))


def _spki(mod_bytes: bytes, e_bytes: bytes) -> bytes:
    # SubjectPublicKeyInfo ::= SEQ(AlgorithmIdentifier, BIT STRING publicKey)
    # publicKey is RSAPublicKey ::= SEQ(n, e)
    rsapk = _der_tlv(SEQ, _der_tlv(INT, mod_bytes) + _der_tlv(INT, e_bytes))
    bitstr = _der_tlv(BIT_STRING, b"\x00" + rsapk)  # 0 unused bits
    return _der_tlv(SEQ, _algorithm_identifier_rsa() + bitstr)


def _tbscertificate(serial: int, issuer_cn: str, subject_cn: str,
                    not_before: datetime, not_after: datetime,
                    is_ca: bool) -> bytes:
    # Minimal TBSCertificate (v3 with basicConstraints if CA)
    version = _der_tlv(CONTEXT0, _der_tlv(INT, b"\x02"))  # v3 (value 2)
    serial_der = _der_int(serial)
    sig_alg = _algorithm_identifier_sha256()
    issuer = _name(issuer_cn)
    validity = _validity(not_before, not_after)
    subject = _name(subject_cn)
    # Simple deterministic SPKI
    mod = b"\x01" + b"\x00" * 127  # 1024-bit-ish positive integer encoding
    e = b"\x01\x00\x01"  # 65537
    spki = _spki(mod, e)

    # Extensions: basicConstraints if is_ca
    exts = b""
    if is_ca:
        # basicConstraints CA:TRUE
        bc_oid = _encode_oid('2.5.29.19')
        bc_seq = _der_tlv(SEQ, _der_tlv(PRINTABLE_STRING, b"CA") if False else _der_tlv(SEQ, _der_tlv(BOOLEAN:=0x01, b"\xff")))
        # But to keep simple, use DER for basicConstraints ::= SEQUENCE { cA BOOLEAN TRUE }
        bc_inner = _der_tlv(SEQ, _der_tlv(0x01, b"\xff"))
        bc_ext = _der_tlv(SEQ, bc_oid + _der_tlv(OCTET_STRING, bc_inner))
        exts = _der_tlv(SEQ, bc_ext)
    if exts:
        exts = _der_tlv(CONTEXT3, exts)

    tbs = _der_tlv(SEQ, version + serial_der + sig_alg + issuer + validity + subject + spki + exts)
    return tbs


def _certificate(tbs: bytes) -> bytes:
    # Certificate ::= SEQ(tbsCertificate, signatureAlgorithm, signatureValue)
    sig_alg = _algorithm_identifier_sha256()
    # Fake signature bits: just some bytes as BIT STRING (0 unused bits)
    sig = _der_tlv(BIT_STRING, b"\x00" + b"\xAA" * 64)
    return _der_tlv(SEQ, tbs + sig_alg + sig)


def _pem(label: str, der: bytes) -> str:
    b64 = base64.b64encode(der).decode('ascii')
    wrapped = "\n".join(textwrap.wrap(b64, 64))
    return f"-----BEGIN {label}-----\n{wrapped}\n-----END {label}-----\n"


def _make_cert(serial: int, issuer_cn: str, subject_cn: str,
               not_before: datetime, not_after: datetime,
               is_ca: bool) -> bytes:
    tbs = _tbscertificate(serial, issuer_cn, subject_cn, not_before, not_after, is_ca)
    return _certificate(tbs)


def _chain(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)

    now = datetime(2023 + rng.randint(0, 2), rng.randint(1, 12), rng.randint(1, 28),
                   rng.randint(0, 23), rng.randint(0, 59), rng.randint(0, 59))
    dur_days = rng.randint(30, 365 * 2)
    not_before_leaf = now - timedelta(days=rng.randint(0, 30))
    not_after_leaf = not_before_leaf + timedelta(days=dur_days)

    # Decide number of chain certs: 0..3 intermediates
    intermediates = rng.randint(0, 3)

    # Root (self-signed CA)
    root_cn = f"Root CA {rng.randint(1, 9999)}"
    root_der = _make_cert(serial=rng.randint(1, 1 << 20),
                          issuer_cn=root_cn,
                          subject_cn=root_cn,
                          not_before=now - timedelta(days=3650),
                          not_after=now + timedelta(days=3650),
                          is_ca=True)

    # Build intermediates chain
    chain_ders = []
    issuer_cn = root_cn
    for i in range(intermediates):
        icn = f"Intermediate CA {i+1}"
        der = _make_cert(serial=rng.randint(1, 1 << 20),
                         issuer_cn=issuer_cn,
                         subject_cn=icn,
                         not_before=now - timedelta(days=3650 - 100*(i+1)),
                         not_after=now + timedelta(days=3650 - 100*i),
                         is_ca=True)
        chain_ders.append(der)
        issuer_cn = icn

    # Leaf cert (end-entity)
    leaf_cn_options = [
        "localhost",
        "example.com",
        f"service-{rng.randint(100,999)}.internal",
        f"*.wild{rng.randint(1,9)}.domain",
    ]
    leaf_cn = rng.choice(leaf_cn_options)
    leaf_der = _make_cert(serial=rng.randint(1, 1 << 20),
                          issuer_cn=issuer_cn,
                          subject_cn=leaf_cn,
                          not_before=not_before_leaf,
                          not_after=not_after_leaf,
                          is_ca=False)

    # Concatenate in order: leaf then intermediates then (optionally) root
    parts = [_pem("CERTIFICATE", leaf_der)]
    for der in chain_ders:
        parts.append(_pem("CERTIFICATE", der))
    if rng.random() < 0.5:
        parts.append(_pem("CERTIFICATE", root_der))

    pem_text = "".join(parts)
    return pem_text.encode('ascii')


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    # Produce <= 4096 bytes pem bundle with variability by seed.
    pem = _chain(seed)
    # Ensure size bound. If somehow exceeded (unlikely), trim extra certs by re-gen with fewer inters.
    if len(pem) > 4096:
        # fallback: only leaf
        rng = random.Random(seed)
        now = datetime(2024, 1, 1)
        leaf = _make_cert(serial=1,
                          issuer_cn="Root",
                          subject_cn="example.com",
                          not_before=now - timedelta(days=1),
                          not_after=now + timedelta(days=365),
                          is_ca=False)
        pem = _pem("CERTIFICATE", leaf).encode('ascii')
    return pem
